apps.name: FriedrichAI: Offline AI
apps.short_description:
Run AI directly on your PC — no cloud, no setup, no accounts.
Turn off WiFi — it still works.
Private, local AI with memory. Nothing leaves your machine.

apps.name: Armory Crafter
apps.short_description: Armory Crafter is a modular weapon system that allows you to create weapon models for your games, change their textures, color or size and export them directly to a 3D file format, ready to use in your game or any other 3D project.

apps.name: Auto Mute Music
apps.short_description: Free. Keep your music on without missing a single footstep. Auto Mute Music pauses or lowers Spotify, YouTube, your browser and more the moment a fight starts, then brings it back when you die or the round ends. Works in 21 games, including Valorant, CS2, Apex Legends and Fortnite.

apps.name: FireAlpaca SE
apps.short_description: FireAlpaca SE is painting software for Windows/Mac that has evolved as a higher brand of the regular version of FireAlpaca. We provide a professional creative environment where your creativity can be visualized immediately.

apps.name: Fireworks Premier
apps.short_description: Design, customize, and preview complete fireworks shows with precision timing, music synchronization, layered effects, custom shell placement, and detailed control over every display. Build anything from short sequences to full-length coordinated shows.

apps.name: Foldaria
apps.short_description: Explorer, but faster and better. Foldaria is a modern Windows file manager: tabs, split panes, instant search, Quick Look previews, cloud sync status and 15 themes. One small app, no ads, no account, no tracking.

apps.name: GameMaker
apps.short_description: GameMaker has everything you need to take your idea from concept to finished game. With no barriers to entry and powerful functionality, GameMaker is the ultimate 2D development environment!

apps.name: Godot Engine
apps.short_description: Godot Engine is a feature-packed, cross-platform game engine to create 2D and 3D games from a unified interface. It provides a comprehensive set of common tools, so that you can focus on making games without having to reinvent the wheel.

apps.name: headlineGG
apps.short_description: Create unique VTuber avatars with ease! From the glowing look of classic vector arcade screens to classic boiled animation in a style no 3D model can fake and everything in between. Build from preset parts or draw your own, then bring it to life with built-in webcam tracking!

apps.name: Irida
apps.short_description: Works like Adobe Photoshop, with on-device AI, vectors and print built in. Layers and PSD, AI generation and editing, image trace, Adobe Illustrator-ready .ai, PDF/X-4 and AI agents. One purchase, AI included. AI features require an NVIDIA GPU (8 GB VRAM or more). Everything else runs on any PC.

apps.name: JSAUX E-INK
apps.short_description: JSAUX E-Ink is a companion app for the JSAUX 5.83" E-Ink Display, bringing real-time system monitoring, time, weather, calendar, game information, and personalized images to your SteamOS setup.

apps.name: JSAUX PIXEL
apps.short_description: JSAUX PIXEL is the companion app for the JSAUX dot-matrix display, supporting the display of system status, weather, music, social media notifications, GIF animations, and personalized content.

apps.name: jumpcutGG
apps.short_description: A video editor minus the subscription. Auto-transcribe and clip from the words, build your cut on the timeline, customize the layout, layer captions+graphics, add keyframe anims, then export to any aspect ratio. Runs on your PC - Demo is full version with small watermark

apps.name: LaryWaves Studio
apps.short_description: Turn your music library into a visual experience. 42 real-time audio visualizers, 36 handcrafted themes, 519 pixel characters, powerful music library tools, visualize device audio, and a built-in audio engine with 10-31 Band EQ, Neural EQ and 8D Audio. No telemetry. No subscriptions. Fully offline.

apps.name: Live Wallpaper
apps.short_description: A dynamic Windows desktop app that brings your desktop to life, supporting video wallpapers, customizable mouse pointers and desktop icons, and allows sharing and downloading amazing wallpapers via the Workshop while maintaining multi-resolution, multi-monitor, and performance-friendly features.

apps.name: Mixcraft 8 Home Studio
apps.short_description: Create a soundtrack for your mod or game, or just record your own music.  Use loops to quickly create your beats or use the built-in virtual instruments. Mixcraft is the easiest way to record your music quickly and have it sound great.

apps.name: MobMate WhispTalk – Zero-Cloud Voice Chat Toolkit
apps.short_description: MobMate V2 is a Zero-Cloud voice chat toolkit that sends short TTS reactions like “Got it,” “I agree,” and “laugh” into your voice chat. Even late at night or when you cannot speak loudly, sending quick reactions can make VC more fun.

apps.name: My Auto Clicker
apps.short_description: My Auto Clicker is the ultimate autoclicker and game automation tool, combining a precise autoclicker, a reliable macro recorder, customizable playback binds, and the ability to browse and download community macros and themes published on the Steam Workshop—all in one clean package.

apps.name: Oasis Driver for Windows Mixed Reality
apps.short_description: A SteamVR driver for your Windows Mixed Reality VR headset on Windows 11.

apps.name: PitWall One
apps.short_description: Your race engineer, reimagined. PITWALL ONE is a companion app for F1® 25, Le Mans Ultimate and the Assetto Corsa family: hold push-to-talk, ask about tyres, gaps or when to box, and it answers on the radio from your live telemetry. Live strategy, corner coaching and setup help.

apps.name: Race Track Builder
apps.short_description: Race Track Builder is a software design tool that has a simple, easy to use interface that allows you to build fantasy race tracks or use Google Maps data to create real-life terrain and roads.

apps.name: RealSub
apps.short_description: Live subtitles for Japanese video that has none. Recognition runs locally — from 2 GB of VRAM on a GTX 10-series card (4 GB is better), Vulkan or CPU fallback without an NVIDIA GPU. Capture your whole system, or just one app. Free app = full live transcription; DLC unlocks translation and export.

apps.name: Satisfactory Modeler
apps.short_description: Model your Satisfactory builds. Set up your machines however you like, adding optional limits to the number of any of those machines and the tool will calculate how the parts will flow and how many of each machine type are getting used.

apps.name: Scribeam
apps.short_description: Swipe to type in VR. Get back to your game faster.

apps.name: ShareX
apps.short_description: ShareX is a free and open source program that can capture or record selected area from the screen with a single keypress, automatically save them to your hard disk/clipboard, and instantly upload them to an image/file hosting service and then can copy the URL to your clipboard.

apps.name: SoundWave
apps.short_description: SoundWave is a lightweight soundboard for Windows that lets you play music and sound effects in voice chat. Organize your library, use hotkeys, an overlay, voice effects, and other tools for fast sound control.

apps.name: SpriteMancer
apps.short_description: SpriteMancer is an all-in-one tool to create and animate effects. Includes a Particle Editor, Animation, Fluid Simulation, 3D Support and a powerful Node Graph plus much more!

apps.name: TransBox
apps.short_description: Modular, fully local AI interpreting for games and voice chat. In-game HUD overlay, two-way voice relay for cross-border co-op, and live captions for showcases and esports. All models run on your machine. Customize with Workshop glossaries and subtitle themes.

apps.name: VRCFaceTracking
apps.short_description: VRCFaceTracking creates a bridge between facial-tracking hardware, and applications compliant with the Open Sound Control protocol

apps.name: Wallpaper Play
apps.short_description: 【WallpaperPlay】It is a powerful desktop beautification tool that combines dynamic wallpapers, desktop clocks, music spectrums, typing follow effects, and mouse cursors. For desktop beautification, this one is all you need! O(∩_∩)O~

apps.name: yoruneko - Living Soundscape
apps.short_description: A living ambient workspace for focus and rest. Mix your own soundscape from layered environmental audio, set a focus timer, and watch the night sky shift with the real lunar phase. Five atmospheric moods with original music, designed by a producer for long, quiet hours of work.

apps.name: Houston, We Have a Spungus Playtest
Rattlecrew Playtest
apps.short_description: Playtest Rattlecrew, an action roguelite for 1–4 players. Lead discarded robots into a vast machine world and turn industrial tools into weapons. Try a work-in-progress build and help improve combat, balance, and co-op with your feedback.

apps.short_description: Open the chest, collect legendary swords, craft powerful synergies, and amass enough gold to pay the King. Dodge the Goblin, survive the Dragon’s fire, and earn the Angel’s blessing. Can you conquer the dungeon and reach 2,000,000,000 gold coins?

apps.name: A Normal Quiz Game where you try to solve questions but the questions have tricks and gimmicks and if you get them wrong you have to beat a wacky punishment but they are kinda fun so you lowkey wanna do them even if it means getting the question wrong Demo
apps.short_description: Solve puzzles, test your reflexes, and do your taxes in this normal quiz game that is actually quite unusual.

apps.name: A Stray Line Demo
apps.short_description: Chapter 1 of A Stray Line. Explore a strange world, draw to cast spells, and begin a story about a lonely little family in the woods.

apps.name: About Fishing Demo
apps.short_description: Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.

apps.name: Acts of Blood Demo
apps.short_description: Acts of Blood is a third-person beat ‘em up action game about revenge that focuses on fast-paced, brutal hand-to-hand combat. Set in the fictional city of Bandapa.

apps.name: Alabaster Dawn Demo
apps.short_description: Break Nyx’s curse and guide humanity's rebirth in this top-down 2.5D Action RPG Demo Version from the creators of CrossCode. Battle enemies with stylish combos, wield multiple divine weapons, solve intriguing puzzles and explore a changing world.

apps.name: Aleef Demo
apps.short_description: Work, browse, or play other games while hatching eggs in the background! Collect 300+ pets, unlock powerful upgrades, and build your battle team. Or Sell/Buy from the Steam Community Market.

apps.name: ALTEREDBLOOD+  Demo
apps.short_description: A BLOOD-soaking Movement-FPS platformer🩸where you Splatter walls and floors with your foe’s BLOOD. Stand in that BLOOD to [ALTER] yourself and your Weapons. Soak up BLOOD to replenish and keep fighting. MOTHER created you to stop them. Beckon our Extinction.

apps.name: AlterMage Demo
apps.short_description: Step onto the shores of AlterMage, a first-person action-platformer featuring spellblade focused combat. Embark on a harrowing journey to learn sorcery, explore labyrinthian passages within a forbidden citadel, and uncover the truth of a dark past.

apps.name: Another Door Demo
apps.short_description: Another Door is a multiplayer, turn-based roguelike with monsters, despair, risk and betrayal. Hide your intentions, bluff to survive and bet on your luck. Will you back out, or venture through Another Door?

apps.name: Arcane Shores Demo
apps.short_description: Build your settlement, grow your population, and defend your kingdom in this magical city-builder. Gather resources, construct buildings, and harness powerful spells as you expand your civilization. Survive your first 10 days and prepare to face incoming invaders!

apps.name: Armory Crafter Free
apps.short_description: Armory Crafter is a modular weapon system that allows you to create weapon models for your games, change their textures, color or size and export them directly to a 3D file format, ready to use in your game or any other 3D project. Free version allows to create swords only.

apps.name: ASTHENIA Demo
apps.short_description: In this demo, take the role of Adam, a man torn from his loved one and trapped in an ancient world of entities. Wield the primordial gauntlet to fight distorted foes and explore the remains of an alternate land ravaged by a mysterious disease.

apps.name: Auto Arcana Demo
apps.short_description: Devise the ultimate spell rotation and watch it obliterate your foes in this roguelike auto-battler. Seek forbidden knowledge to craft overpowered spells, assemble devastating combos, and break the game.

apps.name: Bad House Demo
apps.short_description:
Welcome to your new home. Enjoy this free short-term rental, but there's one condition: don’t go into the basement.
Discover the first floors of the dungeon-crawling auto-battler in Bad House’s Demo!

apps.name: BALL x PIT Demo
apps.short_description: Get a taste of BALL x PIT, a brick-breaking, ball-fusing, base-building survival roguelite. Batter hordes of enemies with ricocheting balls and gather the riches of the pit to expand your homestead, generate resources and recruit unique heroes in this hair-raising demo.

apps.name: Barbless Demo
apps.short_description: The first chapter of Barbless. You sold everything you owned and bought a house on a tidal coast, sight unseen, to learn to fish. Here every fish is a boss fight: read the tell, answer right, and it tires. Answer wrong and your line snaps. Your progress carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Barista Dream Demo
apps.short_description:
Barista Dream lets you create a variety of coffees, including espresso, Americano, latte, and cappuccino, with meticulous precision. It aims to provide both fun and learning while making coffee.

Manage your cafe wisely and prepare as many orders as possible to boost your popularity.

apps.name: BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS Demo
apps.short_description: Beastopia Raiders is a 2D PvPvE animal extraction shooter set after humanity’s extinction. Raid zombie-infested ruins, scavenge the machines humans left behind, build a refuge for your animal clan—and extract before the horde closes in.

apps.name: Beat Weaver Demo
apps.short_description: 3D multi-track rhythm action with space-time bending mechanics that reward your style as much as your precision. Hit notes and switch tracks to add instruments to the mix. Become a remix machine, enter the flow state and uniquely approach each song of a highly replayable, genre-defying soundtrack.

apps.name: Beneath Paris Demo
apps.short_description: Descend into the forbidden French Catacombs in this atmospheric first person horror experience. Explore restricted tunnels, uncover hidden secrets, and venture deeper into forgotten passages where the further you go, the more it feels like something is down there with you.

apps.name: Between Cats Demo
apps.short_description: Slide cats of all shapes and sizes to leave exactly one empty space in each row and column. Meet 40 adorable cats and put your puzzle-solving skills to the test across 120 challenging levels.

apps.name: Black Jacket Demo
apps.short_description: Gamble your way out of hell in this blackjack-inspired rogue-lite deckbuilder. Play powerful card combos or cheat to outwit your opponents and earn your freedom. Win their Soul coins! Bribe the ferryman! And uncover the story of those who stand in your way.

apps.name: Bloom Control Demo
apps.short_description: Eradicate the Bloom in this high-energy active incremental. Hack into powerful security weaponry at infested target sites as the only AI fast enough to outpace the spread. Control and destroy the hostile growth before your transmission window closes.

apps.name: Boba Cafe Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: You’re reborn—back at the beginning of your startup journey. In your last life, poor management led to your shop being crushed by competitors. This time, the sweet scent of condensed milk runs through your veins, and you’re set on one goal: turn “Bingbao” into the top name in the industry.

apps.name: Booster Pack Heroes Demo
apps.short_description: Rip open booster packs and pull your next foil hero in Booster Pack Heroes - an incremental game where every pack could contain your next powerhouse. Defend the tower from an endless onslaught of monsters and fight your way through the realms.

apps.name: Breadwinner Demo
apps.short_description: You are the eldest child and the only one with a job. Over six paydays to Christmas, split one salary between rent, the electric bill, Mom's medicine, and what your family asks of you, then come home to what you couldn't afford. A horror game about things that happen to real families everywhere.

apps.name: Brigador Killers Demo
apps.short_description: Isometric insurgent simulator. Fight on foot and in vehicles, build and steal a private arsenal and bring the war home to the businessmen who started it all in this continuation of the Brigador saga.

apps.name: Bulbo's Belief System Demo
apps.short_description: Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told, letting him see, move, and interact, but he can forget! Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity and manage conflicting beliefs to solve cute mind-bending challenges.

apps.name: ButtKnight Demo
apps.short_description:
Save Maidens and slay monsters in this boobastic retro shoot-em-up! No man can stop you. No demon can sway you. And no woman is outside your reach!

Be... The ButtKnight!

apps.name: Canvas City Demo
apps.short_description: Canvas City is a turn-based tactics RPG where movement is core to the strategy. Grind rails, launch off ramps, and use every part of the map to your advantage as you outsmart rival crews and take back the city.

apps.name: Cardalaxy Demo
apps.short_description: Cardalaxy is a card upgrading game with 4X inspiration and 5+ different victories.

apps.name: Casualties: Unknown Demo
apps.short_description: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 5 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.

apps.name: Causal Loop Demo
apps.short_description: Causal Loop is a narrative puzzler in which you solve intricate puzzles on a remote alien world by using the unique “echo” mechanic. Record, replay, and interact with past versions of yourself in this demo for Causal Loop!

apps.name: Chaos The Devil Demo
apps.short_description:
Ps1 era inspired 3D platformer. Run, jump and fly your way through a new adventure, done the old way.

A multi-year solo passion project, handcrafted from scratch.

apps.name: Clockwork Rabbit Demo
apps.short_description: Tessa the bunny was hired at a textile factory as a mechanic. Create and program robots to solve logical puzzles.

apps.name: Coasteroid Demo
apps.short_description: Build stellar rollercoasters across alien worlds, carve tunnels through planets, and launch trains into orbit. Customize every track element, scenery decoration, and environment before subjecting riders to the forces of the universe! The galaxy is your theme park!

apps.name: Cookiesaner Demo
apps.short_description: A Balkan bullet-heaven starring Cookie — a real apricot maltipoo. Auto-fire ćevapi, eat baklava, burek and other Balkan foods to chonk up through five belly stages, and hit STAGE 4: GOD MODE. This free demo is the full opening arc: two biomes, three showdowns to chase.

apps.name: Cop Bastard Demo
apps.short_description: COP BASTARD is a classic first-person shooter set in early 90s Japan, offering non-stop action inspired by action movies.

apps.name: Corner Quest Demo
apps.short_description: An idle auto-battler that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things.

apps.name: Cosmo Cargo Demo
apps.short_description: Cosmo Cargo is an inventory autobattler roguelike PvE game in which you fight to maintain chaos in the galaxy. Collect and combine items in your ship to gain powerful effects and defeat the Administrators.

apps.name: Croak Demo
apps.short_description: Tongue-grapple and pinball-bounce the frog prince across levels to reach the Witch’s Banquet in this hand-drawn 2D platformer. Each whimsical world has its own wacky boss, hidden collectibles, and a unique traversal ability. Grit your teeth! You're gonna CROAK.

apps.name: Crypt Runner Demo
apps.short_description: Navigate dangerous crypts, defeat enemies, and gather loot in this extraction dungeon crawler. If you die, you lose it all. Extract alive to bring your spoils back to your base camp. Visit NPCs, upgrade your town, and gear up for another crypt run.

apps.name: CubeMate Demo
apps.short_description: CubeMate is a chess-inspired 3D puzzle game. Rotate the cube, outthink the board, and solve hand-crafted puzzles — one move at a time.

apps.name: Deep Dish Dungeon - Demo
apps.short_description: A survival exploration game where you navigate through a puzzly hand-crafted dungeon, with metroidvania and crafting elements. Unravel the enigmas of the dungeon’s depths solo or online co-op multiplayer.

apps.name: Die Hand Gottes Demo
apps.short_description: Humanity asked AI to cure disease. It rewrote us. A survival-thriller JRPG with cinematic fixed cameras, tactical gunplay and supernatural powers. Explore the world for supplies and secrets, shape your Gifts, and fight through biotech horrors toward the city where the adventure will truly begin.

apps.name: Digimon Story Time Stranger Demo
apps.short_description: Play the opening chapter of Digimon Story Time Stranger in this demo. Save data from this demo can also be transferred into the full version of the game.

apps.name: Dino Card Hunt Demo
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder with auto-battler combat. Scavenge for Dino eggs to strategically build your team.

apps.name: Diorama Tactics Demo
apps.short_description: Build your team, place your units, and watch them fight automatically in this strategic roguelite auto-battler. Collect powerful heroes, master the board, survive challenging battles, and grow your collection as you push deeper into the game.

apps.name: Director of Management: Football Club Demo
apps.short_description:
Choose your place in football.

Play as a First Team Manager, Club Director, Club Owner, or Federation Executive in a living football world spanning 890+ territories, 60,000+ clubs, and more than 2,000,000 players and staff.

Manage the team. Build the club. Own the institution. Govern the game.

apps.name: DJ Life Simulator: From Your Bedroom to the Mainstage Demo
apps.short_description: Plug in a REAL USB DJ controller or Mouse/Keyboard and learn professional mixing techniques while playing! Rise through a career of epic gigs, and master skills you can use on real decks — the only game where fun truly turns you into a professional DJ.

apps.name: DOCTRINEERS Demo
apps.short_description: DOCTRINEERS is a turn-based strategy game where no two games are ever alike. Devise clever strategies, use unique doctrinal units, and adapt to new battlefields in a single-player campaign and online multiplayer.

apps.name: Don't Drop The Cake Demo
apps.short_description: Use your mouse to balance a cake that wobbles with every step in this horror game. Escape twisted beings and overcome dangerous traps, uncover the mystery behind the cake, and see the story through to its conclusion.

apps.name: Dragon Heist Demo
apps.short_description: A co-op heist game for up to 4 players: sneak into a sleeping dragon's lair, loot its gold, steal its egg and escape through the portal together, without making a sound.

apps.name: Drawquarium Demo
apps.short_description: Draw your very own fish and build a cozy little aquarium. And if you like, set it as your animated desktop wallpaper! Watch your drawings come to life. Feed them, raise them and collect golden scales to unlock new decorations. There's also some handy tools to help you focus and unwind.

apps.name: DREADSHELL Demo
apps.short_description: DREADSHELL is a first-person sci-fi horror game, built on quiet tension and paranoia instead of constant jump scares.

apps.name: Dreamed Away Demo
apps.short_description: Dreamed Away is an emotional action-adventure RPG with psychological horror elements. Play as Théo, a boy lost in a dark, mysterious world. Explore a unique reality, duel against darkness in a unique, fast paced combat system and mind your choices.

apps.name: Dreams of Amelia Demo
apps.short_description: Amelia is very lonely. Working a corporate job leaves you with few chances of getting a boyfriend. And hey, Amelia has her "needs" too! But everything changed when she bought an old book, on the local flea market... with a demon inside! YOU are that demon. Make Dreams of Amelia come true!

apps.name: Drowned Lake Demo
apps.short_description: Turn on your camera and face the ██████ waters of the Drowned Lake. Play as one of three characters: fish, explore, gather resources, and follow clues to a missing documentarian. Survive found-footage horror inspired by Brazilian folklore.

apps.name: Dynamic Breach Demo

Free demo of Dynamic Breach, a top-down tactical shooter of military gothic and necro-technological
horror. Play the five operations of the prologue with an AI squad to command, plus Breach against
bots. The full campaign continues for 28 more operations across five acts.

apps.name: EcoChess Demo
apps.short_description: Save the forest in this improved version of chess with new boards with obstacles and power-ups.

apps.name: Family Reunion: The Appetizer (Demo)
apps.short_description: Your typical incremental family dinner table simulator where you play as a very bored child trying to speedrun THE APPETIZER.

apps.name: Farm & Feast Demo
apps.short_description: Grow fresh ingredients and run your own little restaurant. Enjoy a peaceful day that stretches from the field to the table. Plan a fresh menu for a delightful day, keep your pantry full, and make your customers happy. Earn your own money and build your little world step by step.

apps.name: Farm to Fortune Demo
apps.short_description: Turn a tiny plot into a fortune, one seed at a time. Grow crops, sell them in your shop, and reinvest everything you earn. Better tools, more land, richer harvests. Relaxing from the first seed to the last field.

apps.name: Feed The Void Demo
apps.short_description: An incremental deckbuilder where you shape your deck the way you desire. Upgrade cards, unlock synergies, play massive combos, and constantly discover game-changing abilities.

apps.name: Fenestra Demo

Build a party of heroes, explore randomly generated dungeons, discover powerful builds, and encounter strange creatures as you fight your way through the dungeon. Plan ahead and adapt to your surroundings, or meet your inevitable end.

apps.name: Fork the Rich Demo
apps.short_description: Billionaires should not exist. It's time to Fork the Rich!

apps.name: Foxy Dumplings Demo
apps.short_description: In Foxy Dumplings, you’ll run your own food truck and make friends along the way. Cook dumplings from all over the world, take good care of your clients, and discover how a meal can mend more than just hunger in this cozy cooking sim. Rise to the top of Foxtagram, one heartfelt dish at a time.

apps.name: Fracture Field Demo
apps.short_description: Fracture Field is an incremental quarry mining game. Shatter rocks with timed swings then invest your earnings into upgrades. Build a fleet of drones to automate your empire, bomb tough layers, and unlock powerful prestige upgrades on your journey to master the quarry.

apps.name: Fresh Market Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Build your own supermarket: order stock, fill shelves and serve customers at checkout. Grow your shop to store level 10 in the demo, customise your shop sign and unlock two additional product licences.

apps.name: Game Market Mayhem Demo
apps.short_description: Game Market Mayhem is a cozy organization simulator where you sort 5,120 scattered game boxes according to their genres and platforms. Transform a massive pile of boxes into the perfect game store. Fill the shelves, unwind, and enjoy the satisfaction of everything being in order!

apps.name: Gasoline Demo
apps.short_description: Gasoline is ferentic & bloody --boomer shooter-- inspired by 90s classics.

apps.name: Generic Fighter Maybe Demo
apps.short_description: A classic arcade-style 2D Fighting Game, wrapped up in a goofy, full-of-energy, stylized presentation that mixes great animation and zany battle moves with simplistic doodles!

apps.name: Goblin Smasher Demo
apps.short_description: Hover over goblins and your hammer smashes them. Start with a handful in a quiet meadow and end with thousands on one screen. Liberate 8 goblin lands, build their landmarks, wield 10 legendary hammers and topple the Goblin King in a crunchy pixel-art incremental.

apps.name: GONE Fishing Demo
apps.short_description: GONE Fishing is a CO-OP multiplayer survival horror game where you and your friends must work together to stay alive by fishing. The only way to survive is to keep feeding the lake’s insatiable hunger before it feeds on you. Can you satisfy the hunger... or will you become the next offering?

apps.name: Gopher It: Office Intern Simulator Demo
Greed & Darkness Demo
apps.short_description: Descend into a cursed fortress in this retro-style dungeon crawler where darkness is both your greatest ally and deadliest threat. Gather priceless treasure, face lovecraftian horrors and decide how much you're willing to risk before greed consumes you.

apps.name: Grim Heart: Bleak Laments Demo
apps.short_description: You are Hemwick, ex-witch hunter, chasing an ancient artifact: the Grim Heart. Ready your arsenal and survive brutal encounters in a handcrafted 2D pixel-art world. Your expertise is your greatest weapon and, ultimately, the difference between life and death.

apps.name: Grinding Guilds Demo
apps.short_description: Grinding Guilds mixes the loot hunt and character building from ARPGs, with the strategy elements of Auto Battlers. Pick your hero, level up, get loot and upgrade abilities. Hire allies for your guild, equip Pacts, position your units and find the best strategy to beat all bosses.

apps.name: Gunmetal Gothic Demo
apps.short_description: A co-op shooter-RPG with a retro-3D aesthetic.  Customize and upgrade your character as you take back the city of Vestige from demonic machines!

apps.name: Guns 'n Goblins Demo
apps.short_description: Face a deluge of monsters in this incremental horde survivor FPS. Build your Bastion, level up your character, and upgrade your arsenal to rise from Apprentice Bell Ringer to Master Dragon Hunter.

apps.short_description: Rain precise fire from the skies! In this intense AC-130 experience, coordinate with ground forces, dismantle enemy operations, and hunt down Zmey before his deadly plan unfolds. Every pull of the trigger changes the fate of the battle.

apps.short_description: "Hariti" is a first-person psychological horror game. You will play as a mother searching for her missing daughter in a crisis-ridden hospital. Experience an atmosphere of extreme dread within the halls of this abandoned Chinese-style medical facility.

apps.name: Havkerman Demo
apps.short_description: HAVKERMAN X is an open world, post apocalyptic, first person shooter, immersive Sim. Featuring high risk / high reward gunfights, a multitude of weapons and augmentations to collect to hone your playstyle, and a branching story with quests where you can explore and decide the fate of the wasteland.

apps.name: Head Miner Demo
apps.short_description: Head Miner is an idle mining game where your character spins and crashes into walls to move forward. Break rocks, collect valuable ore, and spend your earnings on character upgrades. Spin, smash, mine, and grow stronger! Try the free demo!

apps.name: Heart of a Bird in a Cage (draft version)
apps.short_description: Draft of a tale intertwining warmth, bitterness, longing and compromise.

apps.name: Heliobane Demo
apps.short_description: The free demo of HELIOBANE: the first three stages of World 1, from the Tharsis Belt to Admiral Husk. Build your first loadout at the Magpie, learn the Breaker, and see if the Amiga-style shoot 'em up is for you. The demo keeps its own save.

apps.name: Hell Is Other People Demo
apps.short_description: Can you survive the horror of being yourself? Play Chapter 1 of Hell Is Other People, a cute and disturbing psychological horror about identity, isolation, and the terrifying reality of being different.

apps.name: Hellforged Demo
apps.short_description: Taste the chaos in the Hellforged Demo! Experience a loot-driven, extraction bullet-heaven game, where every run is a tense heist. Battle demon hordes, pre-craft your build, and unleash epic synergies. Safely extract your epic gear mid-battle, or risk it all for legendary power.

apps.name: Hello Kitty Island Adventure Demo
apps.short_description: Join a friend in Hello Kitty Island Adventure for free! Restore a mysterious island, solve ancient puzzles, cook delicious dishes, customize yourself and your cabins, and so much more. Or play on your own in a special demo.

apps.name: Hello Triangle: Build a GPU - Demo
Heretics Amulet Demo
apps.short_description: A dark, tarot-inspired roguelike card game. Draw cards and place them in a grid to get your total as low as possible. Earn souls and spend them on powerful items to improve your deck between rounds. Includes 8 rule-bending bosses and an endless freeplay mode.

apps.name: Heroll: IF Demo
apps.short_description: Step into the unknown on a mysterious board full of surprises. Roll, spin, and loop. Everything depends on the hero's luck in this dynamic journey.

apps.name: Hey, Don't Look at Me Demo
apps.short_description: You moved into your late grandmother's apartment to sort through her belongings and start a new life. On your very first night, a light appears in the window of the abandoned house across the street... someone is there.

apps.name: Highway Station Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo: the first three days at a highway gas station, alone or with up to three friends. Pump fuel by hand, stock the shelves, punch card payments into the register and try to keep the place from catching fire.

apps.name: Humanless Demo
apps.short_description: In this DEMO, you play as a super skilled combatant, with superhuman speed and agility. Fight against merciless demons, while dashing and jumping to dodge evil traps through a selection of carefully designed levels.

apps.name: HYPERDROP: A Pachinko Roguelite Demo
apps.short_description: Build impossible scoring machines in the HYPERDROP demo, a hypnotising physics-based pachinko roguelite bursting with satisfying chain reactions and game-breaking combos.

apps.name: I can offer you Flowers Demo
apps.short_description: ‘To propose to my boyfriend... what flowers would you recommend?’ Arrange bouquets in this cozy puzzly game! Discover flowers, meet new people, and become the Atrium Botanique community center florist !

apps.name: Infernal West Demo
apps.short_description: Infernal West is a first-person psychological horror puzzle game set in a Wild West saloon. Observe every detail, identify the anomalies warping reality, and unravel the mysteries hidden within an endless loop. Every decision may bring you closer to the exit... or trap you in the loop forever.

apps.name: Infinity Bounce Demo
apps.short_description: Turn the galaxy into a chaotic pinball machine in this physics-based incremental game. Rack up millions of points and do your best to keep the all-consuming space cat fed. Use planets, black holes, and manipulate space and time. Can you fill the cat to the brink of a big bang?

apps.name: Inkblood Demo
apps.short_description: You're an Inquisitor following a trail of death. A cult is at work, your predecessor has vanished, and the region teeters on the edge of chaos. Find the truth. Uphold the Inquisition. Do not fail.

apps.name: Iron Bramble Demo
apps.short_description: Momentum-based platforming built around expressive movement and tight gunplay. Master your elastic grappling hook to explore a vast, cyber-gothic megastructure, where robots piloted by the souls of the dead do penance for their sins.

apps.name: Iron Throat Demo
apps.short_description: Try the opening of Iron Throat, a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game. Keep the survivors of a train crash alive, scavenge the shifting tunnels inside the mountain for food and supplies, and face the first boss. Demo progress does not carry over to the full game.

apps.name: Ironholm: Reign of the Isles Demo
Kaido Genkai Demo
apps.short_description: Kaido Genkai is an open-world racing exploration game that blends the excitement of high-speed races with the charm of anime-style graphics and RPG elements, set in a nostalgic 90's fictional Japanese countryside. Come explore the open world and see who you meet along the way!

apps.name: Keikaku Demo
apps.short_description: Build your dream car and drive through the '90s. Keikaku計画 is a simulation game where you get to experience both authentic car building and life in Japan, and rise to become a '90s street legend.

apps.name: King in the Mountain Demo
apps.short_description: A resource management incremental mining game where you rebuild your Mountain Hall. Plan each descent, choose where your dwarves dig, gather gold and return home when the torch burns out. Manage production, upgrade your crew, dig deeper, and bring your fallen kingdom back to life

apps.name: Liminal Descent Demo
apps.short_description: Experience liminal horror in Liminal Descent, a psychological horror game inspired by the Backrooms. Explore eerie environments and face the unknown in this free demo featuring 1 playable map.

apps.name: Liminal Shroud Demo
apps.short_description: Explore surreal liminal spaces in this first-person psychological horror game. No-clip through shifting realities and uncover a quiet mystery as the Shroud closes in. DEMO includes first 5 chapters!

apps.name: Litany Demo
apps.short_description: Litany is a roguelike deckbuilder where you play multiple units, craft a hyper-synergistic group, and trigger results that should not exist. Pick a character, open boosters, upgrade cards, and craft a powerful combination that breaks the numbers!

apps.name: Little Sheep Valley Demo
apps.short_description: Tend to a flock of sheep and build your perfect Mediterranean farm in this cozy ranch-builder! Decorate, expand, and create the perfect home for your fluffy friends. Yes, you can cuddle them.

apps.name: Little Writer Desktop Companion Demo
apps.short_description: Your little companion is an ambitious writer with very little discipline. Type, and they'll write too. Every keystroke moves their work forward. In this idle productivity game, help them become a renowned author while you get things done.

apps.name: Low-Budget Repairs Demo
apps.short_description: Try the demo of a renovation game set in a 1990s Polish apartment block. Take on jobs, cut costs, improvise, and see if you have a talent for questionable workmanship. The full version will offer more tasks, tools, and absurd renovation chaos.

apps.name: Lucky Punk Demo
apps.short_description: Push your luck and beat the odds in this roguelike deckbuilder. *Draw* another card or *Stop*. 1% chance. 100% choice. Survive and thrive in a vibrant eco-dystopia… or don’t. ¯_(ツ)_/¯ Gather supplies and grow your community in the post-apocalypse. Do you feel lucky, Punk? 💀

apps.name: Lucky Shot Demo
apps.short_description: A shooting dopamine machine! Lucky Shot is a roguelike mag-builder FPS where you master different weapons, build wild combos, and break the game to reach massive high scores.

apps.name: Luma Orb Demo
apps.short_description: Guide your orb through rotating planets and floating islands in this colorful 3D action platformer. Jump across gaps, dodge falling hazards, collect stars, and fight back with power-ups. From fiery worlds to slippery ice, every level brings a new challenge.

apps.name: Lunar Chrysalis Demo
apps.short_description: A box garden escape game. Su Li wakes up to find herself in an unfamiliar room, with monsters lurking around and strange symbols...she explores and solves puzzles in this eerie space, confronting the ever-approaching monsters... all to seize a glimmer of hope and escape this place!

apps.name: MALMORT Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person tower defense set in the Louisiana bayou, 1850. The dead are rising from the black water. Choose one of four heroes, build traps and turrets on stilted walkways, and fight the horde yourself to protect the last totem holding back the evil. Solo or 2-player co-op.

apps.name: Mana Roots Demo
apps.short_description: An idle-farming game where you use magic to handle the work. Plant, expand and automate with the help of animals. All from the bottom of your screen

apps.name: Mancalero Demo
apps.short_description: Mancalero is a marble board game fusing roguelike progression with deckbuilder strategy. Collect special marbles, unlock powerful blessings, and defeat every table to become the true Mancalero.

apps.name: Mauled Horde Demo
apps.short_description: Mauled Horde is a free-to-play 1–3 player co-op horde shooter. Survive relentless waves solo or with friends. Spend resources at Citadels to buy and upgrade weapons, unlock active and passive skills, activate traps, and shape your build as each round grows more intense.

apps.name: MAW Demo
apps.short_description: What's it like to be queer in a totalitarian regime? Explore your identity as a wolf detective working for the state. Sniff for clues. Interrogate or date other characters. Make lasting choices. Will you fight your instincts or embrace who you really are and face the consequences?

apps.name: Mazestalker Demo
apps.short_description: Explore deep isometric dungeon labyrinths in this Action-RPG that was likened to many classics from the 16-Bit Era.

apps.name: Meaningless Random Numbers Demo
apps.short_description: Meaningless Random Numbers is an Incremental Horror Game about earning money through Random Number Generators but be cautious, God is Watching...

apps.name: Mecha Simultactics Alpha
apps.short_description: Mecha Simultactics is a simultaneous-turn-based competitive tactics game with customizable mechs, anime-inspired battle replays, and online multiplayer PvP.

apps.name: Medium Rare Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo. Eat people and conserve ammo as you hike to the top of a mountain where a human meat factory is about to process your kidnapped wife in this turn based survival dungeon crawler.

apps.name: Mercyrail: Haven Bound Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo of a railway survival management game on the real UK rail network. Choose who boards the last train out of a dead London, send crews into empty stations for supplies, and take the line north through the Home Counties. The rest of the run to Haven is in the full game.

apps.name: Metro Anomaly Demo
apps.short_description: Watch the behavior of the office clerks closely and find the one who is merely pretending to be human. You have only one bullet to survive this cycle. Make a mistake, and the anomaly will attack you.

apps.name: MINDWAVE Demo
apps.short_description:
MAKE YOUR WAY TO THE TOP OF MINDSCAPE TOWER.

DELVE INTO THE MINDS OF YOUR OPPONENTS IN THIS MICROGAME FRENZY.

BE CONSUMED BY THE TRUTH THEY SPEAK TO YOU, IN THE CEREBRAL BATTLE OF SIGHT AND SOUND HIDDEN WITHIN EACH OF US.

apps.name: Mira and the Legend of the Djinns Demo
apps.short_description: Explore a Moroccan-inspired 2D pixel art Metroidvania filled with ancient ruins, Djinn magic, and fast elemental combat. Wield powerful weapons, uncover forgotten secrets, and journey through the ruined kingdom of Fallen Amazgesh.

apps.name: MirrorBullet Demo
apps.short_description: A shot that has not reflected cannot kill. Like Perseus facing Medusa through his shield, you strike only by reflection: place mirrors, fire once, and turn the sentries' own volley into your weapon. This demo holds 24 stages from seven sectors of Greek myth.

apps.name: Moonbrella Demo
apps.short_description: A 2D platformer Metroidvania with deep movement and no jump button. Upgrade your umbrella to explore an abandoned planet and ascend to the moon.

apps.name: Moonlight Castle: Easy Idle Defense Demo
apps.short_description: A short relaxing idle game disguised as a first-person shooter. Defend against endless waves, upgrade your firepower, and watch the numbers go up.

apps.name: MOP’N SPARK Demo
apps.short_description:
Try, rewind, and rebuild!
MOP'N SPARK is a 2D puzzle platformer built around clever thinking, where you coordinate a cleaner and an electrician to piece together the solution.

apps.name: Moral Dilemma: Breaking Character Demo
apps.short_description: A fourth-wall-breaking narrative adventure. The Storyteller wants you to kick your nemesis, Charles the Chair, into the lava. It’s the climax of the script. But what if you refuse? Lead a rebellion of fired protagonists and reclaim the story from a narrator who’s lost the plot.

apps.name: MoteMancer Demo
apps.short_description: Automate across six Elemental planes, each with unique logistical tools. Infuse ingredients, craft alchemical structures, and uncover elegant solutions through experimentation - cultivating a garden of possibility, one discovery at a time.

apps.name: Moto Courier Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Ride real-sounding motorcycles through a living island city. Wrench on your own bike in a hands-on garage, take orders, pack them right and deliver before the clock runs out – solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

apps.name: MR DONALD: DEMO
apps.short_description: MR DONALD — the game of the decade. You’re the hero, the hope of gamers and the entire world. Defeat every enemy with your partner and make gamedev great again!

apps.name: MR MAGEBOY DEMO
apps.short_description:
A cozy incremental game about an aspiring mage trying to get RICH!
Upgrade your spells, collect tons of magical resources, and sell for huge profits!

apps.name: Murder Castle Demo
apps.short_description: You are trapped inside a masterpiece of madness. Unravel the chilling mystery of H.H. Holmes Murder Castle. In this atmospheric true crime escape simulator, every room is a puzzle and every document a shocking discovery. Can you escape the architect of death?

apps.name: Mushroom Hunter Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: A relaxing mushroom-foraging simulator. Explore the forest, discover rare mushrooms, appraise their worth, then dry or pickle your finds. Enjoy enchanting nature and relax far from the bustle of the city.

apps.name: My Beautiful Faraway, Please Don't Be Cruel To Me Demo
apps.short_description: A melancholic first-person adventure through a dreamlike, half-remembered nowhere. Explore, encounter its strange inhabitants, and solve puzzles as you unravel a story about the fragility of existence.

apps.name: My Cuckqueen Girlfriend Demo
apps.short_description: Your girlfriend doesn't mind you sleeping with other women. In fact — she loves it. But every secret you keep, every lie you tell, brings her one step closer to something dangerous. Choose carefully!

apps.name: MYTHHUNT Demo
apps.short_description: Try MYTHHUNT solo or in 1–4 player co-op. Prepare at the lodge, explore the forest, hunt wildlife, scavenge gear, face cryptids and extract alive in this early playable preview.

apps.name: Myths are 100% True Demo
apps.short_description: Myths are 100% True is a Fast-Paced Combat-Platformer that feels like X-Files if it was made by 12 year olds back in 2008. This is the Demo of that game.

apps.name: No Wings Required Demo
apps.short_description: A pocket-sized adventure about a flightless duck and his trusty balloon. Explore the Featherfall Islands, take on wildly chaotic tasks, and prove that “winging it” might actually be a valid career strategy.

apps.name: Noctambulo (Chapter 1)
apps.short_description: NOCTAMBULO is a platformer adventure game where you'll have to explore, solve puzzles and collect different items to progress in the story. Learn Bennie's story as you help him find his way into a mysterious nightclub in a town in the Andes.

apps.name: Nova Survivors Demo
apps.short_description: Top-down space roguelite: hold off endless hordes and build your run from cards, artifacts and weapon evolutions. This demo includes the full World 1 campaign (15 levels, 3 bosses) and Survival up to wave 20, with 4 ships and real progression.

apps.name: Nox Mortalis Demo
apps.short_description: Nox Mortalis is a retro-style open world survival game where you must gather resources, craft essential gear, and explore sinister dungeons. Face hellish creatures and fight to survive in this world.

apps.name: Oh No, Meteor! Demo
apps.short_description: Oh No, Meteor! is a short incremental game. Chop trees with your cursor, send lumberjacks, haulers, and miners to work, then spend wood, stone, and coins on a huge skill tree, talent cards, and artifacts before the meteor hits the town.

apps.name: One Million Bolts Demo
apps.short_description: Try the first shift of ONE MILLION BOLTS. Learn the tools in training, then take a factory line of about 1,000 parts apart as a robot operator: unscrew bolts, cut welds, lift out heavy parts and spend your salvage on upgrades. Play solo or with up to three friends.

apps.name: Order, My Lord! Tidy Up the Dungeon Demo
apps.short_description: Try the free demo. You are the Dark Lord, and heroes have left your dungeon in chaos. Pick up objects, gather matching ones and find where they belong in this first-person organizing simulator. Add the full game to your wishlist.

apps.name: PANEMA Demo
apps.short_description: Roll, Score and Bend Luck. A dice-builder roguelike of cartridges, challenges and Yahtzee.

apps.name: Parasite Mutant Demo
apps.short_description: This is a bio-horror RPG featuring a retro third-person semi-fixed camera and an ATC combat system that blends real-time and turn-based elements. You play as Nova, a Psionic Agent sent to investigate a mysterious abandoned city-island, ultimately uncovering the hidden truth and rewriting fate.

apps.name: Pavel Quest Demo
apps.short_description: Pavel has been captured by the diabolical mastermind Lukas. Taken to Lukas's castle on his own private island, Pavel must make his way through the trap filled castle to regain his freedom.

apps.name: Penance Demo
apps.short_description: Searching for his missing wife, Calen awakens in a place that feels both familiar and wrong. As night falls, terrifying creatures emerge. Hide, fight strategically, and solve puzzles to survive the shifting nightmare and uncover the truth.

apps.name: Pidgeon Pocket Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy pixel-art incremental about a flock of adorable pigeons and a park full of clueless picnickers. Aim your flock at the crowd, snatch coins from pockets, and spend the loot on upgrades. This free demo runs until your third pigeon joins, plus a victory lap of bonus rounds.

apps.name: Pig King Demo
apps.short_description: The battle for the pig throne has begun! Fight your way to the top in this arena party brawler for up to 4 players.

apps.name: Plague Doctor: Apothecary Demo
apps.short_description: Run your own plague doctor apothecary in this first-person shop simulator. Grind herbs, stir brews, bottle remedies and advise customers. Set prices, count change, hire staff and grow a humble remedy shop into Rookbridge's trusted apothecary.

apps.name: Plush Rangers Demo
apps.short_description: Survive waves of wacky mutated constructs to defeat powerful bosses with your team of Plushie friends in this quirky chaotic Survivors-like. Earn merit badges to unlock new Plushies, relics, items, and upgrades.

apps.name: Pollinate or Die Demo
apps.short_description: Pollinate or Die is a fast-paced action roguelite focusing on movement, combat and evasion. As one of the last surviving bumblebees, you alone can revive Earth’s flora. Slash, Smash and Dash through waves of enemies as you search for flowers to pollinate and bring life back to the planet.

apps.name: POLYARIS Demo
apps.short_description: Explore the frozen Arctic in the POLYARIS demo featuring survival gameplay, skiing, boating, scavenging, dynamic weather, hostile encounters, and open-ended exploration. Stay warm, manage your needs, and survive the lonely north.

apps.name: Portal Beasts Demo
apps.short_description: Start your Portal Ranger journey in this free demo. Catch beasts, control them in real-time battles and explore Mosswood, Hollowwood and Beast Farm. Play solo or try the separate online co-op campaign with a friend, currently in beta.

apps.name: Primal Idle Demo
apps.short_description:
The real Primal Idle, fenced at level 20 same valley, same save, same
updates as the full game. All 13 skills, your first tamed dinos, your first
apex guardian, the homestead, the camp, contracts, digs and the museum's
entry hall. No timer, and offline progress works.

apps.name: Probably Stolen Demo
apps.short_description: Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set in a dystopian space station. Craft, trade, and smuggle goods of questionable origin, navigate faction loyalties, and stop rampant AI by killing those it controls. Earn enough to buy out your shop before rising rent forces your hand.

apps.name: Red Glare The Reckoning Demo
apps.short_description: 1946. The Reich has fallen. The hunt begins. Track escaped Nazi officers across 7 missions. New commando Fritz the dog, two new enemy types, Roguelike Mode, Fog of War Mode and enhanced weather. Standalone — no base game required. Justice has no borders.

apps.name: Resident Evil 4 Chainsaw Demo
apps.short_description:
Survival is just the beginning.

Experience a taste of Resident Evil 4, a reimagining of the original game released in 2005.

This demo consists of a specially tuned version of the game's opening sequence and can be played repeatedly without time restrictions.

apps.name: Respect The Horde Demo
apps.short_description:
You're outnumbered. Outsmart them.
Lure hordes of zombies into deadly traps, shape their path with obstacles, and grow stronger with every kill. But know when to walk away before overconfidence and greed turn your strategy into uncontrollable chaos.

apps.name: Retro Game Collector Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Demo: play the first five in-game days. Unbox second-hand game lots, sort your shelves, hook up an old console by hand and play a built-in minigame on the CRT. The full game has 300 collectible games on 17 fictional retro systems.

apps.name: Sandcastle Demo
apps.short_description: On a sun-warmed tropical shore, quietly craft a mighty sandcastle. Carve moats, raise towers and walls, then embellish with driftwood, pebbles, shells and seaweed. Gentle tides, soft surf and a calming color palette turn every build into a peaceful, relaxing moment. This is the demo for Sandcastle.

apps.name: Sara Demo
apps.short_description: Sara – a brutal, nonlinear visual novel about sins committed and the final chance for redemption. Are you worthy of forgiveness?

apps.name: Scapewatch: Idle MMO Demo
apps.short_description: 30 skills. Three combat styles. Clans, raids, hiscores, pets, capes. Set up your queue, close the tab, come back richer. Scapewatch is the idle MMO for people who actually like the grind.

apps.name: SCRATCH FEVER Demo
apps.short_description: Scratch tickets, merge cash 2048-style, and set off chains of rockets, TNT, and lightning to afford your next ticket. Build broken combos with dozens of lucky charms in a neon-soaked roguelike about chasing the big win, and what it really costs.

apps.name: Seed in Demo
apps.short_description: Seed in is a vibrant, 2D, puzzle game that challenges you to dig your way out of ingenious and fun levels! Along the way, you’ll enjoy a relaxing, adorable, and quirky story with memorable and lovable characters!

apps.name: Shattered Realms Demo
apps.short_description: Battle hordes of enemies, unlock powerful abilities and new characters, and conquer unique bosses in this dark fantasy roguelite ARPG packed with loot, upgrades, and deep build customization. Traverse the Shattered Realms and reclaim the fragments of a broken world.

apps.name: Shield-Bearer Ben Demo
apps.short_description: Demo with 4 stages. A short incremental game where you play the TANK in a dungeon-finder party. Hold up your Big Shield, call out the red circles, and keep three teammates alive. Upgrade 120+ skills in a giant skill tree and take down the Demon Lord before tonight's patch deletes his dungeon.

apps.name: Shift At Midnight Demo
apps.short_description: An online co-op detective horror for up to 3 players. Work together across randomly generated shifts to investigate your customers, as some are only pretending to be human. Make one mistake, and you’ll be forced to board up, set traps, and hide.

apps.name: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance Demo
apps.short_description: Become a mighty demigod and battle through a decimated Tokyo in a war between angels and demons. Make new allies along your journey, engage in intense, turn-based combat, recruit hundreds of demons and forge your own path to dictate the fate of all existence.

apps.name: Slime Jump Demo
apps.short_description: Slime Jump is a 2D precision platformer game where you explore a world full of hazards and can collect optional gems. There are 7 areas to traverse, two difficulties, cosmetics, and achievements. A grappling hook and blaster gun are needed for later parts. Can you rescue and reunite with your lover?

apps.name: Slots & Skulls Demo
apps.short_description: A turn-based roguelite built on a slot machine. Stop the machine to attack, win fights for chests, and upgrade what drops at the forge (if you dare). Or invite a friend and fight them.

apps.name: Slumber Realm Demo
apps.short_description: Battle your childhood fears in a 90s-soaked dice roguelike. One die roll triggers your entire build. Chain wild combos, fight broccoli, and decorate your bedroom with nostalgic relics.

apps.name: Somebody's Home: The Boarding House Demo
Something to Drink? Demo
apps.short_description: I'm Tom and I just got a job as a bartender. Now I have to wipe down the same sticky counters where I used to leave my own marks. In this dive, even the rats look like they're hungover. Alright, the boozers won't pour their own drinks - time to get back to work.

apps.name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds Demo
apps.short_description: In the Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds – Demo, try out 4 characters, 8 courses (3 main courses + 5 CrossWorlds), 15 different Machines, and customize playstyle with 20 Gadgets. Test out Grand Prix and Time Trial modes, and explore the Garage to personalize your vehicle.

apps.name: Spaceflight Simulator 2 Graphics Demo
apps.short_description: Graphics and performance demo for Spaceflight Simulator 2. Explore stunning scenarios from low Earth orbit to the Moon’s surface and test how the game performs on your own device. The demo also includes a full planet editor for creating your own customplanets.

apps.name: Splitcard Demo
apps.short_description: Every card is a choice. Swipe left or right to unleash one of two powers, build broken combinations, and fight your way through a challenging roguelite deckbuilder.

apps.name: Star Claw Demo
apps.short_description: A claw-machine roguelite where you fling a cat's stretchy paw to grab treasure. Bounce off bumpers and reach each room's cash target before time runs out. Combine powerful upgrades, battle bosses, and unlock new cats and decorations between runs.

apps.name: Steel Horse Demo
apps.short_description: Muster your knights, call upon your champions, bring forth your... M4A4 Sherman? Steel Horse is an atypical fantasy turn-based strategy game. Take control of Samuel and Andrew, two tankers from the far future of 2025 summoned to this world to save it from its own rabid wild taken form!

apps.name: Stellar Blade™ Demo
apps.short_description: Reclaim Earth for humankind. Enjoy a taste of this gripping human fate story, as EVE embarks on a mission to save Earth from oblivion.

apps.name: Sticky Rooms Demo
apps.short_description: Furniture comes as stickers, so the order matters and mistakes can’t be undone. Clara has left the office to become an interior designer, with thirty jobs ahead of her and a home of her own to decorate at her pace. A new illusion to live in.

apps.name: Swarmhold Demo
apps.short_description: Swarmhold is a base defense roguelite where you survive the relentless swarm. Gather resources, build your defenses, draft in-game upgrades, and fight alongside your base to hold the line. Play solo or with up to 3 friends.

apps.name: Swirl Together Demo
apps.short_description: Swirl Together is a playful and relaxing fluid sim than can be enjoyed alone or with friends.

apps.name: Table of War Demo
apps.short_description: Command an army, not a hero. Your units move and fight on their own action points; the deck is your command channel. Every soldier is named, promoted, and gone for good when they fall. This demo is the opening act of the campaign — one commander, one act, one run at a time.

apps.name: Tech Legends Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Open a tiny PC shop and make it the talk of Northgate. Stock shelves from Amazoom deliveries, set your prices, ring up customers at a real register, and build your first gaming PC's by hand. Play your opening three days, then carry your shop into the full game.

apps.name: Tenebrarium Demo
apps.short_description: An idle-like alien colony simulator. Study an alien species and expand the colony to discover all their peculiar behaviours.

apps.name: Terrible Lizards Demo
apps.short_description: Terrible Lizards is a horror parkour game set against the backdrop of an old Route 66 attraction… with something dark and sinister lurking below. To escape, you’ll need to move fast, navigate challenging terrain, and uncover what Dalton’s Dinos is really hiding. You’d better start running.

apps.name: The Cardian - Light the Shrines Demo
apps.short_description: The Cardian is a tactical roguelike deckbuilding card-defense game where positioning is everything. Predict enemy movements, plan your path, and set your cards in advance. See the future, outsmart the swarm, and defend the last Shrines of Light!

apps.name: The Halloway Haunting Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Explore six abandoned buildings in the town of Halloway, solve the puzzles that turn their lights back on, and get away from the thing hunting you in the dark. Play online, in splitscreen, or alone.

apps.name: The Labyrinth Demo

apps.short_description: Bagnomor is a bleak survival-horror set in a remote corner of Eastern Europe, where ancient entities were awakened by human folly. There is no escape, and the forest wall is closing in.

apps.name: Balingo
apps.short_description: Balingo is a bingo roguelike where every ball counts. Buy bingo cards, mark numbers, and combine tickets, stamps, markers, and marbles to create unique combos and reach ever-higher scores before you run out of balls.

apps.name: Ballisticards
apps.short_description: Ballisticards is a physics-based, point-chasing, deck-building roguelike where every drop counts. Drop balls onto your cards to rack up points. Power-up your deck with stickers, paint, and stamps to trigger wild chain reactions, discover powerful synergies, and score big!

apps.name: Banana Airways
apps.short_description: Feed your passengers. Or they'll eat each other. Run an airline with cannibal chickens, radioactive passengers and screaming babies you can throw off the plane. Fly, serve, repair and try to land. Play solo or with up to five friends.

apps.name: Bank Vault: Tidy Up Together
apps.short_description: Organize a bank vault packed with 2,345 unique items! Sort cash, gold, and precious treasures, arrange every shelf, and turn chaos into order. Team up with friends in this satisfying tidying adventure!

apps.name: Bar Baron: Restaurant & Nightlife Tycoon
apps.short_description: Turn a half-empty room into the hottest place in town. Build your rooms, open up your menu, hire your crew, plan your supply and handle the crises every night throws at you. Bar Baron is an isometric management game that simulates running a bar and restaurant in depth.

apps.name: Barbless
apps.short_description: You sold everything you owned and bought a house on a tidal coast, sight unseen, to fish. Here every fish is a boss fight: read the tell, answer right, give line, hold steady, and it tires. Answer wrong and your line snaps. You get better because you learned the fish, not because your stats went up.

apps.name: Barely Alive
apps.short_description: A co-op survival party game. Hunt your friends or survive until sunrise.

apps.name: Barista Dream
apps.short_description:
Barista Dream lets you create a variety of coffees, including espresso, Americano, latte, and cappuccino, with meticulous precision. It aims to provide both fun and learning while making coffee.

Manage your cafe wisely and prepare as many orders as possible to boost your popularity.

apps.name: Be a Pirate!
apps.short_description: Defend your pirate fleet from the Crownsmen - and the monsters that lurk beneath.  Command Cannons, Voodoo Cauldrons and more across the land and sea, rescue and upgrade a crew of missing pirate captains to assist you while you face down the Crown and their dark plan.  Think, don't just click!

apps.name: Beach Side Chaos
apps.short_description: A very British seaside beat ’em up. Choose from three fighters, battle through nine stages, grab weapons and unleash powerful specials. Take back the seafront from Steve Barage and his thugs, solo or with a mate in local two-player co-op.

apps.name: BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS
apps.short_description: BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS is a 2D PvPvE animal extraction shooter set after humanity’s extinction. Venture into ruined cities and dangerous laboratories, search for valuable supplies, and return safely to your shelter with your loot.

apps.name: Beasts of Prey
apps.short_description: Beasts of Prey - a survival sandbox game! Hunt Dinosaurs, craft items and build massive structures to claim your own land in a game-world full of dinosaurs, cannibals and other dangers.

apps.name: Beer Thirty
apps.short_description: You're broke, on house arrest, and starting an illegal backyard brewery. Dig for ingredients, brew beer, sell to questionable customers, and turn your tiny operation into a beer empire. Go solo or bring 3 friends.

apps.name: Berry Busy Tidy Up!
apps.short_description: Thousands of fruit lie scattered across a sunny terraced market. Pick them up, carry them to the right stall and set each one into neat, satisfying rows. No timer, no fail state: just you, 4,000+ pieces of fruit and the quiet joy of putting everything in its place.

apps.name: Between Cats
apps.short_description: Slide cats of all shapes and sizes to leave exactly one empty space in each row and column. Meet 40 adorable cats and put your puzzle-solving skills to the test across 120 challenging levels.

apps.name: Between Us: Reckoning
apps.short_description: Step into the shoes of Laura, a journalist drawn into a web of mystery, murder, and buried secrets. Every choice shapes your fate as you uncover the truth behind a series of brutal killings tied to your past—before it's too late.

apps.name: BioRogue
apps.short_description: Grab a living cybernetic fish. Fire it. Mutate it. BioRogue is a 3D twin-stick roguelite bullet hell where 100+ mutagens let you splice together a build that's yours alone. Die, adapt, and go again, until the regime that built this island out of genetic exploitation finally falls.

apps.name: Bit Rot
apps.short_description:
Create your fortress, ready your arsenal, upgrade your defences, and prepare yourself! 

BIT ROT is a co-op and singleplayer zombie horde survival where every run is different. A new map, loadout, base, and a new way to die! How long can you survive the horde?

apps.name: BLACKFROST: The Long Dark 2
apps.short_description: A year after the Aurora’s appearance & the world went dark, the people of Harmont & its vast wild environs struggle to survive the Quiet Apocalypse. Survive alone or with others against a host of new hazards & a fresh new survival sandbox from a pioneer of the genre. Live together. Die alone.

apps.name: BLIP
apps.short_description: Welcome to B.L.I.P., a semi-idle incremental game about a tiny lab with unreasonable ambitions! Build machines, recruit Scientists, and make an absurd number of Blips.

apps.name: BlobBobbing
apps.short_description: Drag squishy gummy blobs onto their twins and watch them fuse into rarer, shinier blobs. A cozy merge idler where every blob wobbles, stretches and bounces like real jelly, and your nest keeps bobbing and earning while you're away.

apps.name: Block Dash
apps.short_description: A short, fast-paced action game where you move and dash your way through an abstract obstacle course. Encounter a wide variety of blocks that all pose different challenges. Will you be able to make your way through and see what lies at the end of it all?

apps.name: Block Garden
apps.short_description: A 3D puzzle game about bringing jelly blocks together. Blocks of the same color stick when they touch, and once they're stuck they move as one piece. Push them around small islands with a cat until each color is joined up.

apps.name: BLOOD CRUCIBLE
apps.short_description: A no-turns deck builder roguelike game. Time your ability and combo enemies while you frantically play cards. Explore hexes to power up with stats, xp-gaining-cards, and artifacts. Get bloody through this stylized crucible.

apps.name: BloodStar: Raiders
apps.short_description: Command a squad of Raiders in this brutal turn-based tactics game, fighting rivals and monsters for loot and the powerful Relic before racing to escape alive.

apps.name: Bloom Control
apps.short_description: Eradicate the Bloom in this high-energy active incremental. Hack into powerful security weaponry at infested target sites as the only AI fast enough to outpace the spread. Control and destroy the hostile growth before your transmission window closes.

apps.name: Bloomsgrove
apps.short_description: Bloomsgrove is a short incremental game about a ghost in a forgotten tomb overgrown with plants. Tend to your grave by harvesting various weeds and plants while uncovering memories of who you once were.

apps.name: Bloomtop
apps.short_description: A cozy idle gardening game that lives at the bottom of your desktop. Water, harvest and cross-pollinate pixel-art plants while you work, discover 70+ hybrids, and grow a flowering vine up your monitor's edges until it frames your whole screen.

apps.name: Blue Hawaii Aniki's Soft Ore Demand vol.5
apps.short_description:
Blue Hawaii Aniki, a self-proclaimed film director, takes a paycheck gig
hosting a cheap late-night variety show. Six segments, only four air each
episode. No lectures, no tearjerking - just 2-3 hours in a world you may
wish you lived in. New readers can start here.

apps.name: Board Game Tycoon
apps.short_description: Start your own board game publishing company! Combine themes and mechanics, name your games and customize their covers. Have your prototypes playtested, refine your ideas and publish your games. Invite creators, win over fans and critics, and create your first hit.

apps.name: BOOM! Buster
apps.short_description: BOOM! Buster evolves the arcade genre into a fresh, new experience in this adrenaline-filled hot-potato adventure.

apps.name: BOOMER
apps.short_description: A chaotic co-op horror game for up to 6 players. Scavenge eerie environments, feed your loot to a hungry steam engine, and pass Boomer between teammates in a deadly game of hot potato.

apps.name: Boopie Island
apps.short_description: Build a cozy colony for your Boopies! Keep them happy with swings, flowers, and plenty of cozy surprises — and watch your little village grow.

apps.name: Bootleggers
apps.short_description: Burn bootleg games in a waterfront shed and sell them off a folding table while a patrol cop works the block. Every disc you get your hands on unlocks a new branch of the piracy tree. Save enough and the failing internet cafe across town goes up for sale.

apps.name: Borrowed Faces
apps.short_description: Help stranded humans escape an otherworldly realm as you pick them up on your bus route. Investigate and interrogate each new arrival to ensure they don't devour you or your passengers as you head to your safehouse.

apps.name: Breadwinner
apps.short_description: You are the eldest child and the only one with a job. Over six paydays to Christmas, split one salary between rent, the electric bill, Mom's medicine, and what your family asks of you, then come home to what you couldn't afford. A horror game about things that happen to real families everywhere.

apps.name: Brighter Tomorrow
apps.short_description: Your future starts tonight. Take contracts from a suspicious temp agency, gear up, and work the night shift in an abandoned hospital. Restore power, finish the job, and survive long enough to clock out in this procedural co-op horror game.

apps.name: BRIGHTON BEACH TAKEOVER
apps.short_description: Russian gopniks from Brighton Beach take over America by destroying all buildings and replacing them with Soviet panel buildings while counter-attacking the US forces.

apps.name: BRO, DON'T DROP IT!
apps.short_description: A brutally difficult 1-2 player flying-disc game where one person throws and the other must catch. Miss once and the run is over. Survive 9 increasingly ridiculous holes, master impossible throws, and find out whether your friendship can survive the course.

apps.name: Broken Sword - The Smoking Mirror: Reforged
apps.short_description: The classic award winning adventure returns in glorious 4K with fully remastered audio. Step into the shoes of intrepid tourist George Stobbart and sharp-witted journalist Nico Collard as they unravel a deadly Mayan conspiracy steeped in ancient artifacts and dark magic.

apps.name: Bronzebeard's Tavern 2
apps.short_description: A chaotic 1–8 player co-op tavern simulator where you travel across fantasy regions, master unfamiliar cuisines, and serve unpredictable customers under the guidance of legendary tavern mentors.

apps.name: Build A Bot
apps.short_description: A top-down shooter rogue-like that sees its player take control of a mechanized weapons platform designed for one thing and one thing only: “Take down the corporation, by any means necessary. . .”

apps.name: Bull Gone Wild
apps.short_description: Play as a bull where you build momentum, chain attacks, and slam into enemies as everything around you explode into chaos. It’s all about feeling powerful, out of control in a good way, and turning every fight into something loud, messy, and fun.

apps.name: Burg Battle
apps.short_description: Burg Battle is a reverse tower defense game by ElevenSeventy. Build custom bases, strategically counter your enemies, and push to destroy their castle.

apps.name: Cabezurrio vs Skeletons
apps.short_description: In a world dominated by skeletons, Cabezurrio is the only hope for restoring things to how they once were. Armed only with a suit of armor, a shield, and a sword—and aided by a wizard—he will attempt to wipe out all the skeletons and set his companions free.

apps.name: Calamity County
apps.short_description: Calamity County is a first-person survival horror game set in an abandoned theme park. The player’s main weapon is an unreliable toy gun that forces the player to control it like a classic rail-shooter game. The player must survive as they slowly discover the unnerving past behind Calamity County.

apps.name: Call It a Day
apps.short_description: A physics-based online co-op game where you and your friends play as the world's worst renovation crew. Drag the couch up the stairs, water down the paint and throw the trash out the window - but don't work too hard. Cracking open a cold one with the boys is also part of the job.

apps.name: CaLLMara
apps.short_description: CallMara is a psychological thriller with elements of horror, set in a gloomy medieval village. The protagonist, waking up in the forest, discovers a devastated village and explores its secrets, gradually realizing that he has become the cause of the evil that has engulfed his village.

apps.name: Campus Clash
apps.short_description: Campus Clash is a free-to-play collectible card game set on a magical university campus. Pick one of 15 Leaders from five rival cliques, build your deck from 242 cards and outwit your opponents in turn-based duels, against the AI or in ranked online matches.

apps.name: Canyons
apps.short_description: Canyons is a third-person action shooter set in a procedurally generated world. Fight mysterious Awakened alone or in co-op for up to 4 players, command giant Crawlers, build your haven, and survive a brutal living world.

apps.name: Card Bundler: Complete Collection
apps.short_description: A short and relaxing card-collecting game. Discover, create and sell card bundles to buy new card packs and complete your collection!

apps.name: Carnival Catastrophe
apps.short_description: Clean up a trashed carnival by finding misplaced items, restocking booths, fixing up rides, and getting everything ready to open again.

apps.name: Carrer Manager 27
apps.short_description: Experience a complete football career, from the youth academy to stardom. Create your player, develop through training, earn a place in the senior squad, compete matches, negotiate contracts, and turn every decision into part of your legacy.

apps.name: Carta Bellum
apps.short_description: A turn-based roguelike RPG for wizards with no self-control. Stack charms until your spark throws knives, calls meteors and builds Tesla turrets that zap whatever moves. Pick your path across a map of shops, treasure and weirdos. Rob graves or play the saint, and your magic goes holy or full devil.

apps.name: Case 27: Noema
apps.short_description: The architecture of the visible does not belong to material bodies, but to the numinous abyss we sculpt around them.

apps.name: Cat Cat Cat Factory
apps.short_description: Run a factory with cats! Put them to work, optimize production, and make magic tools and medicines to fulfill requests in a fantasy world. Expand your factory, unlock new products, and venture into action stages to gather materials. Grow your factory together with your cats!

apps.name: Cataclyzm
apps.short_description: A 2D arcade shoot 'em up forged in the age of fire, feedback and METAL! Battle corrupted amps, demonic guitars and epic metalheads as you chug beer in a hellish concert of bullets and riffs. Crank it up to eleven and enter the moshpit!

apps.name: CelSector
