apps.short_description: A 2D sci-fi action side-scroller where you fight to survive a facility overrun by biological nightmares. Blast through enemies with an arsenal of firearms, deeply customize your character's appearance, and avoid hazards, traps, and mutations.

apps.name: Cesta
apps.short_description: Story-focused gunrunning sim. Find a contact who can supply, make the deal, smuggle it over the border, and sell it to a buyer. Pay them, stall, lie, or steal. Treat them with respect or spit on them. But remember that fucking people over has its price...

apps.name: Chaotic Conundrum
apps.short_description: Hit the ground running in a frantic and fast adventure through a broken world made of lost fragments of time and space. Featuring a 90s-graffiti artstyle and a headbanging dynamic soundtrack.

apps.name: CHEAT
apps.short_description: A co-op exam cheating game where you and up to 5 other students explore schools filled with teenage hijinks ran by a demonic faculty. Steal answers, bully nerds, pray to a magic 8 ball - develop your cheating skills all so you can pass the impossible year-end exam by any means necessary.

apps.name: Chef Buba
apps.short_description: Recover the lost recipes of Minas Gerais cuisine in a world transformed by "The Defragmentation"! Explore charming 3D dioramas, solve logic puzzles, and help Chef Buba overcome creative challenges in this 360° sokoban adventure.

apps.name: Chess Twist
apps.short_description: A mind-bending chess game, where straight lines turn and diagonals fork. Millions of different boards with new strategies hidden in plain sight.

apps.name: Christmas Tree Simulator
apps.short_description:
This is a cozy Christmas game!
Decorate your tree in a beautiful living room, all ready for Christmas Eve, with a warm fireplace and an adorable little cat by your side. Christmas dinner is waiting for the family to arrive. No pressure, no rules... just you and the magic of Christmas!

apps.name: Chrome Carnage
apps.short_description:
Machines took all jobs but one - urban blood sport.
Chrome Carnage is a multiplayer top down shooter set in vibrant chaotic cyberpunk cities.

apps.name: Chronicles Unwritten
apps.short_description: Command an army from colliding timelines in this free-to-play strategy card game. Combine Units, Relics, and Events across four eras, complete Chronicles, and outthink AI opponents. All 220 base cards are included from the start.

apps.name: Chunk DAW
apps.short_description: Build music out of blocks! Place, pitch, and sequence sounds in a 3D world, solo or with friends in real time. Jam over built-in voice chat, shape terrain and scenery around your songs, then publish your creations for the world to browse, remix, and play.

apps.name: Claim Me After the Hurricane
apps.short_description: Four days after Hurricane Honora, catastrophe adjuster Arlo Fontenot arrives on powerless Corvina Key to make fast, final calls. Choose between three divergent romance routes as Vivienne, Tess, and Poppy force him to confront what he owes the island—and them.

apps.name: Cleanup Gone Wrong
apps.short_description: Clean up a world where the trash fights back! Play solo or with up to 4 players online. Collect rubbish, wash away grime, dismantle bulky junk, and upgrade your tools. Battle trash monsters, rescue your friends, and turn a filthy workplace into a job well done.

apps.name: Click and Slash
apps.short_description: A cute desktop monster that accompanies you every day.

apps.name: CLOCKHEART — The Dead Hour
apps.short_description: The Master Clock stopped at 11:47 and the whole city froze. Climb a gothic clockwork tower card by card in this roguelike deckbuilder: living, animated combat, 58 cards, 25 relics, a crooked blackjack den, fair minigames and three endings.

apps.name: Cloudwright
apps.short_description: Build a cozy factory in the clouds. Salvage your crashed airship, set conveyors humming across your island, then sail off to discover new islands and the people who live there. Solo or online co-op, up to 8 players.

apps.name: Cluckopia
apps.short_description: Cluckopia is a cozy block-building game. You are a rooster: build a house — walls, door, roof — and set out to find your missing sister. Plant, cook, forge, decorate the village and make friends at your own pace; when danger comes, awaken the legendary powers. Play alone or with up to 3 friends.

apps.name: Coalition Defense: The Twisted Scourge
apps.short_description: Gather heroes, warriors, and defensive towers of different races to resist the oncoming horde of mutated enemies! In this tower defense game that combines roguelite elements, kill enemies to earn coins, build defenses, and discover powerful cross-race synergies through random upgrades.

apps.name: Code 87
apps.short_description: A co-op horror adventure where you infiltrate the quarantined Blue Hive City, recover vital data, find the antidote, uncover BHL's secrets, and escape the nightmare alive.

apps.name: Code Market
apps.short_description:
Your store. Your robot. Your code.

Code Market is a relaxed management game where you don't click to sell — you program. A robot works in your supermarket, and it does exactly what your Java code tells it: walk to a rack, pick up tomatoes, take a customer's order, pack the bag.

apps.name: CODEX : RECALL
apps.short_description: CODEX : RECALL is a single-player PvE strategy card game that combines 2.5D exploration, deckbuilding, tactical grid movement, and fragmented storytelling. Explore The World of Codex, restore Mind Spaces corrupted by breaches, and uncover the truth behind you, Lipa, and this world.

apps.name: COG
apps.short_description: HNI Industries is HIRING TODAY! Join a team where productivity is purpose and exhaustion is honor. Your worth will be measured by each word you successfully type. Can you handle the stress?

apps.name: Cold Rails
apps.short_description: Cold Rails is a horror adventure set on a train. You work as a bartender, serving drinks to passengers and uncovering a story as a mysterious woman in a dress stalks the train.

apps.name: Coldwater County
apps.short_description: Build and tune your truck, then find your line across Coldwater County. Explore nine touring trails and three expert crawling routes, earn permits and medals, and tackle recovery jobs in a single-player off-road driving game.

apps.name: Coliseum Slap
apps.short_description: Launch gladiators, earn money, and buy your freedom in a coliseum filled with chaos. Customize the voices of 7 types of gladiators using your microphone, unlock upgrades, overcome absurd events, and multiply your earnings with unpredictable physics.

apps.name: College Architect
apps.short_description: Design, build, and manage a college campus. Become an architect of a prestigious university that only accepts the most elite students, or a community college that allows for normal everyday folks to pursue an education regardless of their academic background. What will you build, Architect?

apps.name: Color-Mixing Workshop
apps.short_description: Run your own paint workshop solo or with up to 3 friends. Brew paint from water and color tablets, mix any color you can imagine and name your discoveries. Fill customer orders, automate production with conveyor belts and grow your workshop into a color empire.

apps.name: Combustor
apps.short_description: Gas reaction simulator. Build the ultimate jet engine, solve puzzles, or just make everything explode!

apps.name: Company of Heroes - Definitive Edition
apps.short_description: Company of Heroes – Definitive Edition, features the original Company of Heroes along with the Opposing Fronts and Tales of Valor Expansions, enhanced visuals, quality-of-life gameplay improvements, and 64-bit platform support.

apps.name: Confined Space - Module Madness
apps.short_description: A bullet-hell roguelite where your weapons wear out. Every module burns through its own durability, and when it breaks, it's gone for good. Loot, trade and rebuild your loadout between waves, adapt to whatever the next arena throws at you, and see how long you will last in the endless battle.

apps.name: CONTRAXIS
apps.short_description: Contraxis is a fast-paced 2.5D arcade action game where you trace, capture, and command escaped prisoners in the prison city of Axis. Master quick reflexes, summon assists, and survive escalating bosses to chase the highest score.

apps.name: Cookiesaner
apps.short_description: Vampire Survivors, but the survivor is a real apricot maltipoo. A Balkan bullet-heaven: Cookie auto-fires ćevapi, devours baklava and burek to chonk up through five belly stages, and hits STAGE 4: GOD MODE — a giant Cookie rolling through the horde. Sevdah soundtrack. One dog. The whole čaršija.

apps.name: Counter-Strike:Global Offensive
apps.short_description:
Counter-Strike:Global Offensive (CS:GO) expands upon the team-based action gameplay that it pioneered when it was launched over 2 decades ago.

CS:GO features new maps, characters, weapons, and game modes, and delivers updated versions of the classic CS content (de_dust2, etc.).

apps.name: CoXistence
apps.short_description: A strategic card battler with 8 attack vectors on a dynamic 4×4 board. Explore a magical world map, earn rare cards, combine and fuse cards to strengthen your deck, and adapt to shifting battles as you uncover arcane secrets in a mysterious fantasy realm. Bring those cards online in PvP mode.

apps.name: Cozy Puzzle Simulator 3D
apps.short_description: Unwind with realistic 3D jigsaw pieces in four cozy rooms. Explore 100 puzzles, turn your own pictures into puzzles, and settle in with changing daylight, rain and relaxing music. Start small or take on 500 pieces, with your progress saved between sessions.

apps.name: Crateball
apps.short_description: Crateball is a 3v3 arcade football game. Crates drop onto the pitch during the match. Some give you a gun, a homing bazooka or a shield. Others freeze you, reverse your controls or explode. The arena changes after every goal. Play online with friends, and bots take any empty spots.

apps.name: Crater Cargo: Mars
apps.short_description: Build a freight company on Mars. Connect mines, depots and spaceports, dispatch autonomous trucks, and compete for profitable contracts. Balance cargo capacity, energy costs and deadlines as you grow an industrial network on the Red Planet.

apps.name: CrazyFood
apps.short_description: Cook in the back of a food truck while a friend drifts through the city at full speed. Grill, chop, stack, and deliver on foot before your customers lose patience. Chaotic online co-op for 2–4 players, or team up for 4v4 Versus.

apps.name: Creep Tank
apps.short_description: Build and customize your own arcane aquarium in this cozy collection/idler game. Use your magic to summon juvenile cute creepy fish. Tend to them and watch them grow. Make discoveries, expand your collection, decorate your tanks with art and plants.

apps.name: Creepy Mansion Party
apps.short_description: A spooky pixel-art platformer set in an abandoned mansion on Halloween night. Fight monsters, explore eerie rooms, and rescue the missing children before the Witch completes her sinister ritual.

apps.name: Crossing Space Zen
apps.short_description: Fly a small ship with a whole people asleep on board and find a world to land on. Real gravity, beautiful suns best admired from afar, and not a single weapon: when trouble comes, you fly.

apps.name: Crow Boss
apps.short_description: Feared for countless acts of brutality, the former warrior known only as Boss returns from the depths of Limbo. Betrayed by those he once served, he now walks among the living once more, driven by a single purpose: to take revenge on those responsible for his downfall.

apps.name: Crown of Mourningfire
apps.short_description: Battle through a cursed kingdom in Crown of Mourningfire, a dark fantasy action platformer. Wield four weapons, dodge deadly attacks, and face monstrous guardians across 30 areas in ten haunted realms. Break the crown’s hold and bring dawn back to the fallen.

apps.name: Crownsink
apps.short_description: A fast top-down action roguelite. Every run: new floors, new loot, a new build. Chain hundreds of weapons and upgrades into something absurd, dodge through hazard rooms and arenas, and dethrone eight monster kings. Play solo or drop in with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

apps.name: Cruel Guardians
apps.short_description: Your manor is threatened from every side by brigands, anarchist revolutionaries, and a demigod. Will you resort to forbidden magic or pray for divine aid? An interactive fantasy novel, 181,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

apps.name: CTRL-U: Testing Facility
apps.short_description: CTRL-U: Testing Facility is a Platform Parkour FPS where every second counts. Fine-tune the prototype of the K-Series Auxiliary Android through a series of increasingly challenging test courses, facing obstacles and enemies that will put your speed and efficiency to the test.

apps.name: Cull
apps.short_description: Cull is a fast-paced 2D pixel-art action-roguelike set in a dark fantasy world. Battle through relentless waves of enemies, upgrade your abilities, and survive in the heart of darkness!

apps.name: CULLFALL
apps.short_description: CULLFALL is a 1–4 player co-op third-person horde shooter. Choose a specialized soldier, complete deadly missions, tear through overwhelming infected swarms, destroy elite enemies and survive the final fight for extraction.

apps.name: Cyrurgia
apps.short_description:
Step into a vanishing world.
Make it whole again.
Cyrurgia is a surreal first person narrative game centered around a tragedy, and what it takes to fix it, if that is even possible.

apps.name: DABA Land of Water Scar
apps.short_description: Clayman, the world in your hands. God, savior, or destroyer. Choose, and pay the price.

apps.name: DarkBazaar
apps.short_description: A case opening roguelite where you trade illegal weapons on the dark web to pay off a debt... or die.

apps.name: DEAD BLIND
apps.short_description: DEAD BLIND is a 2–4 player dark gambling party game where you have 60 seconds to loot an abandoned lab, then risk your haul against your friends in a winner-take-all game of Texas Hold’em. The winner takes the cash. The rest hang.

apps.name: Dead Harvest
apps.short_description:
Prepare your defenses. The dead are coming.

Dead Harvest is a tower defense game where you must protect your territory from hordes of zombies.

Your turrets won’t be doing all the work: you’ll also have to fight the zombies by running them over with your motorcycle!

apps.name: Dead Meat
apps.short_description: A murder mystery interrogation game - where you can ask the suspects literally ANYTHING! Dive into a macabre conspiracy of burgers and billionaires, getting up-close and personal with an eccentric cast of cold-blooded killers - using voice or keyboard.

apps.name: Dead On Your Six
apps.short_description: The brief calls you an exterminator, but the locals see room service. Dead On Your Six is a co-op survival FPS for 1–6 players. Fight through waves of infected, keep your friends on their feet, and watch your six.

apps.name: DeadCast
apps.short_description: DeadCast is a first-person psychological horror game with unique maps, objectives, and threats. Play solo or with up to three players, cooperate to survive—or deceive, betray, and sabotage each other. Trust no one, because the greatest danger may be hiding beside you.

apps.name: Deadly Match
apps.short_description: Deadly Match is a single‑player third‑person murder mystery. Investigate the deaths of two young women in a small, seemingly peaceful town.

apps.name: Deep Panic
apps.short_description: An online co-op underwater horror game with up to 4 players. Pilot a submarine, explore the open ocean and descend into the depths while you fight monstrous threats and scavange its treasures.

apps.name: Den: A Short Horror Story
apps.short_description: Den is a short survival horror, where you rent a small cabin for a weekend getaway, deep inside the woods, hoping to escape reality and find joy in life.

apps.name: Dent & Paint: Body Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: Run your own body shop and fix cars by hand. Inspect, quote and win the job, then strip, cut out rot, weld, fill, sand, mask, mix and spray the paint, polish and wash. Deliver on time, earn good reviews and work your way up from apprentice to foreman.

apps.name: Desktop Pecks
apps.short_description: You are procrastinating, and your birds voice their opinions! An idle bird game that chills on your screen - grow a flock on a floating island, feed them, collect every species, and get roasted while you work!

apps.name: Desperatea
apps.short_description: A dish-pushing, liquid-pouring puzzle game all about a strange substance known as 'tea'.

apps.name: DET-33
apps.short_description: A bullet-heaven roguelite in the ruins of new London. Take contracts from four warring factions, build a gun that breaks the game, and reach the evac before the city closes over you. 700+ weapons, interlocking build engines, and a fresh map every run.

apps.name: DIAMOND OFFICE: BASEBALL GM
apps.short_description: Become the general manager of a baseball club in this management simulation. Make decisions on player signings, trades, free-agent contracts, lineups, and team finances. Compete in a challenging league and build a legendary franchise with your own baseball philosophy.

apps.name: Dicekin: Monster Tamer
apps.short_description: The companion that turns your next battle around might still be inside an egg—hatch your team, brave dice-driven turn-based battles, and journey from sunlit shores to snowy wilds and distant star realms.

apps.name: Die Hand Gottes
apps.short_description: Humanity asked AI to cure disease. It rewrote us. A survival thriller JRPG with cinematic fixed cameras, tactical gunplay and supernatural powers. Customize your weapons, shape your Gifts, and fight through biotech horror toward the tower where it all began in a retro late '90s gameplay experience.

apps.name: DIGGING NERA
apps.short_description: Explore an abandoned mining complex, dig through rock, gather resources and upgrade your equipment. Venture ever deeper into NERA, follow the traces left behind, and try to uncover what really happened beneath the surface.

apps.name: DIMENSIONAL PURSUIT
apps.short_description: Make your way through complex futuristic puzzles! Manipulate portals, redirect reflective lasers and dodge an army of hostile robots to find the exit.

apps.name: Directive 220
apps.short_description: A dystopian management game where you act as an energy dispatcher in a collapsing regime. Allocate power, make tough decisions, and balance stability, government pressure, and citizen survival in a dark retro-futuristic world.

apps.name: DITY: Origins
apps.short_description: Autumn 1974. A cleaner from a forest parish is sent into town to buy soap. He speaks a language in which “don’t worry, I won’t help you” means yes — and the town hears no, every time. Several endings, an open world.

apps.name: Dock 7
apps.short_description: A cozy shipbreaking game about peeling wrecks apart with a laser, one layer at a time, and bringing home what's left inside. No timers, no debt, no game over. Put the radio on, cut at your own pace, and fill your little dock with the things you find and the people you rescue.

apps.name: Don't break the Egg
apps.short_description: Hop, dodge, kick and whatever you do, don't crack! Don't Break the Egg is a chaotic sack race game for up to 4 players where perfect timing is the difference between victory and disaster.

apps.name: Doodles Quiz Game
apps.short_description: Doodles Quiz Game is a difficult rage inducing game, your goal is to complete Doodles stupid quiz while many characters try and screw you over, will you beat Doodles Quiz, or will the characters catch you before its too later, find out in Doodles Quiz Game!

apps.name: Double Whammy
apps.short_description: Run a guitar shop by day. Smash monsters by night. 🎸

apps.name: Downfall - A Slay the Spire Fan Expansion
apps.short_description: A FREE complete expansion for Slay the Spire, made by the modding community. Features one brand new normal character, plus a new game mode with SEVEN fully complete new characters starring in a twisted campaign, and so much more.

apps.name: Draco Disease
apps.short_description: A medieval adventure-strategy game where you fight dragons and waves of zombies using fast-paced combat and flashy magic, while commanding troops to defend the kingdom.

apps.name: Dragonaute
apps.short_description: A fantasy flight action game where you are the dragon. Launch from cliffs, dive between hundreds of floating islands, race your ghost for Steam leaderboard records and set entire fleets ablaze with your fire breath, solo or with up to four players in online co-op.

apps.name: Dravora
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy narrative roguelite about three lives on one hard road: a fallen mercenary, an oath-singer's apprentice, and the youngest of three fen brothers. No combat screens. Every choice is made in words, and every choice follows you down the road.

apps.name: DREADSHELL
apps.short_description: DREADSHELL is a first-person sci-fi horror game, built on quiet tension and paranoia instead of constant jump scares.

apps.name: Drift Wreck: Online Racing
apps.short_description: Drift, boost and battle to the finish in fast-paced arcade racing. Bend bodywork, shed panels and survive spectacular crashes. Collect and tune your cars, discover shortcuts and race online against players on PC and Android.

apps.name: Drift: Beyond Grip
apps.short_description: A top-down arcade drift game. Flick into slides, link corners into massive combos and chase medals across neon cities, snowy passes and desert canyons. Customize your car with 230+ parts, beat daily challenges, or cruise a living city in the Chill Zone.

apps.name: DROPANIC
apps.short_description: Two falling-piece puzzles. One controller. Can you play both at once? Move, rotate and drop across every board together. Clear block lines and chain jewels, then take on up to four boards in this single-player puzzle challenge.

apps.name: Dugout Dice
apps.short_description:
Step up to the plate in Dugout Dice, where classic dice combos meet roguelike baseball strategy!

Roll Full Houses and Four-of-a-Kinds to drive in runs, conquer innings, and build unstoppable synergy with fan boosts and careful strategy on your journey to beat the odds and win the World Series.

apps.name: Dungeon Tourists
apps.short_description: Explore procedurally generated dungeons with up to 4 tourists. Take photos of the curiosities you come across. Throw stuff at them, unlock new floors, get rewards, and complete your collection!

apps.name: Dungeon Weaver
apps.short_description: Build your dungeon, create unique bosses with their own spells, and position your minions against invading adventurers!

apps.name: Dungeons of Chesslore
apps.short_description: Mastering your skills at Chess has never been easier or more fun.  Earn gold by challenging yourself in both full games of chess against 20 different NPC opponents, each with their own personalities & quirks, or in 150+ puzzles.  Take your gold and wager it online or in an intense dungeon adventure!

apps.name: Dungeum
apps.short_description: A classic top-down MMORPG of gold, caves and old wars. Hunt with friends, bring down world bosses with the whole server, fight 30-against-30 sieges, sail between islands, master a craft and make a house your own, all in one living world.

apps.name: Dust to Life
apps.short_description: Everything alive was once dust. Here you get to prove it, two ways. Be the matter and climb from a single particle all the way to life, where every stage brings a new way to play. Or be the force against it: your cursor is the weapon, and the whole tide of evolution is coming.

apps.name: Dust Vein
apps.short_description:
A co-op horror game for 1-4 players set in the dead underground bunkers of Earth.
Collect loot, fulfill the quota, feed the living reactor, and descend deeper and deeper into the mines.

apps.name: DUSTY CANVAS: Restore the Masterpiece
apps.short_description: DUSTY CANVAS is a meditative game about restoring genuine works of art. Clean and restore paintings, unlock new tools, and discover interesting facts about masterpieces and their artists.

apps.name: DWARKA
apps.short_description: Dive beneath the waves in DWARKA, a first-person underwater exploration adventure in development. Prepare your gear, sail aboard SAMUDRA, manage oxygen, and investigate ocean mysteries. The full game is planned for solo play and online co-op for up to four players.

apps.name: DWARRF: A Pinball Roguelike
apps.short_description:
Grab your balls and set sail on your 'pirate' minecart into the depths of the mines.
Fight enemies in a unique blend of Pinball & Pachinko, with turn-based combat whilst collecting game altering balls, relics, & runes that ensure no two runs are alike.

apps.name: Dying Hope
apps.short_description: Dying Hope is a space marine RTS centered around base building and survival. Set in a post apocalyptic future you command a cohort of humanity's remaining military personnel designated as Earth's final hope on an alien outpost planet.

apps.name: Dynamic Breach
apps.short_description: Top-down tactical shooter, military and gothic, necro-technological horror. Requiem: a solo campaign of 33 operations across 6 acts, on hand-made maps. An AI squad to command, 7 classes, 41 weapons. Onslaught: horde mode, a boss every 5 waves. All modes play against bots, offline.

apps.name: ECHIDNA
apps.short_description: A dead god drifts in the dark. Build a salvage fleet that carves it apart cell by cell, and watch a colossal carcass melt into a storm of flying debris and climbing numbers. Strip it to the bone then evolve and start again on something bigger.

apps.name: Echo Walker: Tactics
apps.short_description: Lead the last survivors across a broken Earth - and turn the train that carries them into a home that grows after every battle. Every attack shows its odds first, on a grid you can read in a glance. A full 5-chapter campaign; Chapter 1 is a free demo with a save that carries over.

apps.name: Edge of Madness
apps.short_description: Edge of Madness is a Lovecraftian RPG with tactical card-based combat. Explore the grounds around the Marsh Estate, find equipment, combat cards, and combine them with character skills. Find a way to defeat your enemies without losing your sanity.

apps.name: Egg Harvest
apps.short_description: Egg Harvest is a roguelike farming game where you try to save your farm from debt. Produce eggs with your chickens, complete contracts, choose powerful upgrades, and fill your egg catalog. Keep producing until your debt is paid off!

apps.name: Elven Age
apps.short_description: An old-school isometric MMORPG with no classes: the weapon in your hand decides what you can do. Train your skills by using them, hunt a hand-crafted world, and risk it all — die and you drop your entire inventory. Party up, found a guild, buy a house, and earn your place.

apps.name: Ember Citadel
apps.short_description: Build a colony on the ruins of a lost machine age, master black powder and hold the walls. Somewhere out there, the Citadel is looking for you. Hold out alone or with friends in online co-op.

apps.name: Empire Origin:Rise
apps.short_description: The grand strategy game "Empire Origin: Rise" is coming. Explore the traces left by human civilization on the earth, pursue the great achievements of the kings in the historical fragments, and revive the brilliant civilization in history. glory? territory? Waiting for you to dominate the world!

apps.name: Endless Hallway: Asylum
apps.short_description: Endless Hallway: Asylum is a first-person psychological horror anomaly-hunting game set in a haunting psychiatric hospital. Navigate infinite corridors, spot subtle environmental changes, and make critical decisions to break free from the dark time loop

apps.name: Engines of Hate
apps.short_description: You're a mercenary space-ship captain. Drop war machines and infantry from orbit, call down orbital strikes, and micro every unit in slow motion. No base building, no mining, just combat. Every unit you lose costs Credits to replace.

apps.name: Entropy : Zero
apps.short_description: Be the bad guy in this modification for Half-Life 2 : Episode 2 and step into the boots of a stranded Metrocop, left for dead in the abandoned City 10.

apps.name: Entropy : Zero 2
apps.short_description: Bad Cop is back. Command a small army of Combine synths and soldiers on a Northern campaign to capture Dr. Judith Mossman. A modification for Half-Life 2.

apps.name: Era of Shadows
apps.short_description:
Era of Shadows is a tower defense game, blending base building, resource management, talent progression, and exploration. Gather resources, explore and upgrade your base by day. Defend your town from an increasingly deadly waves of monsters by night. 

Can you survive the darkness?

apps.name: Ergo Sum
apps.short_description:
Ergo Sum is a free-to-play pixel art MMORPG with a charming open world.
Play with friends or make new ones, explore a vast array of classes and evolutions, gain admission to an arcane school, and collect rare monster cards.
Grow stronger with each passing day.

apps.name: ETCH
apps.short_description: A fast top-down roguelike maze-runner. You're a PSI-class Runner, the one unit they can't capture. Slip into a Tracer-held sector, bring its cores online, and take it back before they close in.

apps.name: Everybody Hates You in TOKYO
apps.short_description: Tokyo, 1999. Everyone wants you dead. Fight back in a fast, bloody, darkly comedic retro FPS packed with relentless enemy hordes, ridiculous firepower, permanent upgrades, and 16 increasingly nightmarish arenas. No friends. No mercy. Just another day in Tokyo.

apps.name: Evict Me Gently, Darling
apps.short_description: An adult romance visual novel set in scorching late-September Madrid. Choose Maite, Clemency, or Saara as Iker faces a viral eviction scandal, public outrage, and an irreversible route with its own crisis and ending.

apps.name: EvoMon World
apps.short_description: Guide player and your monster friend on an journey of discovery, adventure and exploration.

apps.name: Exoplanet Settlers
apps.short_description: A turn-based 4X space strategy game built around deep logistics and open-space movement. Use cosmic geography to your advantage, disrupt enemy supply networks, custom-build your fleets, and construct interconnected planetary complexes to conquer the galaxy.

apps.name: Exorcist Hotline
apps.short_description: The world is full of ghosts. So who you gonna call? The Exorcist Hotline! A multiplayer investigative survival horror puzzle game for up to 4 players. One operator. Three exorcists. And a demon. Work together or die trying.

apps.name: Expedition RAVN-3
apps.short_description: Explore a punishing abandoned mine in search of your missing brother. Establish camp, manage supplies and survive as you desperately search to discover a cure for the corruption that gnaws at you in the darkness.

apps.name: Exploding Delivery Service
apps.short_description: A chaotic co-op delivery game where teamwork is your only chance of survival. Guide a half-blind driver, secure unstable cargo, survive random disasters, and deliver explosive packages before everything goes horribly wrong.

apps.name: Extra Virgin Bedfellows
apps.short_description: Guide master miller Alvaro through a drought-struck olive harvest in this adult romance visual novel. Choose among three routes with Rocio, Jimena, or Nieves, and face the personal costs of debt, rivalry, secrecy, and life in a village under pressure.

apps.name: F Of X
apps.short_description: Embark on a journey through a digital world of functions, solving mathematical puzzles to move platforms and conquer platforming challenges. Test your logic to transcend as the Master of Functions.

apps.name: Fabled Footy
apps.short_description: Fantasy and Turn-based tactics meet soccer in this roguelike adventure. Build your party, cast abilities, and outplay orcs, goblins, slimes, and skeletons on your way to crushing powerful bosses.

apps.name: Fabulous Football
apps.short_description: One button. One more match. Take the pitch in fast, top-down arcade football, bend shots with aftertouch, and build a club worth coming back to. Play a quick match, settle a local rivalry, or take your squad through season after season.

apps.name: Faded Fears - Grayshore Motel
apps.short_description: Ryan Caldwell, out of work for over a year, takes the only job he can get: night desk clerk at the lonely Grayshore Motel on Route 9. His first shift starts tonight. He has no idea what this night has in store for him.

apps.name: FAIL GAMES
apps.short_description: FAIL GAMES is a collection of brutally hard but simple minigames. Beat each game to unlock the next. Earn coins when you fail and spend them on outfits and effects. So easy to learn your grandma could play it, but so hard to master you'll throw your PC out the window. And your grandma.

apps.name: Faintlight Traveler : Whisper
apps.short_description:
A relaxed casual idle RPG.
Gather materials through collecting and combat to craft your gear, take on stronger monsters, and create your own adventure story.

apps.name: Fancy's Monster Girl Beach Jigsaw Puzzle
apps.short_description: A relaxing 18+ jigsaw puzzle game with beautiful art and music where you assemble images of sexy monster girls. Complete 60 puzzles to unlock all the images in the gallery.

apps.name: Fantasy Siege
apps.short_description: In Fantasy Siege, you take control of one of several unique fantasy races. Each race has its own units, heroes, buildings, spells, technologies, and other upgrades that will allow you to defeat your enemies in matches for up to 4 players. The game is an auto-battler.

apps.name: Farm to Fortune
apps.short_description: Turn a tiny plot into a fortune, one seed at a time. Grow crops, sell them in your shop, and reinvest everything you earn. Better tools, more land, richer harvests. Relaxing from the first seed to the last field.

apps.name: Fast Lap Racing
apps.short_description: Take street cars to the track and race against the clock. Upgrade your car's performance and set faster lap times. Chase the perfect lap and fight for positions on the global leaderboards.

apps.name: Feed Fred
apps.short_description: Grow food, smash it into bites, and make Fred absurdly fat. An active incremental game where visitors pay to watch Fred eat. Hire Friends, climb the skill tree, and turn a quiet fairground into a crowded feeding freak show.

apps.name: Fenestra
apps.short_description: A fusion of semi-turn-based battles and roguelike mechanics. Build a party of heroes, explore randomly generated dungeons, discover powerful builds, and encounter strange creatures as you fight your way through the dungeon. Plan ahead and adapt to your surroundings, or meet your inevitable end.

apps.name: First Round Hit - The Long Range Shooting Simulator
apps.short_description: First Round Hit is a long-range shooting simulator focused on range estimation, ballistic reference data, environmental conditions, wind estimation, scope adjustments, and first-round accuracy.

apps.name: First Steps in the NICU 2: Discharge Support Edition
apps.short_description: Join nursing student Yuka in an educational visual novel about helping babies and families move from the NICU to life at home. Explore family rounds, team conferences, and medical-care minigames across six chapters. The sequel to First Steps in the NICU, with Japanese and English text and voices.

apps.name: FIVEFOLD
apps.short_description: Build a party of five by combining jobs, skills, and sub jobs in this turn-based party-building roguelite. With no exploration or traditional level grinding, the focus is on party building and combat. Adapt your formation and skills to each enemy and develop your own strategy to overcome them.

apps.name: Fleshborn
apps.short_description: A short incremental game where you are tasked to clean a lab from fleshy growths using your flamethrower. Collect resources and spend them in a vast upgrade tree to unlock new abilities.

apps.name: Fluff 'N Tumble
apps.short_description: Fluff ‘N Tumble is a one-vs-many online party game for friends who deserve each other. Tackle, hunt, or team up with your friends across a handful of cute, chaotic games. This is a collection of dynamic multiplayer party games, each one changing how one player takes on the rest of the party.

apps.name: Flurst
apps.short_description: Flurst is a fast, strategic card game for solo play against up to five bots or to battle it out with friends. Play matching cards, reset or burn the pile, tune the house rules, and survive your face-up and face-down table cards to empty everything first and get Flurst!

apps.name: Foosball Champs
apps.short_description: Experience the most authentic foosball simulation in VR. Bring the table directly into your room and face off against friends in lag-free and cross-platform multiplayer.

apps.name: Football Temptations
apps.short_description: Step into the life of James, a rookie football player balancing the pressure of the American Football League with romance and temptation. Make choices that shape his career and love life — can you win the Bowl and find a girlfriend by season’s end?

apps.name: Footy Bash
apps.short_description: Step into the world of Footy Bash,  Experience the rush of fast-paced football with 1-4 players. Unleash spectacular speckys to leave your opponents in awe and land devastating hits to thrill your fans. With dynamic gameplay and a classic look, Footy Bash is an electrifying footy spectacle.

apps.name: Fortress Forever
apps.short_description: Fortress Forever is a Source mod inspired by the earlier versions of the Team Fortress series (Team Fortress Classic and QuakeWorld Team Fortress).

apps.name: Fox Flare Night
apps.short_description:
Shape-shifting Kitsune Mio battles the mischievous Tanuki army in this fast-paced, comedic side-scrolling shooter!
Unleash powerful yōjutsu and transformations to dodge bullet barrages.
Packed with modes for both casual and hardcore players, offering plenty of content to master!

apps.name: FPV Stuff
apps.short_description: An FPV drone sim for new and experienced pilots. Pick a stock drone or build your own from about a hundred parts, tune it in a Betaflight-style configurator, fly a field, a bando and a race track, and watch every flight back.

apps.name: Franchise Hockey Manager 13
apps.short_description: Franchise Hockey Manager returns for the 2026-27 season with plenty of additions to the deepest, most authentic hockey strategy gaming experience you can find.  Choose from teams around the globe and select a team to guide to glory, including a chance at the ultimate prize, the Stanley Cup®.

apps.name: Front Page
apps.short_description:
As Editor of an independent newspaper, you are in charge of printing daily front pages. You decide which story you want to publish, and see the world change depending on your choices and actions. 
What kind of Editor will you become?

apps.name: Full Service Resort
apps.short_description: Take charge of a struggling seaside resort in an adult visual novel blending romance, erotic encounters, and management. Meet eleven women, build relationships, and balance dates with daily challenges as you bring the Grand Paradise back to life.

apps.name: Futurika Online
apps.short_description: Futurika Online is a free-to-play, pixel art cyberpunk MMORPG with real-time combat and story-driven progression. Play for free!

apps.name: G.A.A.R.L - Gabe's Action Arcade Roguelike
apps.short_description: GAARL! is a difficult roguelike action platformer. Wield your chain gun to fight monsters in tense combat, or fire it into walls to climb through handcrafted arenas. Buy upgrades, create wacky builds, get good health insurance, and unlock the mysteries of GABE'S ACTION ARCADE ROGUELIKE!

apps.name: Galactic Bounty
apps.short_description: Play as a droid bounty hunter for hire. Accept contracts, deploy into dangerous locations, eliminate targets, break into secure systems, and get paid. Spend your rewards on weapons, gear and software upgrades for your droid.

apps.name: Galaxy Unwritten
apps.short_description: Pilot your own ship in a single-player space sandbox. Fight, trade, mine and salvage, then turn your earnings into a fleet and modular factories. Fine-tune your ship's loadout, board enemy vessels and create local mods with built-in visual tools.

apps.name: Gambitfall
apps.short_description: A chess roguelike deckbuilder where the tactics you already know are the score. Place your pieces, land forks, pins and skewers, stack Relics and multipliers until the numbers explode, and outwit Masters who each break one rule of chess.

apps.name: Gasoline
apps.short_description: Gasoline is ferentic & bloody --boomer shooter-- inspired by 90s classics.

apps.name: Gatto's Pizzeria
apps.short_description: Run a cozy first-person pizzeria as an adorable cat! Prepare authentic Neapolitan pizzas step by step, serve hungry human customers, and upgrade your restaurant with new recipes, ovens, and decorations while relaxing in a hand-drawn 3D kitchen.

apps.name: Gear Up Einstein!
apps.short_description: A strategic roguelite auto-battler for 1-3 players. Travel through time, recruit historical figures, and gear them up with badass equipment for ridiculous combos. Master tactical missions solo or with friends. Ready to save the world?

apps.name: Ghost Girl Requiem
apps.short_description: Play as Haruhiko, a young man who can hear ghosts, in a five-chapter supernatural adventure. Search rooms, uncover clues through conversation, show or combine items, and fight spirits with paper talismans. The choices you make in each chapter shape the story's final ending.

apps.name: Ghost Haunting
apps.short_description: A classic 2D point-and-click adventure in glorious low resolution! Puzzle yourself through a world full of ghosts, monsters and pixelated mischief to rescue Gigi's grandmother from the realm of the dead. A heartwarming story about growing up, death, and how the two are connected…

apps.name: Gliding Together
apps.short_description: Hang-glide from the summit to the landing field across 15 hand-crafted worlds. Lean to steer, dive for speed, thread rings to build your streak and slip past canyon walls, cable cars and laser gates. Chase your best run solo, or race up to three friends online.

apps.name: Glimtide
apps.short_description: A tiny island of jelly creatures that lives on its own, for everyone at once. Glims eat, sleep, fall in love, build villages and pass their skills to their babies. Watch them, bring a treat, adopt a favourite, design your own species, or drop a banana peel.

apps.name: Gloamfall
apps.short_description: A pixel-art dark-fantasy roguelike with twin-stick combat and action-RPG loot. Descend through 7 acts and 14 biomes, topple 15 lords, roll a new arsenal every run and forge the armor you keep. Six heroes, 70 weapons and two paths to choose from after every act.

apps.name: Gods of the Grid
apps.short_description: Fight your way up Olympus in a match-3 roguelite. Match runes to strike and heal, cast spells and claim relics, and find the weakness every foe is hiding. Nine realms, seven demigods, one life per run.

apps.name: Got More?
apps.short_description: Fight monster hordes in a bullet heaven roguelite with automatic attacks, weapon evolutions and 18 bosses. Mix guns, melee weapons and skills, unlock companions, and upgrade your gear between runs to take on the next chapter.

apps.name: Grave Rounds
apps.short_description: Miss shooting zombies? Here you go! A round-based zombie shooter for one player, in a boarded-up graveyard house and a snowbound village in 1944. The dead come in rounds, more of them each time. Buy guns off the walls, find the power, spin the Lucky Wheel, and see how long you can hold out.

apps.name: GreeDrill
apps.short_description: You owe the Company $2,000,000. Pay it back in ore. A push-your-luck mining roguelike: drill deeper for a bigger payout, surface before the hull cracks, outrun the Bailiff and face the five Guardians of the deep.

apps.name: Grey Heritage: Counter Gambit
apps.short_description: Grey Heritage: Counter Gambit is the grand finale to the tactical RPG trilogy. Command a massive cast of returning heroes in the series’ most strategic entry yet. Master evolved turn-based combat, guide your army through tactical challenges, and witness the conclusion to every character's story.

apps.name: GRID DEFENSE: GRID WAR
apps.short_description: Build towers, unleash ultimates and command six heroes in sci-fi tower defense. Play all 100 Scenario stages free. Try one-minute highlights of Basic and GRID COMMAND before purchase, then take your aerial fleet into GRID COMMAND's survival battles.

apps.name: Gridiron Football GM
apps.short_description: Take over a fictional pro football team as its head coach and turn it into a dynasty. Set the game plan, call the plays, manage the cap, make trades, sign free agents and draft from a 130-program college league simulated alongside the pros.

apps.name: Grindwick
apps.short_description: Grindwick is a free-to-play 2D online action RPG built around the grind. Choose an expedition, hunt monsters, find better gear, and grow stronger through combat skills and a passive tree. Play solo or in a party of four. No quests, just the next hunt.

apps.name: GRIP 2: Combat Racing Evolved
apps.short_description: Sequel to GRIP and the spiritual successor to Rollcage, GRIP 2 is a fast and futuristic combat racing game with rocket-powered, flippable vehicles. Race with unique movement tech and use powerful weapons and abilities to beat your opponents to the finish line.

apps.name: Grocery Store Simulator: Prologue
apps.short_description: Manage a grocery store in Grocery Store Simulator: Prologue. This free version includes all the gameplay elements of the full version, with progression available but limited. Enjoy a comprehensive taste of the full game with some limitations on progression.

apps.name: GuildBound
apps.short_description: A cozy idle guild manager that lives on your desktop. Recruit heroes, send them on quests and contracts, gear up at the vendors, and rally the whole guild for raids. Your guild keeps working while you do, and the loot is waiting when you look back.

apps.name: Gunship Origins
apps.short_description: Fly combat helicopters solo or co-op multiplayer in the AH-64 Apache, OH-58 Kiowa Warrior, and UH-60 Blackhawk. Dynamic missions including search and destroy, rescue, and more. Pilot progression: get promoted and earn awards. Windows, Mac, Linux, and Steam Deck support.

apps.name: Hack 42: Typing Incremental
apps.short_description: Hack 42 is a short typing incremental game about crafting powerful hacks and smashing computers for fun and profit.

apps.name: Hack it Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build software, hire and train a skilled team, research new features, and grow your startup in Hack It Tycoon a management sim where every project, payroll decision, and loan deadline matters.

apps.name: HALASKÂRGAZİ
apps.short_description: Istanbul, 1918. The capital is occupied, and the resistance works in the shadows. Found a secret society, recruit agents, decode telegraph ciphers, and smuggle supplies to Anatolia in a historical espionage strategy game.

apps.name: Half-Life 2 RTX
apps.short_description: Re-live the groundbreaking, critically acclaimed Half-Life 2 like never before, reimagined with RTX Remix. Featuring full ray tracing, remastered assets, and DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation, this DLC is free for Half-Life 2 owners.

apps.name: Half-Life 2: DownFall
apps.short_description:
DownFall is a Half-Life 2 single-player mod taking place in the White Forest surroundings.
You're once more putting on the HEV suit as Gordon Freeman. Your mission is to recover a newly developed technology by the resistance, known as the "citadel buster", before the Combine manage to destroy it.

apps.name: Half-Life 2: VR Mod
apps.short_description: Half Life 2: VR Mod is a fan-made project, which adds full Virtual Reality support to the original 2004 PC gaming classic by Valve Software. Are you ready to become the Freeman?

apps.name: Half-Life 2: Year Long Alarm
apps.short_description: Year Long Alarm is a Half-Life 2 single-player mod that is set in an abandoned mine outside of City 17. A Scanner has discovered you, and the Combine are closing in on your position. Fight your way through a vast underground mine to try and meet up with the Resistance members of Station 12.

apps.name: Half-Life: MMod
apps.short_description: Half-Life 1: MMod is a free, fan made modification for Half-Life aiming to refine player's arsenal and further expand player's combat options. Featuring AI tweaks, VFX and SFX overhaul in spirit of original, additional weapon functionality and bug fixes, while keeping most changes optional.

apps.name: Harappa
apps.short_description: A classic city-builder in the spirit of Pharaoh and Caesar III, set in the ancient Indus Valley. Lay out grid streets and drains, ride out the yearly floods, set up workshops and trade, raise great monuments, and grow a reed-hut village into a thriving brick city.

apps.name: Harem of Lies
apps.short_description: She's hoping you'll banish the wrong woman. How sweet. Unveil 30 adult anime characters in a single-player deduction roguelike, expose disguised succubi, and unlock their stories. Every Court can be won by reasoning alone. No forced guesses.

apps.name: Hawker
apps.short_description: HAWKER is a Roguelite Action-RPG where you must pay or evade a debt to Death in a procedurally-generated grimdark world. Scavenge, barter and fight for ichor, life, and truth. Thirty days, an impossible debt. Pay, or Fall.

apps.name: Heal Me Faster
apps.short_description: You're the healer in a pixel-art incremental RPG where your company fights and your healing choices matter. Manage mana, shield a marked ally and recruit from twenty-one classes. Between battles, grow a working camp, shop and town. They charge. You keep them standing.

apps.name: Heart Abyss
apps.short_description: Heart Abyss is a brutal action-platformer inspired by Japan during the 17th and 18th centuries. Wake up your inner beast and take vengeance on those who put a collar around your neck. Find your sister and uncover the mystery behind the disappearance of all jinkos.

apps.name: Helbreath Mystic Tavern Classic
apps.short_description: Rise, level up, and arm yourself for an endless war between two rival nations. Choose your allegiance and carve a path of destruction through your enemies in this reimagined and customized world of Helbreath.

apps.name: Helio-3 The Lab
apps.short_description: Helio-3, a hypnotic incremental game combining idle, merge, and physics-based gameplay. Inject, collide, split, and fuse atoms to discover new elements, earn energy, unlock powerful upgrades, and prestige your way through an evolving quantum laboratory.

apps.name: Heliobane
apps.short_description: Fly the sun-killer gunship Heliobane against a hive that eats stars, in an Amiga-style vertical shoot 'em up. Strip guns off the dead, buy the rest from a trader who calls you kiddo, and break fifteen screen-filling Heralds across three worlds.

apps.name: Hello Doctor
apps.short_description: The worst ambulance company in town is hiring. Answer the phone, rush to the patient and get them to the hospital alive: one drives, one navigates, two in the back keep them breathing. Online co-op for up to 4, real physics, rowdy patients.

apps.name: Hentai Clicker: Iris is streaming
apps.short_description: Click, collect hearts, and upgrade your way through Iris’s naughty alchemist stream. Unlock outfits, scenes, voice reactions, and seductive progression in Hentai clicker: Iris is streaming.

apps.name: Hentai Clicker: Maya is streaming
apps.short_description: Hentai clicker: Maya is streaming — Click, collect hearts, and upgrade your way through Maya’s teasing stream. Unlock outfits, scenes, voice reactions, and playful progression with one very naughty mechanic.

apps.name: Hentai Clicker: Seraphina is streaming
apps.short_description: Click, collect hearts, and progress with Seraphina, a very naughty angel streamer. Unlock scenes, outfits, upgrades, and voice reactions in Hentai clicker: Seraphina is streaming.

apps.name: Hentai Puzzle: Kristina
apps.short_description: Hentai Puzzle: Kristina: Solve playful adult anime puzzles with Kristina, a very naughty Mrs. Claus. Progress through challenges, unlock images and scenes, and enjoy a festive, seductive puzzle experience.

apps.name: Heptic Arena
apps.short_description: Squad up, hunt monsters, and crush the competition! Chase fame and fortune in Heptic Arena - the galaxy’s deadliest game show where infamy is power and ratings are king. Step into the spotlight and make them watch!

apps.name: HeroQuest: Digital Edition
apps.short_description: Descend into the dungeon to destroy the forces of Dread and protect the Realm in this tactical turn-based RPG based on the timeless tabletop legacy. Form a fellowship of four or set forth on your adventure solo, roll the dice and let the quest begin!

apps.name: Hex Seculum
apps.short_description: Explore a perilous hex map, delve into tense dungeons where time and torchlight run out, and fight turn-based battles where distance and positioning decide survival. Plan your expedition, manage supplies, and escape with treasure.

apps.name: Hey, Don't Look at Me
apps.short_description: You moved into your late grandmother's apartment to sort through her belongings and start a new life. On your very first night, a light appears in the window of the abandoned house across the street... someone is there.

apps.name: Hidden Object World
apps.short_description: Hidden Object World is a classic, pure hidden-object game focused entirely on the joy of finding hidden items. Explore beautifully detailed scenes at your own pace and enjoy a peaceful, relaxing experience.

apps.name: Hidden Raccoons in Winter
apps.short_description: Hidden Raccoons in Winter is a cozy pixel art hidden object game! Search for adorable raccoons hidden across handcrafted winter landscapes. Relax, take your time, and find them all!

apps.name: Hide or Seek: Container Island
apps.short_description: Hide or Seek: Container Island is COOP, PVP or solo game where you can hide as a cat or seek as a dog. While hiding, you have to hide through multiple areas in Container Island using magic potions from Dhugs, while evading creatures. While seeking, you have to capture all cats.

apps.name: Hisako and Shyla
apps.short_description: Take Shyla & Hisako on a sword-swinging, spell-casting adventure in this oriental metroidvania-inspired H-game.

apps.name: HitTube
apps.short_description: HitTube is a 1-4 player horror streamer shooter. The zombie apocalypse is here and now you're a streamer who kills live for donations. Your weapon is a minigun and your minigun is your best friend!

apps.name: Hold My Cargo
apps.short_description: A first-person smuggling sim, solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Carry every crate, hide contraband in your ship, and bluff or bribe customs. Trade up to a bigger freighter while your crew keeps the officer busy and the evidence out of sight.

apps.name: Hold The Levee
apps.short_description:
Dig trenches, raise levees, stack sandbags and build dams, then watch what the water does. Hold the Levee is a game
about real water physics: seepage, undermined walls, flood waves, ice jams and 24 missions, from defending a town
to flooding villages guarded by the AI.

apps.name: Hole Punch Cocktail
apps.short_description:
"Drink. Kill. Drink. Kill." 

Enter the dream of Ms. Hangover, a young office worker with a slight alcohol dependency, fight against a twisted reality, and successfully finish your daily routine.

apps.name: Hollow Card
apps.short_description: Every choice becomes a card. Every card can change the story. Explore the frozen town of Stillwater, defeat your enemies, and decide who gets to walk away. A dark narrative deckbuilder.

apps.name: HoloCozy
apps.short_description: HoloCozy is a cozy idle desktop companion where you can spend relaxing time with hololive talents in their rooms. Enjoy music and ambient sounds, keep your favorite characters close, and watch them grow at your own pace while you work, study, or unwind.

apps.name: Home:Ward
apps.short_description: A hand-drawn first-person horror game where sound is warning, light is a risk, and the shortest path is rarely the  safest... It is 1907. You wake with no name, a spear in your hand, and a torch that barely holds back the dark. The way out is somewhere below...

apps.name: Hook & Loot
apps.short_description: Hook & Loot is a relaxing single-player magnet fishing game. Clear an autumn lake of 1,458 metal objects. Haul in scrap and rare finds, bring your catches to the scrapyard, and upgrade your gear.

apps.name: Hoosegow: Prison Survival
apps.short_description: A dark comedy about life behind bars. A random convict, a random charge, a random sentence. One goal: survive at any cost. Every decision opens new paths, or leads to death.

apps.name: Horror Mahjong
apps.short_description: Expect the unexpected. Play mahjong with friends in a haunted tea house. Draw, pong, kong, and win—then get up and watch their backs. Grab supplies, fight, and revive your friends until dawn. Or spend the night with computer tablemates.

apps.name: Horse Thieves
apps.short_description: Babandan kalan bara el koydular! Yıkık bir meyhaneden başla; içki üretip sat, avlan, balık tut ve kumar oyna. 4 arkadaşın ile barını büyüt, Vahşi Batı'nın belalı tipleriyle uğraş ve düelloya çıkıp hakkın olanı geri al. Birinci şahıs, komik bir bar işletme macerası!

apps.name: Hotel Is Hungry
apps.short_description: The world ended. You got a hotel job. Check guests in, serve their orders, keep them away from killers, and decide who the hotel eats. A horror hotel management game.

apps.name: How Deep
apps.short_description: A co-op extraction mining game for 1-4 players. Ride the elevator down into procedurally generated caves, dig up treasure, fight off what lurks in the dark, then decide whether to head back to the surface or risk going deeper.

apps.name: Hrolfr VS Evil Skulls
apps.short_description: "Hrolfr VS Evil Skulls" is a 2D third-person action RPG, where you as a mighty warrior Hrolfr the Walker fight evil creatures in a dark fantasy world inspired by Estonian folklore, Cthulhu Mythos and old-school sword&sorcery B-movies. Save the world, fight Evil Skulls, rescue the princess!

apps.name: Huex
apps.short_description: A hex-grid line puzzle. Drag lines across the board until every hex is covered. Play a new puzzle every day, work through the stages, or build your own and share it with friends. Simple rules, challenging puzzles.

apps.name: Humanity Box
apps.short_description: Become a god and wield divine power over a miniature, realistic world. Set fires, call rain, unleash disasters, and bless or curse your people. Then watch tribes grow into nations and fight wars on their own.

apps.name: Humanless
apps.short_description: Play as a super skilled combatant, with superhuman speed and agility. Fight against merciless demons, while dashing and jumping to dodge evil traps through carefully designed levels.

apps.name: Hunting Contract
apps.short_description: A co-op horror game for 1–4 players about hunting monsters to meet a company's quota. Kill the beast, seal it in a coffin and drag it back to the truck—while your friends scream in proximity voice chat.

apps.name: HUNTING PIXEL
apps.short_description: Hunting Pixel is a reverse bullet-hell incremental game. Hunt swarms of pixel monsters, load them into the crusher to generate pixel resources, and level up! Unlock over a hundred combat modules and stack their powers to conquer every hunting ground!

apps.name: HYPERyuki: Snowboard Syndicate
apps.short_description: Race, trick, and explore across vibrant slopes with a cast of unique riders. Master speed, style, and control in this fast-paced arcade snowboarder. Prove it where it counts, split-screen with friends or head-to-head online multiplayer. Shred the mountain. Rip the competition.

apps.name: HypnoX: Steel Riders
apps.short_description: An arcade racing action game where you'll face challenging tracks, dangerous obstacles, and a race against time. Ride different motorcycles, fight bosses, use weapons, powerups and overcome crazy challenges.

apps.name: Icy Tower
apps.short_description: The legendary jumping game is back! Join Harold the Homeboy and friends as they jump up the Icy Tower. Make combo jumps to build up massive scores.  How high can you get?

apps.name: In Orbita
apps.short_description: A funny, bittersweet point & click adventure: explore your parents' house on an ordinary Sunday and the cartoons of the 80s, collect and combine items, solve puzzles and choose what to say, even when the sincere words just won't come out

apps.name: In Silent Walls: Origines
apps.short_description: In Silent Walls: Origins is a narrative psychological horror game where you investigate an abandoned mansion through disturbing visions and mysterious objects linked to the past.

apps.name: Infernal Foundations
apps.short_description: Command Hell's horde in a colony-building sandbox. Reshape a voxel world, gather physical resources, build your infernal stronghold block by block, create production chains, and defend Hell’s newest territory from the forces of mankind.

apps.name: Infinite Night 2
apps.short_description: Stand your ground as Kael in a single-player dark fantasy action RPG. Evade the surrounding horde, turn gear and orbs into a focused build, choose mastery nodes, and break through to each boss.

apps.name: Infinite Supermarket
apps.short_description: Infinite Supermarket is an online co-op survival roguelike with physics-driven chaos, proximity voice chat and character roles. You and up to 7 friends must find the exit - and keep yourselves fed on the way.

apps.name: Intergalactic Burger Joint
apps.short_description: Turn falling ingredients into a dinner rush. Match four, set up cascades, and serve hungry customers across six space restaurants. Work through 120 campaign orders, unlock a crew of chefs, or see how long you can keep the kitchen running in Endless.

apps.name: InternetCafe98
apps.short_description: Start with one trash PC and build a packed 1998 internet cafe. Serve customers, upgrade your hardware and network, and research new tech in this retro incremental tycoon.

apps.name: IRON GUARD: Day Zero
apps.short_description: A sci-fi tower defense in the spirit of classic RTS games. Fly an armed drone over alien battlefields, build and upgrade turrets, unleash superweapons and find out why the terraformer robots rebelled — before your crew is lost on an unknown planet.

apps.name: Iron Maw
apps.short_description: Command the Iron Maw, an armored war train, against the Meridian Iron & Ordnance Company's Legions. Build a devastating convoy, crush colossal war machines, and defend the ten free cities that refuse to kneel.

apps.name: Iron Stride
apps.short_description: A top-down roguelite where you pilot a war titan through armies of thousands. Crush infantry underfoot, duel enemy titans, bolt salvaged guns and relics onto your machine and fight your way across the sector to the tyrant at the end.

apps.name: Ironclad
apps.short_description: A co-op horror game where you and a small crew pilot tanks to eradicate the monster infestation plaguing the world. Work together and harness ancient technology to end the scourge once and for all.

apps.name: It's A Flop
apps.short_description: Fish Flopping physics meet party-game chaos! Flop out-of-water across many zany game modes. Customize your aquatic fighter, team up with up to 8 friends locally or online, and flop your way to victory.

apps.name: Jester's Dungeon
apps.short_description: An Obscure Dungeon Crawler where you a wizard, Dives into a dungeon to reclaim your stolen Relic from a wicked Jester.  Sacrifice your blood to the Black Eye and  use it's powers to survive, slay monsters and master the dungeon.

apps.name: Jigsaw Puzzles Complete
apps.short_description: Piece together cozy places, beautiful paintings and your own photos. Fill optional story and travel albums, or choose any picture and puzzle at your own pace. Play solo, with friends online, or across your Windows desktop.

apps.name: Juicicora
apps.short_description: A cozy co-op adventure where you play a Soul, a small glossy slime. Explore a hand-painted world with up to four friends, dash and wall-jump through sky temples, mix fruit powerups at the alchemy table, and win over the villagers who live there.

apps.name: JumpBald
apps.short_description: A metroidvania full of bald guys? Reach the top of the tower with pixel-perfect jumps, collecting weapons that let you unlock the map. Be careful! every mistake can send you, literally, back to the beginning. Only then will you be able to take revenge on the one who mocked you and your alopecia...

apps.name: Junk Tower Together
apps.short_description: What are friends for if not to build a tower out of junk together... In Junk Tower Together, take turns stacking the most ridiculous objects, balance on the brink of disaster, and build a crazy tower with a group of up to 8 players.

apps.name: Just Keep Defending And Mining
apps.short_description: Just Keep Defending And Mining is a unique incremental game that combines combat and resource gathering. Balance mining and survival, invest into upgrades, grow stronger every round, unlock new regions, and Just Keep Defending and Mining.

apps.name: Kaiju Ace
apps.short_description: Pilot fighter jets against colossal kaiju in this combat flight simulator. Fly from the cockpit or chase view, and defend cities and convoys. Purchase aircraft and weapons in a persistent career with generated missions.

apps.name: Kastrava
apps.short_description: Found a kingdom and fight dozens of rival kingdoms for control of the map. Build villages, castles and walled towns, forge alliances, and break walls with trebuchets in a fast medieval strategy game where only one crown survives.

apps.name: KAYF-LIFE: Complete Edition
apps.short_description: A modification for Half-Life 2, which is a parody with an alternative look at the story and different voice acting, made in the manner of amateur Russian film dubbing that was popular in late 90's and early 2000s. It also brings visual overhaul, reworked gameplay, new mechanics and more!

apps.name: Kessrand: The Last Warden
apps.short_description: You are the Last Hero of a kingdom trapped inside a mountain, and the invaders are hunting you. Carve tunnels and set traps between waves, then survive each wave, leading the horde through the killing warren you built.

apps.name: Key Strokes
apps.short_description: AIM, TYPE, and HIT in this top-down golf game where your typing prowess determines your shot.

apps.name: Kick4Two
apps.short_description: Foosball for two. Grab the keyboard or a controller, pick a table and play head-to-head on the same screen, in split screen or over LAN. Real rod physics, a CPU opponent with four levels and five tables.

apps.name: Killer Santa 1990
apps.short_description: Step into a chilling 1990s horror story. After returning to your late grandfather's old house, you uncover missing people, a cursed DVD, and a murderous Santa Claus hunting you down.

apps.name: KINETET
apps.short_description: A falling-block puzzle driven by physics. Adjust your angle and power to launch blocks that roll, tumble, and stack. Connect same-colored blocks from wall to wall to clear them, and compete with players worldwide for the high score on the online leaderboards!

apps.name: King in the Mountain
apps.short_description: A resource management incremental mining game where you rebuild your Mountain Hall. Plan each descent, choose where your dwarves dig, gather gold and rare artifacts, and return home when the torch burns out. Manage production, upgrade your crew, dig deeper, and bring your fallen kingdom back to life

apps.name: King Me
apps.short_description: King Me is a fast-paced medieval strategy game where every move can shift the crown. Build your forces, outsmart rivals, unleash powerful cards, and survive unpredictable events as you battle through challenging levels for glory.

apps.name: Kingsreach
apps.short_description: Build a living 3D medieval kingdom. Villagers work, eat, trade and sleep through four seasons while goblin raids test your walls. Generate walled cities, play a free sandbox, or command one of four empires in Conquest.

apps.name: Kintsugi Cottage: Cozy Repair
apps.short_description: A cozy 3D jigsaw restoration game. Hundreds of shards lie across a cottage museum floor, and every glaze, curve and pattern is a clue. Work out which pieces belong together, rebuild the artifacts by hand, and restore the full artifact collection.

apps.name: Kwun Tong: The Origin
apps.short_description: My friend is starting a new model shop located in Kwun Tong. But he disappeared since the second day of opening...

apps.name: La Divina Commedia
apps.short_description:
La Divina Commedia is a Dark Fantasy ARPG inspired by the famous masterpiece opera of Dante Alighieri.
The "procedural extraction dungeons generation" system ensures a unique and never repetitive experience.
"Abandon all hope , ye who enter here".
The journey to hell begins!

apps.name: La Sima: The Blind Beacon
apps.short_description: Train 13 skills, craft your gear, and prepare expeditions into a 100-floor chasm. A dark fantasy idle RPG where every descent asks how much you are willing to risk. Grow the town, discover creatures and relics, and seek the light of the Blind Beacon.

apps.name: Lagan Salvage Run
apps.short_description: A co-op roguelike deckbuilder about salvaging sunken ships. Loot cards from flooding rooms, break into sealed holds for better treasure, and pick your route across open water. Every run comes from a seed you can share. Get out while there's still a way back.

apps.name: Last Orcs Standing Tall
apps.short_description: Lead your orc tribe to victory in a turn-based 4X roguelite! Expand your realm, explore a dangerous dark fantasy world, forge powerful equipment, and build mighty warbands. Crush rival orc tribes or be the first to earn enough honor to claim victory.

apps.name: Last Paddle Standing
apps.short_description: Pong meets battle royale. Last Paddle Standing throws up to 12 players into a chaotic arcade arena that shrinks with every elimination, and knocked-out players return as vengeful spirits to sabotage everyone still standing. Short matches. Maximum chaos.

apps.name: Last Stream
apps.short_description: Last Stream is a 1–4 player online co-op horror game. Go live from a haunted house, uncover the memories its ghost left behind and keep your chat watching. But every clue you bring back makes it angrier. Run. Hide. Keep recording.

apps.name: Legato
apps.short_description: A first-person action RPG in the style of King's Field, rendered like a late-90s console game. Veyr's King has not been seen in seven years, and the people of the kingdom are forgetting who they are. Find out why, through dungeons, villages and the sealed gate of the capital.

apps.name: Let's Dye Together
apps.short_description:
Let's Dye Together is a fast-paced 2-4 local/online player party platformer shooter where color is your greatest weapon!
Compete in a series of minigames, blasting platforms to claim them and creating paths only you can traverse. Adapt and survive in order to conquer the ever-changing battlefield.

apps.name: LFG Battles
apps.short_description: Async PVP auto battler where you build a party of heroes and gear them up to fight other players. Craft synergizing combinations as you try to break the game with your build! Dominate the ranked leaderboard or explore absurd combos at your own pace in casual mode.

apps.name: Liani
apps.short_description:
Who is Liani?
Where is Liani?
Every obstacle will test you.
Every step will lead you into the unknown.
Remember, all you have to do to keep moving forward is to never give up.

apps.name: Licensed to Love Airi
apps.short_description: Licensed to Love: Airi is a short adult retro-style visual novel about joining a relationship training agency and learning what happens when practice starts to feel real.

apps.name: Life Souls
apps.short_description: Life Souls is a cooperative roguelike for 1–6 players featuring dynamic arena combat, free-form skill combinations, epic bosses, and permanent progression.

apps.name: Life Well
apps.short_description: Build your dream home, advance your career, and experience a full life in Life Well. An isometric life simulator where you manage daily needs, handle unpredictable emotions, start a family, and even adopt a pet. How will you live yours?

apps.name: Litany
apps.short_description: Litany is a roguelike deckbuilder where you play multiple units, craft a hyper-synergistic group, and trigger results that should not exist. Pick a character, open boosters, upgrade cards, and craft a powerful combination that breaks the numbers!

apps.name: Little Boo and the Spectral Orbs
apps.short_description: A challenging single-screen platformer inspired by 80s arcade classics. Help Little Boo rescue his lost friends across 40 deadly levels. Dodge traps, outrun enemies, and race against time. Easy to learn. Brutal to master.

apps.name: Little Merchant
apps.short_description: You arrive in Morvalle with empty pockets and a bag over your shoulder. Pick herbs, brew potions and haggle with the people in the square. Save up for a market stall, then a shop, then someone to mind it for you. Start small. The town is waiting.

apps.name: Logistique
apps.short_description: Logistique is a modification which brings a different point of view to the events happening during Half Life 2. It's the first part of a single player campaign developped by Elseware Experience featuring custom maps, textures, sounds and musics.

apps.name: Loopy
apps.short_description: LOOPY is the lab’s daily Slitherlink arena: Outrun neon, nine ranked protocols a day, arcade rules that shift under you, weekly/monthly circuits (Gauntlet, Megaloop, Throne Rush), and a synthwave score locked to every mode. Close the loop. Climb the board. No ads. No IAP.

apps.name: Lost Ball: Homeward Bound
apps.short_description: One lost ball. One epic journey home. Bounce, roll and blast your way through a 3D world of colourful environments from gritty cityscapes to fantastical worlds. Master new abilities, overcome tricky obstacles and solve challenging puzzles along the way. Ready to roll? Then let’s bounce

apps.name: Low Earth Orbit Adventures
apps.short_description: Low Earth Orbit Adventures is a chill space sim set in the near future where the space around Earth has become a frontier of science, commerce and diplomacy. Retrieve the Hubble, rescue astronauts, assemble space stations and many other missions in this realistic but friendly adventure.

apps.name: Lucky Dice
apps.short_description: Lucky Dice is an incremental dice game. Roll dice to earn chips, collect new dice, buy upgrades and expand your table. Unlock automation to keep the dice rolling and watch your earnings grow.

apps.name: Lucky Hell
apps.short_description: A dice game scored on Yahtzee hands. Roll, hold what's worth keeping, roll the rest again. Clear the target score and you move down a stage, and a shop opens in between. On the way down you hit stages where the dealer has bent one rule.

apps.name: Lucky Scoop
apps.short_description: Run a cozy gift shop where every scoop counts! Collect colorful gems, fulfill customer orders, solve satisfying 3D packing puzzles, upgrade your shop, and turn your little business into something special.

apps.name: Luminleaf Chronicles
apps.short_description: "Luminleaf Chronicles" is a local multiplayer game for 1 to 4 players that combines elements of survival, adventure, and roguelike genres. Acquire items, upgrade your skills, and defeat the continuously appearing bosses to survive tooth and nail in the game world, ultimately face the Skeleton King!

apps.name: Luna Plena
apps.short_description:
"Read your enemy. Count every turn."
A Short RPG Beneath the Full Moon.

apps.name: Lurid Conquest
apps.short_description: Lurid Conquest is a full-featured NSFW deckbuilder with a rich story and characters. Slay the Spire–inspired gameplay is paired with a story hub where you develop relationships, corrupt your captives, and recruit them as allies to aid in your war.

apps.name: Lust and Restitution
apps.short_description: Guide museum conservator Rafe Sowerby through a six-week restitution programme in this adult romance visual novel. Choose one of three distinct routes, navigate professional and personal consequences, and pursue relationships with Yewande, Elspeth, or Blythe.

apps.name: Lustera: Goddess of Passion
apps.short_description: Become a Guardian of a divine Shard in this erotic fantasy adventure! Meet seductive beauties, discover their secret desires, and win their hearts with your charm. Build powerful decks, compete with other Guardians, and create the harem of your dreams!

apps.name: Lyara
apps.short_description: Lost in an unknown world, Lyara tries to make sense of her surroundings while dealing with inner conflicts. Brave different challenges to find the answers she seeks as you progress through the game and grow alongside her.

apps.name: MADD: Mine Asteroids, Don't Die
apps.short_description: "Space-horror" bullet-hell with physics-controls. Maneuver your small mining & salvaging vessel through asteroids, starship wrecks, and hostile entities in the dark void of space. Find unique gadgets for your ship, and return to your hauler to upgrade and repair. Don't die.

apps.name: Mafia Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build a criminal empire in a stylized 1930s city. Capture territory, hire dealers and muscle, manage product, money, and heat, then fight rival gangs and police in a third-person action-management game.

apps.name: Mage Duel
apps.short_description: Mage Duel is set in the world of Degom - a rich fantasy realm where language is magic. Cast spells through translation, uncover meaning through conversation, and grow stronger with every word you learn.

apps.name: MagiMine Orchestra
apps.short_description: Smash ore by clicking or holding, scoop up scattered resources, and automate the mine with four specialist classes. Chain combos, flood the screen in Fever, then prestige for permanent power in this active incremental mining game.

apps.name: Mai Petite Saigon
apps.short_description: Mai-Anne aced everything she was told to. When her little brother disappears, she drops it all and dives into Paris's drawing underground to find him. A 240-page graphic novel, read page by page, with its own music and silences.

apps.name: MAID FOR YOU!
apps.short_description: Three maids. Thirty nights. One table, kept just for you. While the manager is away, Aoi, Reina and Akane open the café after hours for a single guest.
