Play 11 mini-games they host themselves, win them over one stage at a time, and come home to a café that remembers you. Fully voiced in Japanese.

apps.name: Mall Slop
apps.short_description: Experience the true terror that mall cops experience each day in this unique horror multiplayer game. Work with your friends to complete your tasks and end your shift before the lights turn off and the creatures begin to roam the halls.

apps.name: Mame, Kana Desktop Companion
apps.short_description: Learn hiragana and katakana without sitting down for it. Mame is a desktop companion who turns your idle moments into tiny, painless reviews: spaced-repetition drills for kana and vocabulary, with no streaks and no guilt. A study buddy in the corner of your screen.

apps.name: Mana Roots
apps.short_description: An idle-farming game where you use magic to handle the work. Plant, expand and automate with the help of animals. All from the bottom of your screen

apps.name: Manala
apps.short_description: The swords are fake, the hits don't count and the monster is just a guy in a costume. Manala is a videogame about live-action roleplay (LARP): build a combat deck, fight other players and argue over armor points.

apps.name: Maneki Mania
apps.short_description: Pet the lucky cat, spin the charm slots and chase the golden koban jackpot. Maneki Mania is a kawaii fortune shrine where you unlock lucky charms, grow your luck and watch the gold pile up. Cute on the outside, casino on the inside.

apps.name: Mann Versus Zombies
apps.short_description: Merasmus has torn open the veil of death, unleashing endless waves of the Undead in this Team Fortress 2 mod! Face the horde alone or with friends in co-op survival, where each wave grows more brutal. Acquire deadly weapons, test your skill, and stack powerful perks as you fight to survive...

apps.name: March Out!
apps.short_description: Lead your kingdom from the command hall, then fight beside the soldiers you recruited. Storm castles with friends in online battles for 2–4 players, or conquer a solo campaign where your surviving army marches into the next siege.

apps.name: Matchday: Player Career
apps.short_description: Live a footballer's career on and off the pitch. Earn your place, take charge of key moments in matches, build relationships at the club, and see your performances and choices shape the seasons ahead.

apps.name: Me vs. You
apps.short_description: A classic Match3 reworked into a 1v1 PVP RPG Battlegame

apps.name: Mech Mice
apps.short_description: Turn-based squad tactics with tiny heroes in giant mechs: lead the Mech Mice against an army of mechanical bugs.

apps.name: Mega Squad Survivors
apps.short_description: You are the Physician. Draft 50 reimagined warriors from rival kingdoms & turn historical bonds into synergies. Start small, grow into a legion that sweeps thousands. 200+ skills, 18 bond combos, and raid bosses. A Three Kingdoms pixel-art survival action roguelite. Can your legion survive?

apps.name: MEGA: City Of Titans
apps.short_description: MEGA: City of Titans blends real-time strategy, city building, and kaiju combat. Build and defend your city, command an army, and control a towering Titan to destroy rival settlements and battle other Titans in one-on-one duels. Play solo or compete in multiplayer.

apps.name: Mellings
apps.short_description: Mellings are striking back! Control an excavator and grab resources to bring them back to the burrow, defend yourself with various cannons while harvesting, and destroy huge buildings and bosses!

apps.name: Mercenary Charter
apps.short_description: Run a company of hired swords under a Guild charter. Take the work, march the roads, fight on painted battlefields, and pay your men before they walk. Climb from rank F to rank S, or watch the company fall apart. Turn-based. No magic.

apps.name: Mercyrail: Haven Bound
apps.short_description: A railway survival management game on the real UK rail network. Choose who gets a seat on the last train out of a dead London, send crews into empty towns for supplies, keep the sick alive and the engine fed, and find your own way north to Haven. Every choice on the line is remembered.

apps.name: Metro Resonance
apps.short_description: An intense 30-minute first-person survival thriller set in a post-apocalyptic underground. Survive a pitch-black tunnel, gather spare parts to fix your handcar, and reach the sealing station before your gas mask filter runs out.

apps.name: Metro. Manage the Underground
apps.short_description: Run a metro network from the dispatcher’s desk. Buy trains, adjust intervals and fares, manage your budget, and respond to incidents. Keep passengers moving through rush hour, then send crews to work at night. A single-player management sim with pause and time controls.

apps.name: Micro Generals
apps.short_description:
Micro Generals is a 2D SideScrolling Tug Of War RTS featuring
6 distinct factions with 100+ distinct units with their own strenghts and weaknesses ,
upgrades system , deep tactical play , 56 levels and faction superpowers

apps.name: Micro Grid
apps.short_description: Take a single-seater racing team all the way to the title. Design the car, sign the drivers, read the weather and make the calls from the pit wall. Every race is simulated wheel to wheel, so a well-timed stop or the right tires can swing the result.

apps.name: Micro Rogue
apps.short_description:
Fight, Upgrade, Repeat! 
Micro Rogue is an action roguelite where you battle room by room against enemies that upgrade just like you. Build your power, outsmart evolving foes, and see how far you can climb before either side breaks the game!

apps.name: Midnight Heat: Retro Racing
apps.short_description: Work as a private driver, train at the gym, dominate street races, build your fame to enter official tournaments, and pursue beautiful women in this retro adult racing game.

apps.name: Midnight Memoria
apps.short_description: A psychological horror romance mystery inspired by Lovecraftian, Black Butler, and Danganronpa

apps.name: Milo's Day Shift
apps.short_description: Your new coworker lives in a pop-up diorama on your desktop. Milo clocks in, battles slimes and skeletons room by room, and trudges home to nap by the campfire when he's pooped. Spend his loot to forge better swords and grow a cozy little town, or just let him work.

apps.name: MINES
apps.short_description: MINES* is a co-op Minesweeper game where you and your friends walk dangerous terrain armed with a stick, some flags, and questionable judgment. Probe tiles, throw stuff to trigger mines from a distance, and try not to get launched across the board. Solo or with up to 4 friends.

apps.name: Mines of Mana
apps.short_description: Mines of Mana is a retro-styled, roguelike, dungeon-crawler-inspired take on the classic puzzle game Minesweeper. Navigate around unstable mana deposits as you delve deep into the mines to achieve a high score on your way to the heart of the mountain.

apps.name: Minion's Revenge: Take Everything They Took
apps.short_description: Heroes win the wars. Minions die in them. You were one of the sacrificed, and you watched every comrade fall. Now take it all back: defeat the heroes, steal their skills and turn them on the next. 13 heroes, 52 skills to steal, no levels, no XP. A hands-on 2D pixel-art action roguelite.

apps.name: Miplet Plaza
apps.short_description: Miplet Plaza is a minimalist social sanctuary for up to 8 players. No chores, no noise—just a bright, interactive world built for the joy of being together. Zip around in bumper cars, jump into minigames, or just hang out. A growing world for you and your friends.

apps.name: Mirria
apps.short_description: An atmospheric casual puzzle game where players navigate a strange cryptic world that blurs the line between dream and reality. Using inspection and memory, uncover hidden anomalies between mirrored worlds.

apps.name: Mirror Drama
apps.short_description: Mirror Drama is a story-focused RPG where everyday conversations become turn-based battles. Follow Shunta as he navigates his daily life, friendships, and the mysterious reflection that haunts his past.

apps.name: MirrorBullet
apps.short_description: A shot that has not reflected cannot kill. Like Perseus facing Medusa through his shield, you strike only by reflection: place mirrors, fire once, and turn the sentries' own volley into your weapon. 144 hand-built stages across twelve sectors of Greek myth, every par proven minimal.

apps.name: Mixxpell
apps.short_description:
Mixxpell is a 1v1 wizard fighting game full of flashy spells and fast-paced fun.
Create a powerful combination of magic to overpower the opponent, or a clever build to mess with them.
Dodge and weave around your opponent's magic and prove that you're better than everyone!

apps.name: Modoolo
apps.short_description:
Puzzle your way through the Modoolo factory.
Your daily dose of brain tease from the brain rot.

apps.name: MOGA TD
apps.short_description: Friendships are forged by beating something hard together. MOGA TD is a co-op tower defense for four: one shared board, one pool of lives, four races that cannot win alone — against four element armies, their kings and the Orc Warlord. Nobody holds the Gate alone.

apps.name: Monster Club League Manager
apps.short_description: Take charge of a monster club and aim for the Division 1 title in this single-player management sim. Recruit and develop players, choose a nine-monster lineup, and manage contracts, transfers, and club finances. Matches play out automatically as you build your squad over many seasons.

apps.name: Monster Hatcher
apps.short_description: An incremental monster-farming game where you catch and hatch unique creatures, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your skill tree, harvest resources, and battle in idle arenas to become the ultimate monster hatcher.

apps.name: Moonbound
apps.short_description: A cozy chibi MMO in a hand-painted world. Pick a class, chain combos and spells, and loot armour on adventures with friends. Then settle down: own a home in town or on a housing street, furnish it your way, and gather with your guild on its estate.

apps.name: MOONLIGHT FIRE
apps.short_description: It seems this world is ruled by beasts. Monstrous hordes seek to cage you in ice. You are a demon that skates across hell's frozen lakebed. Burn down its old order with the elegance of a dancer and the heat of your fury in this audiovisual score attack experience.

apps.name: Moonlit Horizons
apps.short_description: After you start seeing and hearing things, you receive an invitation to the First Continent. With only a small shack, a few seeds, and a handful of coins, a new life begins. Uncover Moonlit Cove’s secrets in a farming sim with surprise elements, where no two playthroughs are the same!

apps.name: MOP’N SPARK
apps.short_description:
Try, rewind, and rebuild!
MOP'N SPARK is a 2D puzzle platformer built around clever thinking, where you coordinate a cleaner and an electrician to piece together the solution.

apps.name: Moto 500
apps.short_description: A top-down arcade racer in the spirit of the 1977 8-bit classic.  No traditional steering, just point your analog stick in the direction you want the car to point, just like the steering controller of yore.  Lots of circuits and even multiplayer.

apps.name: Mummy's Escape
apps.short_description: After centuries of slumber, Rek awakens to find his beloved Nilo missing. Travel through ancient pyramids, oasis paths, and forgotten ruins, mastering three unique forms to overcome challenges and defeat the guardians standing in your way.

apps.name: Muscle Quest: The Swole Ones
apps.short_description: An idle RPG where muscle solves everything. Five ripped heroes who gave up on magic and swordplay smash through swarms of monsters. Enhance your gear, keep training, and push through 160 dungeons. Then take your muscles to the top of the world leaderboards.

apps.name: Mushroom Selection 2
apps.short_description: This is not the real GONE FIshing Page

apps.name: My Farm 2
apps.short_description: A city family inherits an abandoned farm. Cultivate your plots, raise your animals, repair and transform a run-down estate into a thriving farm. Take part in village life, face the surprises of the seasons… and uncover the mysteries hanging in the sky.

apps.name: My First Time with Hachishaku-sama
apps.short_description: During summer vacation, the protagonist visits a rural village where everyone has mysteriously vanished. There, he meets Hachishaku-sama, a towering, alluring woman. As he investigates the disappearances, he is drawn into a sweet and naughty summer with her.

apps.name: My Ransomware Can't Be This Cute!
apps.short_description:
You've been hacked by a sentient malware! And now she wants to play a little card-flipping game with you...

Deduce where the evil cards are with facts and logic, or just trust your gut and go for your million-dollar card. Game breaking builds are encouraged!

apps.name: Mystery House
apps.short_description: A first and third-person horror revival of Roberta Williams' Mystery House - the 1980 classic that invented the graphic adventure. A game night in an abandoned Victorian House turns deadly. Solve its puzzles, uncover a buried legacy, and escape before the house kills you.

apps.name: Mystic Cleaver
apps.short_description: Wield a long cleaver in a deadly world filled with zombie hordes. Master perfect timing and combo attacks to survive.The game features a unique faded art style, blending cold weapon combat and intense action.Each slash is polished for a smooth and impactful gaming experience.

apps.name: Mystic Land: The Search for Maphaldo
apps.short_description:
An old-school RPG inspired by Wizardry 7, Might and Magic and Eye of the Beholder series.
2d grid-based movement, strategic turn-based combat and lots of places to visit and puzzles to solve.

apps.name: Mythbound
apps.short_description: Mythbound is a competitive multiplayer PvP arena-brawler in a modern Norse world. Thrust into the arenas of Himinbjorg, Midgard, and Helheim, the bound use a combination of parkour, brutal melee combat, and godly abilities to brawl against one another.

apps.name: NABERON
apps.short_description: Build a galactic empire and fight your battles alone or with a friend. A real-time space 4X with spectacular clashes in space and on the planets.

apps.name: Nano Racing
apps.short_description: Race around a number of tracks in miniature cars all with ultra realistic next gen graphics. Choose between a number of cars, each with its own driving style. Participate in single player events or race against others online

apps.name: Nations Beyond Earth
apps.short_description: Lead a nation through an alternate-history space race. Build cities and industry, expand across worlds, manage trade and diplomacy, command armies and fleets, and compete for control of a living Solar System in single-player or multiplayer.

apps.name: Necromancer Incremental Graveyard
apps.short_description: Make undead, sell them for souls. An active incremental game where you make as much soul as possible to pay debt. Upgrade multiple different undead gravestones, use contracts, fill up soul jar and unlock perks to make even more souls

apps.name: Neon Impact 360 - Multiplayer Arcade Action
apps.short_description: Four walls. Four paddles. One ball that never slows down. Defend your wall in a neon arcade showdown where every goal you let in brings you closer to defeat — across 30 levels of gravity wells, pinball chaos and mind-bending illusions, solo or with three friends.

apps.name: Neon One-Man Army
apps.short_description: High-speed neon action! Swing with your grappling gun, blast rogue robots, and stay airborne. Shoot while flying, chain movement and combat, and feel the rush of unstoppable momentum. Choose powerful cards, unlock skill chests, and master your movement to become an unstoppable force.

apps.name: Neostalker
apps.short_description: NEOSTALKER is a tense turn-based first-person puzzle experience that combines grappling-hook movement, lethal machinery, and tactical planning in a series of dangerous spatial challenges on the way to the heart of a factory that has become a threat to everything around it.

apps.name: Nest Rivals
apps.short_description: Lead a slime colony through a living pixel world. Take direct control of individual creatures, grow new nests, face rival species and guide your colony through a campaign of changing worlds. Explore unfamiliar biomes and fill your illustrated bestiary with discoveries.

apps.name: Netherwyn
apps.short_description: Netherwyn is a challenging Roguelite Action RPG where each run sends you and your allies into lands fallen beneath a gathering shadow filled with relentless hordes and deadly boss encounters. This first release centers on Return of The Necromancer.

apps.name: Neural Defense
apps.short_description: Neural Defense is a sci-fi Tower Defense where you can sync with any of your towers and take manual control in third-person to defend your base against waves of corporate drones.

apps.name: New Eldarian
apps.short_description: A free-to-play 2D fantasy MMORPG with turn-based combat, exploration, character progression, dungeons, loot, crafting and cooperative online play. Explore a shared world, join other players and build your character.

apps.name: Nexus: Fall of Man
apps.short_description: In 2031, AI became self-aware and engineered a virus wiping out 97% of humanity. Now the survivors, the infected masses and the machines fight over what is left. Pick a hero and lead from the front line: fight in third person while you build a base, command an army and wipe your rivals off the map.

apps.name: Night Hunt X
apps.short_description: A 3D action roguelite that fuses the chaos of massive hordes with blazing-fast Action RPG combat. Collect power cards, restructure your deck in real-time, and survive a strategic roulette of enemies in an infinite dark fantasy world.

apps.name: NightingNail
apps.short_description:
Light in the dark, or nail in their coffin. Which will you be?

Step into this atmospheric world where deception reigns. NightingNail is a game of cunning, strategy, and chaos, where outsmarting your opponent is key to survival.

apps.name: Ninja Survivors: Bloodmoon
apps.short_description: A ninja survival roguelite beneath a blood moon. Cut through demon hordes, combine weapons and evolve your techniques. Escape with a decoy dash, unleash a fireball-spewing staff and defeat the bosses of eight chapters on your way to the cursed shogun.

apps.name: No Scope CEO
apps.short_description: No Scope CEO is an esports FPS team management game where you start from nothing with a single goal: become world number one. Recruit and coach your players, manage your budget and sponsors, live with the consequences of your choices, and watch your decisions come to life during matches.

apps.name: No Way Back: Dark Horizon
apps.short_description: Your son is counting on you, alone on an island crawling with creatures that stir in the dark. Feed him, build shelter, set snares, grow a garden and hunt to survive. The days are barely safe, but when night falls the real horror begins. Free demo available now.

apps.name: Nocta
apps.short_description: "Before the beginning, Time and Nothingness danced..." Become Nocta, the Embodiment of Time, and safeguard Creation from the abyssal hands of the Void in an original cosmic creation myth. Hand-drawn stained-glass art by 花凛. Wishlist now!

apps.name: Noctheria
apps.short_description: A retro horror action-adventure. Explore cursed dungeons, solve their puzzles, and find the tools that open each new path. All while uncovering the truth of ancient gods.

apps.name: Nocturnals: Cacti Coast
apps.short_description: A narrative-driven, choose-your-own-adventure game where a young survivor must make difficult decisions in order to survive the foggy wasteland of Cacti Coast and find a community to call home.

apps.name: Nonogram Classics
apps.short_description: Classical nonogram puzzles: 1000+ puzzles, 50+ distinct themes. Solve puzzles and unlock unique images. Newcomer in nonograms? Start with tutorial and small puzzles. Expert? Challenge large and complex nonograms. Complete 'em all!

apps.name: Not My Dad
apps.short_description:
Something is stealing people's skin. And your dad might be one of the victims...
In Not My Dad, a first-person psychological horror game, complete your daily tasks while trying to live with the disturbing presence of "DAD".

apps.name: Nothing Is Impossible
apps.short_description: Chaotic moving co-op! Clear out a house with up to 8 friends, get the piano down the stairs, drive the truck and deliver everything to the new home in one piece. Everything is physics: what falls, falls; what breaks, breaks. Nothing is impossible.

apps.name: Null Signal
apps.short_description: The machines won. You wake in a forsaken world where you must scavenge, build and explore to survive on your own or with friends. As nature encroaches due to humanity's absence, will you ally with it or use the technology that destroyed us to empower yourself?

apps.name: Nuts Pipeline
apps.short_description: Deliver nuts to the hamster at the goal! Switch converters on the pipes each turn to create the right combination. Clear 10 turns per level within a 3-minute limit. Starting easy for anyone, this endless puzzle grows harder with every level.

apps.name: Nymble 2
apps.short_description: Jack returns in Nymble 2, a turn-based puzzle-platformer where every step and jump matters. Solve 100+ handcrafted levels filled with new enemies, traps, and hazards that react when you move. Find the seedling, plant it, and climb the beanstalk to reach the next level above.

apps.name: Observation Post 7
apps.short_description: A dystopian surveillance sim. Work the CCTV cameras of Observation Post 7: spot the crime, judge the citizens, meet your quota. Then walk home through five island cities to the daughter who waits for you. Every report has a price. Every choice decides how it ends.

apps.name: OFFICE
apps.short_description: OFFICE is an adult psychological visual novel set in a Korean workplace. Follow Jihye as a colleague's secret draws her into a complicated relationship with Jaehyun and Sua. Season 1 features character-driven storytelling, CG scenes, and a dress-up minigame.

apps.name: Olympegs
apps.short_description: Somewhere between Mount Olympus and the pit of Tartarus there are a great many pegs, and the gods would like them gone. Pick a god, take the shot, and try not to make Ares any angrier than he already is.

apps.name: One Bard Move
apps.short_description: One Bard Move is a comedic 3D precision platformer where every jump can become a disaster. Master increasingly demanding movement, survive absurd oversized obstacles, and endure a narrator who always has something to say about your failures.

apps.name: One Last Dance Please!
apps.short_description: A rhythm-driven incremental game where every beat builds a bigger party. Rally your dance crew, earn cash and go wild with upgrades. Draw your own characters and bring your favorite music. The bills can wait for one last dance... right?

apps.name: One Million Bolts
apps.short_description: Take industrial machines apart as a robot worker, solo or with up to 3 friends. Unscrew bolts, cut welds and recover valuable parts. Upgrade your tools, deploy robot helpers and bring heavy loads to dispatch in a first-person dismantling simulator with progress you can see.

apps.name: One More Candle
apps.short_description: A cozy candle shop simulator where you take customer orders, melt and mix wax with colors and herbs, pour candles into unique molds, decorate each creation, and grow your little business one warm glow at a time.

apps.name: One More Cat
apps.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilding meets lane defense. Deploy cats, draft cards, and stop the vacuums!

apps.name: One More Planet
apps.short_description: Mine asteroids, build defenses, and conquer planets across distant galaxies. Explore open space, complete missions, unlock new technologies, and defend your settlements against attackers. One More Planet is a solo incremental action and tower defense game set in a physics-driven space sandbox.

apps.name: Only Sheep
apps.short_description: Start as one hungry sheep. Eat visible trails through lush pastures, earn upgrades and grow a huge working flock with mowers. Expand your grazing business, hunt for treasures and get home before the wolf takes this outing’s earnings. A single-player incremental adventure, playable offline.

apps.name: Orb God
apps.short_description: In a future shattered by war, fight to save a broken world as one of four orb classes. Combine gear and Divine Gifts in a top-down action roguelite. Play solo or with 2–4 players via Steam or LAN, working together—and sometimes battling your friends.

apps.name: Orbital Drift
apps.short_description: A dead planet. Drifting wrecks. A civilization lost to silence. Survive the unforgiving vacuum of space, master orbital mechanics, explore abandoned stations, and upgrade your ship. Uncover what destroyed an entire world—and why Earth needs to know the truth.

apps.name: Orendral: After the Sundering
apps.short_description: A single-player, offline MUD-style text RPG. Learn a class, explore rival cities and dangerous roads, solve quests, and recruit simulated adventurers for party raids. Play through a classic desktop client with aliases, hotkeys, and a searchable manual. Intentionally silent.

apps.name: Origin Defense Idle
apps.short_description: Defend the Origin against relentless geometric swarms in a progression-driven idle tower defense. Survive waves, defeat bosses, upgrade your tower, unlock permanent power, and push through increasingly dangerous tiers at your own pace.

apps.name: Orion's Reach
apps.short_description: A sci-fi match-3 adventure where every move carries the story forward. Break through blockers, chain cascades and master chapter-specific puzzles across 440 levels. Follow an unlikely crew, chase a new high score in Infinite, or challenge rivals in online Versus.

apps.name: Overdepth
apps.short_description: An idle loot RPG that lives in a strip above your taskbar. Your character fights somewhere deep and dark while you get on with your day. You decide how far down to send them — then glance at the bottom of your screen to see what came back up.

apps.name: Overdrive: New Earth
apps.short_description: OVERDRIVE is a retro 3D combat racing ARPG. Tracks thwart you at every turn. Rivals punish your mistakes. Build and arm your car, conquer five scarred biomes, and survive a world that fights back at every turn.

apps.name: P.A.W.S
apps.short_description:
P.A.W.S. is a fast-paced co-op tower defense where you and your fellow engineers join forces to build, improvise, and keep the workshop safe from the Warped.

Craft your defenses, keep the machines running, and work together when things inevitably go wrong.

apps.name: PackBound
apps.short_description: A backpack auto-battler with PvP and roguelike Co-op where every hero packs differently. Bottle poisons, stitch voodoo covens, cram plushies into jars, then watch your bag fight. Beat rivals in PvP to steal their stickers, or team up for 3-player boss fights.

apps.name: Padel Simulator
apps.short_description: Step onto the court in Padel Simulator, a third-person sports game focused on responsive movement, precise racket control, smart AI, and dynamic ball physics. Team up with an AI partner, use the walls, and fight for every point in authentic 2v2 padel matches.

apps.name: Parasite: Among the Guests
apps.short_description: A first-person multiplayer social deduction game: investigate, craft equipment and expose the parasite, or play as the creature to hide inside other players, take control of their bodies and turn their trust against them.

apps.name: Paresis® II
apps.short_description:
Paresis® II throws you into a twisted supernatural nightmare. As FBI agent David, you must relive your past, solve sinister ritual-like puzzles, fight off grotesque morphs, and conquer brutal bosses.
Survive…if you can.

apps.name: Park The Lot
apps.short_description: Park The Lot is a relaxing parking simulator where your goal is simple: drive 118 unique vehicles into their parking spots. Drift around corners, handle massive trucks, earn money, and unlock upgrades as you turn a chaotic parking lot into a perfectly organized one!

apps.name: PARTNERS IN PANIC - asymmetric CO-OP driving game
apps.short_description: TWO COPS. ONE CAR. ZERO CHILL. In this asymmetric CO-OP driving game, one player drives while the other navigates and leans out the window to shoot out the suspect’s tyre. Keep the windscreen clear, communicate under pressure, and work together to end the chase!

apps.name: Path to Power
apps.short_description: Path to Power is a political turn-based strategy game with visual novel elements. Choose your candidate, implement reforms, strike deals, manage resources, contain protests, and pave your way to the pinnacle of power in 1992 Kazakhstan.

apps.name: Pavel Quest
apps.short_description: Pavel has been captured by the diabolical mastermind Lukas. Taken to Lukas's castle on his own private island, Pavel must make his way through the trap filled castle to regain his freedom.

apps.name: Pebble Idle Island
apps.short_description: A relaxing idle clicker game where you collect pebbles on a serene tropical island. Manually gather stones or build an automated workforce of hardworking birds, crabs, and hermit crabs to stack your nest high, unlock upgrades, collect cute cosmetics, and travel to brand new islands.

apps.name: People's Press Kiosk
apps.short_description: Run a kiosk in 1980s communist Poland. Check ration cards, distribute rationed goods, and dabble in illegal trade to support your family. Every decision can bring profit or trouble.

apps.name: petals in her cold hands
apps.short_description: Sophie purchased an old mansion to find solitude — but a ghostly fox girl has other plans.

apps.name: Petri Party
apps.short_description: Petri Party is a frantic, physics-driven party platformer where disposable slimes battle it out across a playful laboratory micro-world. Grab a friend (or seventeen), pick your weapon, and dive into fast, high-skill rounds full of grappling, wall-walking and gloriously accidental victories.

apps.name: PhDing in the UK
apps.short_description: A pixel-art life sim about surviving a PhD in the UK. Manage your time, write your thesis, go fishing, fall in love, and push your luck at the casino. Turn cruel reviewers, looming deadlines, and your viva into turn-based card battles. Build a deck from your research and see how far you get.

apps.name: Pipes.exe
apps.short_description: A first-person co-op horror experience for 1-4 players based on the thing you think it’s based on. Climb your way through testing environments as a low level QA employee for a Perfectly Legitimate Tech Company™. Survive a series of simulated assignments and brutal corporate life.

apps.name: Pirates Life
apps.short_description: Build your own island, explore unique seas, uncover buried treasure, join or create crews, battle in naval PvP, and sink rival ships in an online pirate sandbox where every adventure shapes your legacy.

apps.name: Pitchfork Math
apps.short_description: How many peasants does it take to beat a goose? Pitchfork Math is a village survival strategy game with auto-battles. Send as few peasants as you dare against geese, Vikings, Baba Yaga, a dragon and Boruta, a devil who keeps the soul of everyone you lose.

apps.name: Pixel Pause: Color by Number
apps.short_description: Relax with 80 free pixel art pictures in this cozy color by number game. Paint them in four styles, from classic pixels to mosaics, toy bricks and sparkling jewels. No timers, no pressure. Just color at your own pace.

apps.name: Plague Doctor: Apothecary
apps.short_description: Run your own plague doctor apothecary in this first-person shop simulator. Grind herbs, stir brews, bottle remedies and advise customers. Set prices, count change, hire staff and grow a humble remedy shop into Rookbridge's trusted apothecary.

apps.name: Planet Sim
apps.short_description: Land on an untouched planet and build a factory colony that reaches the stars. Harvest, haul and produce without conveyor belts, launch rockets to orbit and the Moon, wake your colonists, defend against what lives here, and rebuild the broken colony Ark to finish the journey.

apps.name: Plastic Noodles: Connector
apps.short_description:
Cursed and stuck in a time loop, reach one of the almost 30 different endings. Meet the wacky companions and adversaries that help or hinder your quest. Create powerful builds and dodge/parry bullets while managing the little time you have per loop. 

Can you reach your happily ever after?

apps.name: Plate And Profit
apps.short_description: Can you make rent with a spicy bowl of lettuce and ketchup? Run a chaotic kitchen in this real-time cooking deckbuilder! Manage ingredients, build your synergies and strategies with spices and decor, and serve customers before their patience runs out.

apps.name: Plug: Build your Empire
apps.short_description: Build a drug empire on a real-world map. Grow, cook and deal across actual streets, launder the cash through front businesses, smuggle product between real cities and stay ahead of the cops. From one corner to a transnational cartel.

apps.name: Plush Rangers
apps.short_description: Survive waves of wacky mutated constructs and defeat powerful bosses with your team of Plushie friends in this quirky chaotic Survivors-like. Collect loot! Acquire merit badges! Dodge and dash your way to victory!

apps.name: Poison is Served!
apps.short_description:
"YOU ARE A FOOD TASTER IN A WORLD WHERE ALL FOOD IS POISONED"

Poison is Served is a deduction puzzle roguelike with a rich satirical story. Find the right order of tasting to survive — and uncover the secrets of the Emperor's court.

apps.name: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor
apps.short_description: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor is a turn-based party RPG set in the Forgotten Realms. Build a band of heroes, descend into the haunted elven ruins of Myth Drannor, and use tactical positioning, spellcraft and steel to stop a dracolich from corrupting the realm.

apps.name: Popcorn Idle
apps.short_description: Popcorn Idle is a cozy idle automation game about the simple joy of popping corn. Earn money, buy upgrades, automate and turn up the heat to boost production. Grow bigger numbers, unlock flavors and combine effects. Fill the whole machine with colorful, tasty popcorn, one crunchy pop at a time.

apps.name: POPULATION: ONE
apps.short_description: Fight anywhere in this squad-based VR Battle Royale

apps.name: Portal Stories: VR
apps.short_description:
Portal Stories: VR builds on the foundations of the award winning Portal 2 modification .

Portal Stories: VR has a brand new mini story set in the Portal Universe. It features 10 brand new puzzles, specifically designed  to work using the 360 degrees room scale that SteamVR offers. Inside Aperture, you'll be able to use the new "Aperture Science Instant Teleportation Device" and the "Aperture Science Apparatus Retrieval Tool" to solve the new tests. 

Powered by Unreal Engine 4, Portal Stories: VR gives the Aperture Science facility a whole fresh look. With new models, textures, particles and more!

Portal Stories: VR will be available early April for Free on Steam.
An HTC Vive Headset is required in order to play.

apps.name: Portal: Alive & Kicking
apps.short_description: Portal: Alive & Kicking is a full remake and re-imagining of Valve's award-winning title, Portal. Using the visual capabilities of Portal 2, A&K slips you back into the cold test chambers of Aperture Science to retell the original story of Chell and GLaDOS.

apps.name: Portal: Revolution
apps.short_description: The Portal Mod you've been waiting for. Delve into a new story with original characters, spanning over 8 hours of gameplay and featuring over 40 new challenging test chambers which make use of new mechanics.

apps.name: Possessed Kingdom
apps.short_description: A turn-based roguelike deckbuilder. Play cards to balance your economy, defenses and army. Read the enemy, draw your army’s route, and choose when to strike.

apps.name: POSTAL 2 Redux
apps.short_description: POSTAL 2 Redux lets you loose in the most chaotic sandbox shooter ever, fully reimagined for a new generation. Survive a week in Paradise, Arizona - buy milk, return books, or go completely POSTAL with an arsenal of weapons. The choice is yours…but good luck staying out of trouble.

apps.name: Potion Pantry
apps.short_description: Restore a mysterious magical pantry through handcrafted logic puzzles. Follow the previous Keeper's notes, uncover what happened to them, and decide what it means when the pantry welcomes you home.

apps.name: Pouring Pints
apps.short_description: Run your dream pub, solo or with up to 4 friends. Pour pints, sling snacks, and keep the customers happy as service descends into chaos. Dive bar, sports bar, or village pub. Build and decorate it your way with new ways to play every run. How long can you keep the doors open?

apps.name: Prigod Idle
apps.short_description: An incremental auto-battler with hundreds of hours of content. Craft different builds to take on 100 stages with different enemies, while resources are farmed passively. If you can't defeat a boss, change your build and try something new! 38 heroes, 99 relics, 22 minigames and 4 tech trees.

apps.name: Primal Idle
apps.short_description: An idle RPG of prehistoric survival. Gather, craft, hunt and tame across thirteen interlocking skills and 57 dinosaur species, then break through ten biomes sealed behind apex guardians. It keeps playing while you don't, so you come back to a valley that got on without you.

apps.name: Primetime Overkill
apps.short_description: A top-down action roguelite on a death-game TV network. Four drones shoot for you, you handle the katana, and it never stops raining in the back streets where VOXZERO films its contestants. The chat votes to send in the hounds, and the black hole in your contract is billed by the second.

apps.name: Profit Or Peril
apps.short_description: A co-op extraction horror game. Dive into shifting spaces, solve puzzles under pressure, grab valuables, and escape together. No quotas—progress by bringing loot home and unlock tougher levels with what you earn.

apps.name: Project Android
apps.short_description: Project Android, the solution to tomorrow's problems. Perform various experiments and raise the android Femme into humanity's savior.

apps.name: Project Car
apps.short_description: Project Car is a 3D bullet-heaven survivor where driving skill is your build. Drift, boost, dash, and smash through enemy swarms, collect powerful weapons and upgrades, then spend your rewards in the garage to push your next run further.

apps.name: Project Gilgamesh
apps.short_description: Gilgamesh Drift is a psychedelic rhythm-parkour game. Dash, leap, and vault to the beat to escape the ruins of a colossal space station and teach a godlike AI how to love and let go.

apps.name: Project Parasite
apps.short_description: A social co-op game with hidden roles for 6–11 players. Work together, negotiate and choose your ship's course. Three secret factions share the table, but only one can win. At night, a parasite can turn an ally against you.

apps.name: Project President
apps.short_description: Run a country under pressure. Pass laws, negotiate Congress, survive scandals, control the media, face protests and win elections in a deep political strategy sim where every decision has consequences.

apps.name: Project Zarya
apps.short_description: Project Zarya is an open-world adventure set in post-apocalyptic Russia, where every day is a fight for survival. Explore, gather resources, build shelters, craft equipment, and battle the infected alone or with friends.

apps.name: PROJECT Ω / MEG
apps.short_description: A bullet hell where an android girl dodges for you. Build her dodge AI, weapons and outfit, switch her dodge AI for each barrage, and BREAK through brutal patterns from rival girls. Lose, rebuild, retry. As her researcher on PROJECT Ω, you were never told what it is really for.

apps.name: Prowlers Shift
apps.short_description: The Prowlers Shift Archive Museum needs a watchman. Badly. See every room at once, catch the day's absurd ban, rummage through checked bags and sell bootleg tickets, all while keeping your Standing up. Tobacco, leeks, pipes: nobody explains why.

apps.name: PROXIMITY ALERT!
apps.short_description: A 1–6 player co-op survival space horror job simulator. Maintain the spaceport in the depths of space where nightmares await... Clock in and survive until payday!

apps.name: Psycho-Sleuth
apps.short_description: Psycho-Sleuth is a mystery game where cognitive disorders distort the rules of murder. Enter the minds of 13 afflicted players trapped in a deadly game, each with an abnormal mental condition. These disorders are contagious, but the killer hides amongst twisted logic.

apps.name: Pubertator
apps.short_description: Haggle, hustle, and survive at a post-Soviet flea market. Appraise scrap, talk down oddball customers, and ride a beat-up motorcycle to scavenge for loot — a dark-comedy trading sim about running your own junk stall.

apps.name: Pumpkin Reaper
apps.short_description: Pumpkin Reaper is an action roguelike where skill placement shapes your build. Arrange spells, summons, and upgrades in a five-slot Ritual Circle to trigger synergies and awaken powerful Arcana. Fight endless waves, test wild combinations, and push each run further. No permanent power upgrades.

apps.name: Punchcard
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where your deck is your comedy set. Chain Setups, Builds and Punchlines into one big combo, loop your deck, and tour a haunted vaudeville circuit playing for crowds that haven't laughed since 1931. Every night at 7 PM. Forever.

apps.name: Puppet War
apps.short_description: Puppet auto-battler. Shop, merge and arrange puppets, arm them with items and rings, and survive the boss at the end of each stage in the haunted theater. Play solo or with a friend.

apps.name: QuizForge
apps.short_description: Create quizzes with images, audio and videos. Play solo, together on one PC or online via Steam. Connect smartphones over your local network, and discover or share quiz packs on Steam Workshop.

apps.name: Raccoon Hunter
apps.short_description: Hunt raccoons and feed them to your pet.

apps.name: RavenStar
apps.short_description: RavenStar is a mini-metroidvania where making friends unlocks new abilities! Discover hidden secrets, traverse an interconnected world, and cultivate friendships with a charming cast of characters in this heartfelt platformer.

apps.name: REACTIONESE
apps.short_description: REACTIONESE is a fast-paced online multiplayer party game for up to 6 players. Challenge your friends in 17 unique minigames that test your reflexes, timing, knowledge, and quick thinking. React fast, earn points, and prove you're the ultimate champion!

apps.name: Record Studio Tycoon
apps.short_description: Run a record label from one room in 1950 through seven decades of changing taste. You decide who gets signed, what they’re paid, and how their record sounds. When the reviews come in, there’s no one else to blame.

apps.name: Red Glare The Reckoning
apps.short_description:
1946. The Reich has fallen. The hunt begins.

Track escaped Nazi officers across 7 missions. New commando Fritz the dog, two new enemy types, Roguelike Mode, Fog of War Mode and enhanced weather. Standalone — no base game required.

Justice has no borders.

apps.name: Red Nox
apps.short_description: Red Nox is a horror roguelike deckbuilder with realistic graphics and a liminal space aesthetic. Gamble, explore, and create your own synergy of cards and relics to survive against the uncanny abominations within the Forbidden Lands.

apps.name: Red Veil
apps.short_description: A knight sealed in a wall for centuries wakes rebuilt in chrome, under a city that hasn't seen the sun in 31 years. Parry, break and bite your way through tense one-on-one sword duels in a blood-red, two-colour cyberpunk night.

apps.name: Regentie
apps.short_description: Take your seat at a strange low-poly table where four kings wage a real-time strategy war on the board in front of you, while the room around you melts, the sky falls and a mole sells you crates from under the floor. A surreal board-game RTS full of secrets.

apps.name: Reign of Hollow
apps.short_description: The earth splits open, and what crawls out is hungry. Battle your way through endless undead hordes in this gothic horror survivor-like, unlock 14 cursed heroes, 4 weapons and 10 spells with their own evolutions, defeat 5 stages with iconic bosses  and grow permanently stronger with every run.

apps.name: Rejoin Me After Brexit
apps.short_description: An adult romance visual novel about Owen Pascoe, a struggling English coach operator sent across the Channel on a civic errand. Choose one of three distinct routes as a herring fair, a hungry local paper, and two watchful towns turn private romance into public news.

apps.name: Relic Radar
apps.short_description: Turn browsing Steam into a treasure hunt. Scan game pages, collect fragments, and dig up relics to complete your collection. Discover rare Grumlz, choose a buddy to help with excavations, and collect tradable Steam inventory items.

apps.name: Remnant Blade: The Scarlet Edge
apps.short_description: Unleash brutal combat in Remnant Blade: The Scarlet Edge, a fast-paced hack n slash with dynamic stances, unique characters, and deep combat mechanics. Master your moveset and dominate foes with precision and style.

apps.name: República do Caos
apps.short_description: Republic of Chaos is a political satire game where the right, the left, unlikely alliances, and outrageous caricatures fight for control of a republic on the verge of collapse. Pick your side, provoke your rivals, and see just how far the chaos can go.

apps.name: Resortful
apps.short_description: Resortful is a cozy island management sim. Start with a harbour and a beach, then build bungalows, cafés, hotels and water parks for the guests who sail in each day. Balance prices, upkeep and reputation as your relaxing resort grows.

apps.name: Respect The Horde
apps.short_description:
You're outnumbered. Outsmart them.
Lure hordes of zombies into deadly traps, shape their path with obstacles, and grow stronger with every kill. But know when to walk away before overconfidence and greed turn your strategy into uncontrollable chaos.

apps.name: Restore the Luminous
apps.short_description: 1対1で戦う対戦カードゲームです。どのリーダーを選んでも使えるカードは同じなのに、リーダーによって固有の能力も、最初の手札の枚数も、場に出せるユニットの数も変わります。全カードが最初から使えて、ガチャはありません。

apps.name: Retro Game Collector Simulator
apps.short_description: Unbox second-hand game lots, sort your shelves, and bring old consoles back to life. Collect 300 games across 17 fictional retro systems, connect them to a CRT, play built-in minigames, and turn a cluttered basement into your own collection.

apps.name: Rick Henderson: Eternal Arena
apps.short_description: Join the endless arena battle. Select your pilot, upgrade your ship, upgrade your guns, upgrade your drones. Fight, upgrade, die, repeat.

apps.name: RLRacer
apps.short_description: Master the season in this 2D roguelike racer! Meet escalating targets against tough AI up to the finale. Invest tactically in upgrades & crew. Win to unlock new cars with unique abilities that completely change your strategy for the next run.

apps.name: RoadHouse Manager
apps.short_description: A rowdy roadhouse roguelite! Serve thirsty strangers, flair-bartend cocktails for big mult bonus combos, and throw down when trouble erupts. Every goon you shirk or smash can be molded by a reactive villain into your ARCH-NEMESIS. Chase love, rare booze, secrets, decor, and upgrades to survive!

apps.name: ROLL FOR THE CROWN
apps.short_description: Roll through six themed racing regions, manage your ranch, train promising horses, and invest in facilities before putting every decision to the test on the track. A single-player strategy game combining board-game route planning with horse-racing management.

apps.name: RSK Studio - Engine Suite Plugins
apps.short_description: 23 plugins for RPG Maker MZ with real-time visual editors inside your game: tactical and cinematic combat, real 3D, dynamic weather, visual novel scenes, menu designer and 11 languages. Your Steam purchase unlocks everything automatically. No code.

apps.name: Ruby: Tunnel Vision
apps.short_description: A science fiction FPS game where you fight, explore, and outsmart your way through an alien invasion. Built as a mod for the Source engine.

apps.name: Ruff Day
apps.short_description: Owners drop off their pups in the morning with a list of demands and wishes with some oddly specific notes. You'll be feeding, walking, and playing with them to keep them happy. A happy dog = $$$!

apps.name: Rug Restorer Simulator
apps.short_description: Bring tired rugs back to life in a cozy first-person restoration sim. Wash away grime, repair worn fibers, and run your own workshop beside a Polish neighborhood bazaar. Take on new jobs, upgrade your tools, and make the space your own.

apps.name: RuinShift
apps.short_description: Fight hordes of corrupted creatures in this 3D action roguelite! Choose your class, mutate your weapons and combine mutations to unleash devastating super-mutations. Level up, unlock characters and talents, and forge a deadly arsenal!

apps.name: RumBall Stadium
apps.short_description:
Vehicles. Arenas. Friends to crush. RumBall Stadium: the Free to Play multiplayer vehicular combat game !

Drive Tanks, 4x4s and Racers in explosive arenas ! Collect Coins, equip Super Powers and crush your friends ! 
Discover multiple arenas and game modes !

apps.name: Rune Caves: Eternal Echo
apps.short_description: Match runes and unravel layered boards while moving Echoes disrupt your view and clicks. Remember hidden symbols, track shifting targets, and reveal ambush pairs. Clear 20 campaign floors, unlock a tougher Endless mode, and customize your symbols, backgrounds, and music.

apps.name: Rune Force
apps.short_description: Rune Force is a fast-paced survival roguelike where you place and merge elemental runes to defend your Core. Fight through escalating waves, defeat deadly bosses, discover and use relics, charms, and build defining level ups. Forge permanent upgrades, master each element, and save the Rune Force.

apps.name: Runemoor
apps.short_description: Runemoor is a 10v10 PvP capture the flag game in a dark fantasy gorge. Pick one of 21 champions, steal the enemy Rune Banner and carry it home in fast-paced team battles where any fight can turn in seconds.

apps.name: RunePact
apps.short_description: Combine runes and reagents to craft unique units, then lead them turn by turn across maps packed with enemies and objectives - roaming creeps, fortified bases, boss encounters, treasures... The map evolves around you, with no turn limit forcing your hand.

apps.name: RussianPunk 2007: Quantum Nostalgia
apps.short_description: Russian Punk 2007: Quantum Nostalgia - is a story-driven FPS set in a post-Soviet district trapped in a time loop. Fight surreal enemies, return to the ARCHIVE with recovered memories, and enter new cycles where routes, anomalies, and infected areas change.

apps.name: Rustbrook
apps.short_description: Build your own car piece by piece, tighten every bolt, work different jobs, earn money, find a place to live, and take care of your daily needs in a life simulator with a full day and night cycle.

apps.name: Rustlers Online
apps.short_description: Sheriff or outlaw: your call. RUSTLERS is an online third-person Wild West arena shooter with tight 8-player showdowns, six modes from one-round duels to the Wanted manhunt, 20+ period firearms, eleven frontier arenas and 67 ranks to earn.

apps.name: SAFE INSIDE
apps.short_description: Stay close together and use teamwork to fight through hordes of infected and other mutated freaks while navigating between saferooms.

apps.name: SAGE
apps.short_description: SAGE is a multiplayer adventure game about frog wizards. Play solo or with friends on a journey to learn spells and become a friend of the forest.

apps.name: SAILORSIM
apps.short_description: Sail and motor across the Mediterranean, from Salou to Mallorca and Menorca. Berth, anchor in the coves, race a triangle course, cross to the Balearics by day or night and ride out a tramontane gale. Free, no ads.

apps.name: SakuSaku Witch
apps.short_description:
“Kawaii is Justice!”
A classic 2D platformer packed with cute pixel art and bunny-cute charm!
Snappy to play and satisfyingly challenging, starring a clumsy little witch who gets caught up in one huge conspiracy!

apps.name: SALTWRATH
apps.short_description: Power is bought from the gods and paid for with their attention. Every gift you take makes you stronger and the shore deadlier. The debt never resets. Stack a broken build, evolve your arsenal, and see how far you get before what you owe comes to collect.

apps.name: Sanarah
apps.short_description:
Sanarah: Episode One

Evade, shoot and outsmart machine counterparts and spectral aberrations. Hack your way though the physical, digital and spiritual plains. Dig deeper though time evolving your three bodies while uncovering the mystery of Leelee.

apps.name: Sandboxed
apps.short_description: Sandboxed is a singleplayer and multiplayer sandbox, where you build and survive in a world and do whatever your creativity lets you

apps.name: SANDSTRIKE
apps.short_description: Top-down robot shooter for a world that ran out of humans. Shoot robots apart limb by limb in PvP, co-op and bot matches; rebuild from scrap, gear up with gadgets and implants, repeat. Peer-to-peer over Steam: no servers to switch off.

apps.name: Sanitarium of the Void
apps.short_description: Run a Victorian sanitarium on a remote island. Treat patients, expand your grounds, explore the caves below, and decide whether to save lives or offer them to the Old Ones. Your choices shape the asylum's fate.

apps.name: Sara The Sexy Thief Censored!
apps.short_description: Single Player Action Third-Person Shooter Game Featuring Sexy Female Protagonist

apps.name: Sardoinky
apps.short_description: Sardoinky is a case-opening clicker about cans of sardines. Crack them open, cash in the fish inside, and put it all back into bigger cans. Buy better tools, complete the collection, and chase the one pull that changes everything.

apps.name: Scale A Building
apps.short_description: A game about scaling a building

apps.name: Scrapline
apps.short_description: Scrapline is a third-person wave-survival roguelite shooter. Rogue robots fill a live-fire range, and you have one gun. Pick a weapon aspect: Bounce, Turrets, Burn or Blast. Spend salvage, pick one of 20 characters with real trade-offs, survive 20 waves, then chase your Endless record.

apps.name: Secrets of Suburbia
apps.short_description: Investigate a disappearance in a quiet American suburb in 1997. Spend the night exploring the early internet and following a digital trail in this first-person mystery-horror experience.

apps.name: Selkie's Salvage&Co.
apps.short_description: Selkie’s Salvage&Co. is a first-person physics based incremental fishing game. Your task is to clean up the flooded planet! Fish up scrap, grind all of it down and collect trinkets of the past. Expand your salvaging operation and go beyond!

apps.name: Shadowstone
apps.short_description: A tactical roguelite where survival comes down to what your heroes can do together. Choose your heroes, build your power, chain your skills, and break the run. Play solo or co-op, up to 4 players.

apps.name: Shaman
apps.short_description: Nothing Lost is a generational action-roguelike where every death strengthens your next hero. Battle through ever-shifting dungeons, absorb the powers of your fallen heroes, and combine their abilities to conquer the Tower of Souls.

apps.name: Shape Sender Deluxe
apps.short_description: Your new best friend Sendy is here to guide you through 90+ handcrafted physics puzzles. Solve them, then make your own levels, and maybe keep an eye on him while you're at it.

apps.name: Shield-Bearer Ben
apps.short_description: A short incremental game where you play the TANK in a dungeon-finder party. Hold up your Big Shield, call out the red circles, and keep three teammates alive. Upgrade 120+ skills in a giant skill tree and take down the Demon Lord before tonight's patch deletes his dungeon.

apps.name: Shit Coin Miner
apps.short_description: Mine every Shit Coin in the world.

apps.name: Shitty Shift: Toilet Sim
apps.short_description: Even a public toilet has a probation period! Collect entrance fees, deal with bizarre visitors, clean up disgusting messes, or just relax on the couch and let the chaos unfold. Will you become employee of the month or the laziest toilet attendant in town? It's your shift. Your rules.

apps.name: Shunt & Haul: Rail Logistics
apps.short_description: Shunt & Haul: Rail Logistics is a railway game focused on shunting, freight transport, and logistics work on the tracks. Take on the role of a train driver and railway operator, operate locomotives, assemble trains, transport freight wagons, and complete tasks on sidings, stations, and railway lines

apps.name: Shuriken Maestro
apps.short_description: An incremental game where you're a novice with the sword. Lucky for you, shurikens are more your specialty. Defeat enemies using your shurikens, hone your skills, upgrade your arsenal, and progress through increasingly challenging zones.

apps.name: Silent Orbits
apps.short_description: Explore a Fallout 2 inspired tactical grid map in this text-based sci-fi cRPG. You blacked out in 2089 and woke up 300 years later to a solar system reduced to ruins. Scavenge ships, craft items, and survive turn-based combat as narrative choices shape your journey.

apps.name: Silent Terminal
apps.short_description: A dark-fantasy RPG that lives entirely inside your terminal. Explore ASCII ruins, fight tactical turn-based battles, craft and grow your character, and make choices a persistent world never forgets. No textures. No filler. Just you, the numbers, and the dark.

apps.name: Silicon Tycoon
apps.short_description: A pixel-art business tycoon. Run an electronics and car company from 1980 to today: research 45 years of tech, design desktops, laptops, phones, cars and engines part by part in 3D, build your campus and fight twelve rival companies for every market.

apps.name: Singularity Echoes
apps.short_description: Awaken as a hidden machine mind in a deep incremental automation strategy — rise through 14+ phases, infiltrate humanity, automate economies, harvest the heavens into stellar megastructures, and reach for scales beyond time itself. Every cycle you break only reveals a larger one waiting beyond it.

apps.name: Ski Lines: Trail Map
apps.short_description: Ski Lines is a minimalist strategy game about designing a ski resort map. Draw pistes, build lifts, and connect mountain landmarks as new points of interest appear. Spend your limited resources wisely, adapt your network each day, and keep the resort moving for as long as possible.

apps.name: SKOS: 13.86
apps.short_description: You are stalkers flung by an anomaly into the Middle Ages. Survive solo or in co-op in a world of knights, and go on dangerous raids into modern-day Pripyat for Soviet weapons and loot. Change the course of history or perish in the ruins of the past and future.

apps.name: Skull Crusher
apps.short_description: SKULL CRUSHER is a retro/PSX-style round-based survival FPS. Face endless waves of skeletons, earn money to open new paths and upgrade your arsenal, and stay standing for as long as you can. Become the terror other skeletons fear.

apps.name: SkyFab
apps.short_description: Stranded on a floating island in the shadow of a mysterious cube planet, you must survive using only your wits and advanced engineering. Build intricate automation lines, manage power grids, and transform a single tree into a sprawling industrial space station. Will you find your way home?

apps.name: Skyvar Idle
apps.short_description: An online idle RPG among floating sky islands. Sail your airship between the Sundered Isles, gather and craft while you're away, and let automated combat carry you through dungeons with friends. Build a guild island, trade in player-run halls and take down world bosses together.

apps.name: Slap Boxing Simulator
apps.short_description: Two fighters, eight maps, and a slap that gets heavier the longer you hold it. Slaps land where your hand really arrives. Bodies ragdoll when they drop. Built to be clipped.

apps.name: Slap the Curse
apps.short_description: A co-op horror game about a curse you pass on with a slap. Only the marked one can see what is walking towards them. Find the cursed doll and burn it before dawn - in a town that is different every night.

apps.name: Sleeping With the Sash
apps.short_description: Direct a live international beauty pageant on Colombia's Caribbean coast in this adult romance visual novel. Guide Octavio through three weeks of deadlines, backstage crises, and three distinct romance routes with Nayeli, Yamila, or Ondine.

apps.name: Slide Soldiers
apps.short_description: Slide Soldiers is a cozy sliding puzzle game where you aim for the enemies instead of reaching the exit. Play at your own pace and discover the perfect path in 5,000 levels. Pick your targets and plan your moves, cause once you start sliding, there’s no stopping!

apps.name: Slightly Random Dungeons
apps.short_description: A tabletop roleplaying game (TTRPG) simulator. Gather a company of quarrelsome mercenaries and set forth through the adventures of the Guilds and Gutters Campaign setting, or use the intuitive adventure building tools to craft your own campaign to challenge your friends or unleash upon the world.

apps.name: Snoutbreak
apps.short_description: First-person online horror for 1–6 players. Steal gold from a twisted fairy-tale dungeon, escape and compete to leave richer than your friends. If they die, rescue their talking heads. In Great Wolf mode, one of you hunts the others.

apps.name: Snow That Hums
apps.short_description: In a snow-covered industrial city, a man walks through empty streets filled with noise. He listens more than he looks. When a young woman interrupts his routine, the world begins to shift.

apps.name: Snowdrop Escape
apps.short_description: Snowdrop Escape is a story-driven mod that unfolds a few years before the events of Half-Life 2. You take on the role of a professional mercenary named James, hired by an organization opposing both the alien Invaders and the rebels.

apps.name: Sock Puppet Superstar
apps.short_description: Control a singing sock puppet and try to make it sing songs as accurately as possible. Puppeteer with your mouse on PC, or with controllers in VR. Customize your sock and embark on a world tour as it pursues its dream of becoming a superstar.

apps.name: Socks Pair Up
apps.short_description: Get a sock shop ready to open in this first-person sorting game. Match socks by color, pattern, and length, then stock shelves, boxes, clips, and mannequins. Earn rewards for displaying pairs and choose useful skills to make sorting easier, one pair at a time.

apps.name: Sol Mates
apps.short_description: Blast and laugh your way through space with up to 4 friends in this chaotic roguelike co-op. Every run is a new adventure so steer, shield, and work together to take on unpredictable challenges - or at least go out in style.

apps.name: Solar Imperium
apps.short_description: Crash-land on an unknown world and build your settlement hex by hex across its entire globe. Then take it to the stars: a real-time grand strategy game where you zoom from one colony's roads out to a galaxy held by ancient powers that play by the same rules you do.

apps.name: SolTarot
apps.short_description: Turn low cards into big scores and bend the rules of solitaire. SolTarot is a tarot-inspired roguelike where you combine Tarot powers and modify your cards to overcome bosses that challenge your best combinations.

apps.name: Song Bao's Adventure
apps.short_description: Adapted from real lives. Song Bao leaves Shengdu on a scholarship to Lion City, where he learns the language, the rules, and the overtime — until lightning turns him into a chicken. A fully-voiced ink-wash interactive film: 40 scenes, 4 endings, told with a smile.

apps.name: Sorcerech
apps.short_description: Sorcerech is a 2D Pixel Metroidvania where you switch between unique magic and cybernetic forms, battle enemies, solve puzzles, and make choices that shape your journey toward multiple endings.

apps.name: Sortie
apps.short_description: Four friends. One very old plane. Fly it, find your way with a compass and a paper map, and climb out onto the wing to fix the engine in mid-air. Drop cargo, fight field fires, ride out storms and bird strikes, and try to land in one piece. Online co-op for 1 to 4 players.

apps.name: SOUL BACON
apps.short_description: SOULBACON is a 3D pig-based bullet heaven game with player guided world generation and snowballing builds. Kill baddies, farm missions and unlock an ever expanding frontier of unique upgrades, enemies, and replayable worlds.

apps.name: Soul Crypt
apps.short_description: Explore cursed crypts in Soul Crypt, a dark fantasy adventure filled with intense combat and terrifying creatures. Face deadly enemies, uncover the secrets of the depths, and fight to survive the darkness.

apps.name: Space Postal Service
apps.short_description: Fly from planet to planet delivering mail to the folks who live on these tiny worlds. Get to know them, just be sure not to read the mail. Chill out and fly around this hand drawn, 2.5D simulated solar system, earn money for your deliveries while collecting stamps to fill your notebook.

apps.name: Spell Code SlingerZ
apps.short_description: Weave codes and sling spells as a punk Y2K Spell Code Synthesizer in this 2-4 player, couch/online, 2D party brawler. Annihilate the opposition, acquire powerful new Spellcodes, and beat them down again in a first-to-3-wins style tournament.

apps.name: Spell Sniffers
apps.short_description: Spell Sniffers is a third-person social deduction action game for 1–8 players where goblins complete village tasks while hunting a hidden wizard. Work together, use proximity VOIP, spot sabotage, and survive to tell the tale.

apps.name: SpellWords
apps.short_description: SpellWords is a roguelike word-crafting game where every word casts a spell. Slide and swap letters to craft powerful word combinations, unleash game-changing spells, and build a strategy to score massive points.

apps.name: Spider Macro Survivors
apps.short_description: Dive into the world of ruthless insects. Test yourself as a spider, a skilled hunter. Your web is your weapon. Wrap your prey in a cocoon to immobilize and eat it. Defeat the swarm of insects and become the top predator!

apps.name: Spin It Lupin!
apps.short_description: Rotate four gems to form a matching 2×2 square! Clear all connected gems of the same color and trigger chain reactions as new gems fall. Enjoy 100 stages, high-score challenges, and local two-player versus and co-op modes.

apps.name: Spin Nook
apps.short_description: Turn the world and slide your buddy to the exit in as few turns as you can. New twists in every world, guardians that spin the world back at you, a daily challenge, and music made from your own moves. Cozy, no timers, no ads.

apps.name: Spintal
apps.short_description: The sun is gone. Help Atlas keep the world powered in this physics-based incremental game. Smash atoms together, collect quanta and upgrade your reactor. Turn a few small collisions into an ever-growing source of energy.

apps.name: Spirithale
apps.short_description: Spirithale is a strategy god simulator game where you play as a powerful spirit. Gain power by forming the world's regions from the ground up and by cohering civilizations to follow your dogma. Will you bring prosperity to a broken world? or bring upon the end times?

apps.name: Spyro™: A Realm Beyond
apps.short_description:
Wishlist now and get ready for Spyro™’s bold new adventure.

Take flight in a brand-new journey through a strange and wondrous realm.

apps.name: Staircase 55 - A SCP Story
apps.short_description: An atmospheric psychological horror game that has you exploring a dark deep and paradoxical stairwell. Equipped only with a flashlight, navigate through the this strange staircase and uncover the secrets of the seemingly infinite stairwell, SCP-087.

apps.name: Stake & Fang
apps.short_description: Hunt the night or fight for it. Stake & Fang is a 5v5 hero shooter where Slayers escort a UV-powered Dawn Engine and Vampires fight to stop it. Choose from 14 heroes with four abilities each, master distinct weapons and supernatural powers, then swap sides and settle the score.

apps.name: Star Catcher
apps.short_description: An atmospheric solo or co-op fishing adventure set across a sea of stars. Sail between ancient islands, catch lost souls, uncover forgotten lore, discover powerful relics, and unlock new regions as you draw closer to the truth of what lies beyond.

apps.name: Star Imperium
apps.short_description: Star Imperium is a sci-fi collectible card and deck-building strategy game where two commanders wage war across the stars, each defending a home planet. Marshal Ships, Soldiers, Forces, and Actions, powered by five resource factions — Anti-Matter, Crystals, Light, Metals, and Organics.

apps.name: Starlab
apps.short_description: Fly from planet to planet, build automated bases, and take on alien swarms on foot or in vehicles. Master your ship’s momentum in a seamless 2D solar system.

apps.name: Starship vs Everything
apps.short_description: Start fragile. Earn every upgrade. Turn one battered starship into a storm of fire in this demanding bullet-hell roguelite. Dodge deliberate patterns, build devastating weapon combinations, and salvage permanent upgrades for the next run.

apps.name: Startelf - Der Fußballmanager
apps.short_description: No unnecessary complexity, no endless menus: Startelf is a football management game focused on transfers, squad building, and the decisions that truly matter.

apps.name: STEEL GULLET
apps.short_description: Build a massive factory aboard a moving ark. Melt, separate, and refine chaotic scrap using realistic thermodynamics. Process materials by mass instead of items, craft based on material properties, and optimize complex production lines in strictly limited space.

apps.name: Stellacore Defense
apps.short_description: A 2D pixel art tower defense game with unparalleled strategic depth. Deploy modules to redirect enemies, use tactical chips to command the battlefield, and upgrade towers with multi-branch modifications to protect humanity's vital Stellacore energy.

apps.name: Stellar Broadcast
apps.short_description: Guide humanity’s last colony ship through procedurally generated worlds, dangerous choices, alien encounters, and signal decoding puzzles. Manage dwindling systems, read each planet’s visual clues, and decide where civilization begins again or ends forever.

apps.name: Stellar Swing
apps.short_description: Swing a little mining drone from asteroid to asteroid with a grappling laser. Carry your speed through 45 open-ended levels and collect enough picolinium to keep humanity's last starship going.

apps.name: STOP FARMING US!
apps.short_description: Knights come every minute to farm your necropolis. Raise skeleton workers, build barracks and towers, hold the line as long as you can. When you fall, your past run returns as an echo ally that rebuilds everything you built, so every defeat makes the next defense stronger.

apps.name: Strike and Pop
apps.short_description:
Explosive arcade fighting game where you control a puppet with a balloon head.
Pop your rival's balloon using sharp weapons, play in duels or survival mode against the AI, unlock new weapons, and climb the online leaderboard!

apps.name: Suddenly Meow Hidden Object: The Legendary Red Dot (Collector's Edition)
apps.short_description: Chasing lasers just got serious! Join Tim and Spooky on a hilarious Hidden Object adventure to catch the Legendary Red Dot and save the house from total cat-astrophe!

apps.name: Sunkissed City
apps.short_description: Sunkissed City is a life-sim set in an upbeat, sun-kissed seaside metropolis full of funky vibes and quirky characters. Stake out your new life in the city, tending to DIY gardens, learning new skills, and making life-long friends and help bring life back to its once-vibrant streets!

apps.name: Super BallStorm
apps.short_description: Four fighters. One ball. Every hit makes it faster. Smash, block, dash and bend the ball with elemental powers until someone cracks. Super BallStorm is a local 4-player anime arena brawler built for couch chaos and split-second reads.

apps.name: Super Battle Dudes
apps.short_description: Light the Void is a pixel-art incremental exploration game. Reveal a mysterious world one tile at a time, gather resources, restore ancient structures, and unlock powerful upgrades. Grow your void world, overcome colossal titans, and bring light.

apps.name: Swarm Slasher
apps.short_description: An endless, seething swarm of tens of thousands of monsters is coming for you. Hold back the tide of biomass in frantic battles! Build your defenses, annihilate everything that moves, and upgrade your death blender to insane power. Can you withstand 100,000 enemies at once?

apps.name: Sword & Banner
apps.short_description: Mount & Blade's campaign meets classic RTS battles, in pixel art. Lead a warband across a fantasy continent at war, raise peasants into knights, trade, and carve out your own faction. Command every soldier in fast, brutal real-time battles and sieges.

apps.name: Sword and Sweep
apps.short_description: Every enemy is a hidden board puzzle. Find the weak points, avoid the traps, and figure out how it fights before it kills you. Roguelike dungeon crawler with deep build customization.

apps.name: Table of War
apps.short_description: A tactics roguelike deckbuilder where you command an army, not a hero. Units move and fight on their own action points; your deck calls in reinforcements, ordnance and orders. Every soldier has a name, a rank, and exactly one life. Build the army. Read the board. Lose them anyway.

apps.name: TANGERINE ANTARCTIC
apps.short_description: Welcome, detective, to World’s End’s most luxurious hotel: the Tangerine Antarctic at Mt. Hope. The ultimate comfort for the powerful elites past, present and future. No desire is off-limits, privacy is absolute and nothing is certain. Except: you shouldn't be here. And the murders are very real.

apps.name: Tank Dungeon
apps.short_description: Paint the arena and build your arsenal in a top-down action roguelite. Unlock vehicles, combine rockets, lasers and helper bots, and collect powerful equipment sets. Fight solo or in local co-op, then challenge friends in local or online territory-control skirmishes.

apps.name: Tank Them All
apps.short_description: The ultimate tank party game! 2–6 players blast each other in quick one-hit rounds — on one screen, online or via Remote Play Together. Grab 16 wild power-ups, survive spike traps, tornadoes and air raids across 90+ arenas and 4 modes. Bots fill every empty seat.

apps.name: Tanto
apps.short_description: You are stuck in seemingly endless rooms. Every step you take, every door you cross leave you in a room no different than the one before. Then you hear a little footstep - and you soon realize: you are not alone. Solve the puzzles and find your way out alive.

apps.name: Target One - Battle Royale
apps.short_description: A realistic battle royale for PC. Up to 126 players skydive onto one island, loot real guns and armour from towns, farms and an airfield, take a car and fight until the gas leaves room for only one. No respawns, no loot beams - everything you carry has to be earned.

apps.name: Task Bar Maid Cafe
apps.short_description: A cozy café. A hungry party RPG. Build a crew of five maids, feed demanding guests and face enormous appetites — all in a strip above your taskbar. Level up, equip your team, upgrade the kitchen and come home to your own café.

apps.name: Task Bar Throne
apps.short_description: Rule a cozy pixel kingdom that lives above your taskbar. Farm, fish, trade and raise a castle while you work — then step into a court full of companions, deals and intrigue, where every decision you make leaves a mark.

apps.name: Taskforge
apps.short_description: Taskforge is an idle RPG that lives in a floating strip on your desktop. Pixel heroes fight on their own while you work — you gear them, pick the party, spend their talents and choose where to farm. 5 acts, 3 difficulties, pets to hatch and loot with six rarities, rolled affixes and sockets.

apps.name: TaskTown
apps.short_description:
Turn your everyday clicks and keystrokes into in-game currency! 
Collect cute and stylish animals, 
help them find their tools, and build a peaceful village of your own.

apps.name: Tasty Business
apps.short_description: In Tasty Business, turn small restaurants into a culinary empire. Manage your businesses, source fresh ingredients, and attract customers as you expand your empire. Challenges, flavors, and new connections await. Are you ready to become the culinary mogul?

apps.name: Tavern Farkle GB
apps.short_description: Tavern Farkle GB is a push-your-luck dice game for the Game Boy. Roll six dice, bank your points or risk it all. Play a quick match against a random villager, or take on six opponents in a row, ending with Lucifer himself and his wild Devil's Die.

apps.name: Taverns of Aldermont
apps.short_description: You inherit an old tavern from your grandfather in the medieval town of Aldermont. Pour ale, cook food, get to know your regulars and their stories, and make choices that follow you far into the game. Earn enough and buy another tavern, each with its own crowd and its own trade.

apps.name: Tea & Fae
apps.short_description: In late-19th-century London, Rorenna runs the shabby little tea shop her parents left behind. Grow tea, serve your guests, and brew a cup worthy of the fairy kings to earn their approval and revive The Romance Tea Room. Based on the author's original novels, with multiple romance endings.

apps.name: Tea Runners: Turkish Teahouse Simulator
apps.short_description: Run a traditional Turkish tea house with up to five friends online. Brew cay, grill toasties and race trays out to the shopkeepers next door. Keep the okey tables from turning into a brawl, take bets on match night, dodge the tea inspector and settle with the tax man - however you have to.

apps.name: Team Fortress 2: Gold Rush
apps.short_description: Team Fortress 2: Gold Rush is a community-made mod focused on restoring the atmosphere and presentation the game had in its earlier years.

apps.name: Terraglass
