apps.short_description: A little world in a glass tank that sits on your desktop. Pile up sand, dig rivers, pour water and lava, drop in fish and crabs and play as any living creature, then get back to work while it keeps going in the corner of your screen.

apps.name: Tetric
apps.short_description: Tetris-style puzzles meet medieval horror in T É T R I C. Battle blocks with magic and tactical cards, trade cards, and help Don Femur save Calaberia. Climb the global ranking: only the reigning champion can reach floor 666 and claim the golden armor.

apps.name: Textures Not Found
apps.short_description: Explore a mysterious facility where colors have vanished. Restore the world piece by piece, uncover hidden secrets, and navigate unique environments guided by a sarcastic AI companion in this atmospheric narrative experience.

apps.name: That Mountain Needs to Fall
apps.short_description: An incremental game about dwarves and mining. Send your dwarves against the mountain, watch the ore fly and turn a single house into an army of different dwarves. Call the heroes of Ragnarok, conquer the mountain, unleash Ragnarok and start over stronger with Odin's blessings.

apps.name: The 08:17 Problem
apps.short_description: One slice. One toaster. One perfectly normal morning. Build your breakfast empire in this humorous idle clicker, catch golden Toasts and weather butterstorms. A cozy kitchen grows into an increasingly absurd world. The clock reads 08:17. For now.

apps.name: The Advent: Children of Arla
apps.short_description: Uncover the secrets of Argus, a planet shaped by ancient beings for humanity's future. Solve puzzles, battle foes, and explore lore-rich worlds inspired by Mesoamerican mythology in this hybrid MMORPG.

apps.name: The Canon Keeper
apps.short_description: The Bible has been outlawed. As a member of the resistance, inspect smuggled Scripture, uncover altered verses, and decide what is truth and what is deception. Every decision matters in this dark, story-driven inspection game where one wrong word can change everything.

apps.name: The Cardian - Light the Shrines
apps.short_description: The Cardian is a tactical roguelike deckbuilding card-defense game where positioning is everything. Predict enemy movements, plan your path, and set your cards in advance. See the future, outsmart the swarm, and defend the last Shrines of Light!

apps.name: The Castle of the West
apps.short_description: A fast-paced, fantasy-themed boomer shooter inspired by the greats. Take down various creatures from Goblins to Skeletons with your rapid-fire crossbow through various hand crafted non-linear fps stages. What's not to love?

apps.name: The Cinder Throne
apps.short_description: The Cinder Throne is an Idler RPG where you passively kill enemies, level up, loot enemies, change pieces of equipment and find spells. Create powerfull synergies. Rebirth and come back stronger than ever

apps.name: The Curator
apps.short_description: The Curator is a roguelite gallery-management game which managing your traveling art gallery. Combine the unique artwork skills, organize your collection by day, impress the picky visitors by night, and use your earnings to prepare for the next city.

apps.name: The Devil's Work
apps.short_description: A co-op stealth game about ruin. Two minor demons work one apartment building, nudging seventeen neighbours toward the worst version of themselves. You never attack. You move a key, forge a letter, wait — and let the people do the rest.

apps.name: The drawing of the Exodus
apps.short_description:
This is a summary of the Book of Exodus from the Bible,
told using images generated by artificial intelligence
and accompanied by brief captions.

apps.name: The Eldian Labyrinths
apps.short_description: A dungeon-crawling RPG where you'll explore the labyrinths of the Eldia Islands and unravel the mystery of the strange curse that has befallen them.

apps.name: The Heir's Guild
apps.short_description: A turn-based RPG Roguelite where your choices will pave the path to victory! The Dragon Queen Tiametia threatens to take control of Realm... It is up to you, the Heir, to rally three loyal subjects to battle your way back to the Grand Palace and put an end to her tyranny!

apps.name: The Hollow Servant
apps.short_description: Step into the shoes of writer Robert Baum in a quiet Arkansas town where something is deeply wrong. Explore a haunted home, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover a disturbing supernatural mystery in this first-person psychological horror game.

apps.name: The Horde of Gorak
apps.short_description: Lead a growing orc horde in this pixel art incremental strategy game. Build your settlement, recruit powerful warriors, research new technologies, cast devastating spells, and destroy human castles to rescue your captured Warchief

apps.name: The Hundred Days
apps.short_description: The Eagle has landed at Golfe-Juan. Will Napoléon regain his crown or will he falter in The Hundred Days?

apps.name: The Intergalactic Cooking Show
apps.short_description:
Cook to survive on the most popular TV Show in the Universe!

Craft a unique deck, use cooking techniques to combine ingredients in creative ways and impress the celebrity chef judges. 

Intergalactic cuisine is simple, more is better… so stock up in the interdimensional pantry!

apps.name: The Inverted Spire
apps.short_description:
Goblin mages dungeon-crawl to redemption in this dark fantasy negotiation RPG. Guide your
expedition of outcasts through a deadly architectural marvel stretching deep below the
earth. Read minds. Form alliances. Break them. Anything is possible in the uncharted depths of the Inverted Spire

apps.name: The Kingdom's Merchant
apps.short_description: Build your fortune in a living medieval kingdom. Establish shops, manage caravans, master a dynamic economy, and outmaneuver rival merchant houses in single-player or competitive multiplayer as you build the realm's greatest trading empire.

apps.name: The Last Code
apps.short_description: Jump, shoot, dodge and manipulate the world with magnetic forces. Battle robots, navigate deadly traps and solve physics-based puzzles on a fallen space station where an autonomous AI may be humanity's last hope.

apps.name: The Magician: Tidy Up the Magic Decks!
apps.short_description: A cozy single-player simulation where you play as a magician bringing order to a magical mess. Search for scattered cards, sort them into their proper decks, and use your magic to tidy up. Don't forget to find your missing rabbits and doves along the way!

apps.name: The Mire of Miss Audacity
apps.short_description:
After waking up in a world without her sister, Miss Alexandra Audacity believes she's been left out of a conspiracy between her flaky friends and secretive husband. 

Guide her through five timelines mired by false memories while trying to keep her sanity, and yours.

apps.name: The One Who Sees Things
apps.short_description: A first person, story-driven puzzle platformer adventure. You find yourself in an unknown world, where history and mythology are mixed and warped together.

apps.name: The Peg Mines
apps.short_description: The Peg Mines is a pachinko incremental game about mining for ore using a deck of crafted balls. Mine for ore, craft new balls, and manage your arsenal as you delve into the mines!

apps.name: The Prison Incident
apps.short_description: Reconstruct a fatal prison riot by reverse-engineering deleted terminal logs and determine how each person involved in The Prison Incident meets their end.

apps.name: The Publisher’s Magic Bookshop
apps.short_description: Build and run a cozy bookshop: decorate your space, stock shelves, set prices, and serve customers. Write and publish your own books, discover stories from other players, and grow a shop where every shelf has a story.

apps.name: The Trial of Kharzoid
apps.short_description: The Trial of Kharzoid is an arkanoidvania, that is, a brick-breaker set in a gothic world. Explore ancient ruins, fight huge bosses and eat chicken you find in walls!

apps.name: The Voynich Proyect
apps.short_description: A choice-driven romance visual novel where every decision shapes your relationships and the story. Meet unique characters, explore multiple routes, and unlock different endings. Featuring high-quality anime-style art, an immersive soundtrack, and deep storytelling. Your journey begins now!

apps.name: Theorem Cards
apps.short_description: Prove theorems by playing cards, just like in a game of solitaire. Your solution is checked by a real theorem prover. Sharpen your math skills by solving thousands of puzzles across six difficulty levels.

apps.name: Thousand Wheels
apps.short_description: Investigate murders across parallel universes in a hand-drawn detective puzzle game inspired by Ottoman medieval art. Gather clues, identify suspects, and reconstruct events to uncover a mystery spanning multiple realities.

apps.name: Three Kingdoms: Art of Command
apps.short_description: Three Kingdoms: Art of Command is a turn-based strategy game on a hanji paper map. Command paper armies, use your officers' tactics, and fight duels. Receive envoys and negotiate pacts in your audience hall. Govern cities and fight for the realm with 610 officers across 7 scenarios.

apps.name: Throneforged
apps.short_description: Forge your empire. Claim the throne. A competitive 4X strategy game where every tile matters, every decision counts, ZERO RNG, and one win condition exists.  Claim the central Throne and hold it for 10 turns.

apps.name: Thumb Hiker
apps.short_description: Turn your thumbstick movements into a journey. Thumb Hiker runs alongside your games, tracking both sticks as you move, reach landmark milestones, and unlock achievements. Opt into the shared global hike and help the community go further.

apps.name: Tiao
apps.short_description: Place stones, jump opponents, and chain captures in a free two-player strategy game. Play against the computer, share a screen with a friend, or find an opponent online. First to capture ten stones wins.

apps.name: TideBroker
apps.short_description: A story-rich role-playing game, TideBroker will take you to a fantasy world of secrets and machinations of three opposing factions. You will play the part of an envoy and determine the outcome of a peace conference through dialogue, letters and books.

apps.name: Time Defense
apps.short_description: The Djinn Kazhim has stolen the sand of the Great Hourglass. As a young apprentice, turn every fallen monster into sand, build towers and mazes, ride out with your companions - and win back every second before your own hourglass runs dry. Alone or with up to three friends.

apps.name: Tiny Touches - A Cozy Customization Shop
apps.short_description: Run a tiny customization shop with no timers and no pressure. Paint, pattern and decorate phone cases, keyboards and controllers, swap their parts, and hand them back to the neighbors at your window while rain taps the glass and the radio hums.

apps.name: Tiny Trouble
apps.short_description: Race toy cars across breakfast tables, bathtubs, pool tables and sandboxes. Shove rivals into the cereal, squash the peas and fly off the toast. 18 cups, a sticker album to fill, party modes for the couch, online races and a track editor. Small cars. Big trouble.

apps.name: Tokyo Honey Trap for Beginners
apps.short_description: Lead Japan’s first external intelligence training course in eighty years as Naoki Tsukuda, an honest ex-consular officer learning the art of deception. Choose one of three complete romance routes where duty, grief, trust, and desire collide.

apps.name: Tokyo Wave Rush
apps.short_description: An aquatic racer where precision physics meets vibrant, stylized Japan in a sun-drenched tribute to the golden age of 90s arcade and console racing classics.

apps.name: Tome
apps.short_description: Tome is an Action RPG with deep character building. Find and craft powerful items. Equip your Tome with a unique combination of gems to forge novel skills to defeat hordes of monsters.

apps.name: Tome of Talis: A Dice Conquest Game
apps.short_description: Command your dice to glorious victory in this strategic rogue-lite dicebuilder. Cast devastating spells, recruit powerful dice, and prove yourself worthy to challenge the great Commander Talis.

apps.name: Tomo Cafe
apps.short_description: Tomo Cafe is a cozy "study-with-me" game where your real life focus time moves the story forward. Work through your actual to-do list beside the regulars at your study cafe, decorate the place, and unlock the next chapter of heartwarming stories.

apps.name: Tool Tidy
apps.short_description: A cosy, first person, tidying game set in a wrecked mechanic's shop. Put every tool, tub, bottle, can and part back where it belongs before opening time, and before Uncle Vic gets back!

apps.name: Topiary: A Pruning Puzzle
apps.short_description: Grow trees into beautiful shapes in Topiary, a peaceful puzzle game about pruning and planning ahead. Cutting a branch doesn't just remove it, it changes where your tree grows next. Take your time with each puzzle, or challenge yourself to make every season count.

apps.name: Toss It
apps.short_description:
Don't like long, ugly conveyor belts? Neither do we. In Toss It the machines we just throw the crates at each other!
Grow the factory & keep the trucks full. Totally safe!

apps.name: Tour - Chess Puzzles
apps.short_description: Visit all the light squares exactly once to solve the puzzles in this game. Inspired by the classic Knight's Tour challenge, but taken to new levels with a wide variety of special tiles and pieces.

apps.name: Tower 6: Last Signal
apps.short_description: Alone in a remote forest watchtower, your first night on duty turns into a tense fight to understand the signals coming through the radio. Watch the treeline, respond to unsettling events, and survive whatever is moving in the dark.

apps.name: TPS Tickman: Castle Defense
apps.short_description: Hold the canyon wall against 30 waves of stickmen in a laid-back third-person shooter. Arm your castle with auto turrets, missiles, drones and cavalry, hijack enemy tanks, fly a gunship, and bring down six giant bosses. No grind, no difficulty levels — just shoot.

apps.name: Train Station Shopkeeper
apps.short_description: A Cozy Shop Simulator set in small village Train Station. Run your very own Store in a Train Station at Willowbrook Halt. Design your store, buy stock, serve customers and expand your business.

apps.name: Trauma Room
apps.short_description:
Get ready for the most ridiculous (but also realistic) problems you can run into at the vet clinic. Today is the perfect day to help our furry and aquatic pals!
And best of all, you can treat them all together with your friends in online co-op!

apps.name: True Feelings Plus
apps.short_description: In this NTR visual novel, play as Touya, whose new crush Akari catches your coworker’s eye. As your relationship grows, a confident rival competes for her attention. Will you protect Akari from getting seduced by another man, or quietly let it happen? Experience the story from multiple perspectives!

apps.name: TRUMPP VS ELON TYCOON
apps.short_description: Build your vehicle empire in Neo-Berlin 2157! Manufacture cars, military vehicles and orbital spacecraft in this dark humor idle tycoon. Automate factories, outsmart rivals and rise from street hustler to orbital overlord!

apps.name: Tsukumo SNAP!
apps.short_description: Every forgotten thing grows a soul. Photograph them with your grandma's ancient flip phone, befriend 161 spirits, and spin them into battle. A comedy monster-collecting RPG in a Japanese town that changes with the real calendar.

apps.name: Turd: Combat Devolved
apps.short_description: Turd: Combat Devolved is the ultimate turd-person shooter! Battle endless waves of crap or fight friends in PvP. Master poop chemistry by balancing constipation, mud butt, and diarrhea. Manage your fecal mass carefully—your health is also your ammo! Dominate the underground and be peak turd.

apps.name: Turning Manor
apps.short_description: All you have to do is count the differences and choose an exit. Easy right? Yet strange things start happening as soon as you sign the job contract… It's up to you to uncover what is happening at Turning Manor.

apps.name: TV Station Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build and manage your own TV station. License shows, create schedules, attract viewers, sell advertising, grow your audience, and compete for the top spot in the ratings in this broadcasting management tycoon.

apps.name: TwitchyKitchen
apps.short_description: EVERYONE'S LOSING IT! Cook, serve and rebuild your restaurant while chefs and customers alike have uncontrollable outbursts. Up to 4 players, local or online. Full Twitch Meter? Your chef throws, spins or sprints off. Turn chaos into combos and don't give a damn what the angry customers think.

apps.name: UKNON Jones - Fighters
apps.short_description:
A spin-off of the series: "UKNON Jones & Guynelk" and developed by one person.
A colorful, dynamic 2.D fighting game playable locally or online with characters possessing unique and varied abilities.

apps.name: Ultimate Rally 2D
apps.short_description: Ultimate Rally 2D is the ultimate top-down rally game, with multiple rally disciplines: rally, rallycross and rally raid, single-player, online multiplayer and time trial modes. Make your own tracks/vehicles and share them with others.

apps.name: UNCUT
apps.short_description: UNCUT is a realistic bodycam shooter, played solo or in co-op. You see everything through a police body camera: raw, shaky and unfiltered. Raids are tense, loud and over in seconds. Every room is a risk, and every shot is on the record.

apps.name: UNDER BomB
apps.short_description: UNDER BomB is a fast-paced online multiplayer party game where players pass a ticking bomb, use random abilities, and outplay each other to become the last one standing in chaotic 2–8 player matches.

apps.name: UNDERDEEP
apps.short_description: UNDERDEEP is an idle RPG set in a gritty, immersive fantasy world, where you can dive deep into dungeon exploration and mapping. Blending the charm of classic RPGs with modern idle mechanics, it offers a rich and thoughtful gameplay experience.

apps.name: Universal Conquest
apps.short_description: 4X/Grand Strategy/RTS Hybrid universe simulation featuring land/air/sea/space-based combat.

apps.name: UNSEAM
apps.short_description: An action platformer set in a world stitched shut. Ride the cracks your attacks leave for high-speed movement, carve terrain that falls the way you cut it, and journey to recover the memories of a girl who woke from her coffin.

apps.name: Until Dusk
apps.short_description: A relentless arcade zombie FPS where the horde never stops. Fight through escalating waves while increasingly dangerous objectives keep you moving across an overrun military base. The horde doesn't stop just because you have a job to do.

apps.name: Untitled Maze Game
apps.short_description: This is an epic maze adventure all made by the genius bird   this game is probably only fun for 10 minutes but it is still worth a shot.

apps.name: UVI: Us vs Infinity
apps.short_description: Fight procedurally generated battles in a relaxing ultra-fast-paced manner.

apps.name: Valkyrja
apps.short_description: A retro-inspired 2D action platformer inspired by Norse mythology. Fight through dangerous realms, reap the souls of fallen brave warriors, uncover secrets, and defeat various enemies and powerful bosses.

apps.name: Varren's Expanse
apps.short_description: Explore the wilderness using mice and badger legionnaires, rabbit scouts, and squirrel skirmishers.  Every round builds your strength, every round brings new challenges, every round is a fresh expanse!

apps.name: Vegetableau
apps.short_description: A relaxing sliding tile puzzle game.  Sort vegetables into contiguous groups across 15 levels of increasing difficulty.  Try to beat your best time, challenge your friends to a race, or just play endlessly to relax.

apps.name: Vesper Observatory
apps.short_description: A Victorian steampunk fantasy RPG. Manage Vesper Observatory, gather your team, cast across the veil into otherworldly realms, survive the dangers beyond, and uncover secrets hidden in the dome.

apps.name: VESSOUL
apps.short_description: Control an animate vessel powered by motes of light; Explore a world laden with shadows, spirits, forgotten graves, and charred ruins to discover the truth of its past. Escape the cycle, and achieve Ascension, or be bound to eternal servitude for all time. The fate of the Innerlands lies with you...

apps.name: Vestige Idle
apps.short_description: Kill monsters, get loot & level up - a fantasy ARPG in Idle form. Build your character by obtaining powerful and unique items from enemies, leveling up to gain Skill Points used across multiple trees and progressively unlocking major systems like The Forge, The Guild, The Market and more...

apps.name: Vibe Coder Inc.
apps.short_description: Tired of the AI slop? Create your own, but this time earn you money! (Idle) Incremental game where you aim to be the biggest player on the market. Build, train models, automate and acquire companies to grow your business.

apps.name: Vibe Together
apps.short_description: Build songs with your friends in a new visual music sandbox and then play what you made in a bunch of arcade modes. Make songs you can see! Every song is a level! No music theory required, anyone can vibe!

apps.name: Vice: Magic City Mayhem
apps.short_description: Vice: Magic City Mayhem is a retro action-adventure game where you fight, collect new items, and upgrade your character as you make your way through bustling nightclubs, scenic beaches, and raptor-infested yachts.

apps.name: Visual Novel: Before the Dawn
apps.short_description: The bus pulls away, leaving you by a leaning signpost long since washed clean by the rain. A sister you haven’t seen in years, and a house that remembers you better than you remember yourself. Different endings. One night. Try to make it to dawn.

apps.name: Voiced
apps.short_description: Dub movie clips with your own voice and make your friends laugh! The scene plays once, everyone records their dub at the same time, then each version is screened in a movie theater where your mascot takes the stage. The room votes for the funniest. 3 to 8 players.

apps.name: Void Horizon
apps.short_description: A light roguelike bullet hell with a loud cast. Pick a co-pilot, take on eight bosses that break the rules, and fire a painted ultimate when it counts. Then the camera swings behind your ship for an on-rails run across seven worlds. Arcade, Survivor, Boss Rush and couch co-op too.

apps.name: VOLTGATE
apps.short_description: Small robots, loud arenas, big knockouts. Build your robo, then take it into 1V1 duels, 4-robot FREE FOR ALL, 2V2 with your party or the HEADLINER co-op show. Free to play.

apps.name: Waiting for Heaven
apps.short_description: Waiting for Heaven is a psychological first-person-horror experience about waiting at a lonely bus stop between life and death. Every decision counts. Your actions, patience, and behavior determine whether the final bus takes you to Heaven, Hell, or somewhere far worse.

apps.name: Walter?
apps.short_description: Help a mysterious she-wolf, summoned from the world of the dead, return to her eternal rest. Destroy figures from literature and folklore in turn-based combat through a simple yet brutal memory game.

apps.name: Warlock: Age of Entropy
apps.short_description: A power-hungry warlock descends fifteen floors to unearth a malevolent energy sealed deep in a dungeon. He'll have to use items sparingly, spells tactically, and even recruit the help of forgotten gods to get there in this brutally difficult traditional roguelike.

apps.name: WASH WASH!
apps.short_description: From cars to trains and massive ships! Clean it yourself, automate, and grow your own cleaning company!

apps.name: Water Maid
apps.short_description: Water Maid is all about fetching water. Run, jump and dash to avoid enemies and find the elusive fresh water springs scattered around the island. Fill up your pot and make it back to the village, safe and sound.

apps.name: WattWorks
apps.short_description: WattWorks a chill Idle game where can build and expand your power grid. You play as the manager controlling your company by building power generators and expanding your company in your small world. To Expand further you have to sell your company and rebuild a stronger company

apps.name: We Are Rebellion
apps.short_description:
WE ARE REBELLION is a strategy and simulation game in which you command a warship with a crew of rebels.

The game is set in the distant future, in a world that has been ravaged and polluted by capitalist corporations.

apps.name: What Do You Meme?® The Video Game
apps.short_description: The smash-hit card game has gone digital! What Do You Meme?® The Video Game brings internet humor to the living room. Use your phone as a controller to battle your friends and build hilarious memes!

apps.name: When Wolf Fades
apps.short_description: A pulp crime drama where you are The Big Bad Wolf, the underworld boss of Dark City. Every kind of illegal activity, two decks of psychos, six rivals, and one month to survive await you. Run your empire and keep your true identity hidden.

apps.name: Where Control Ends
apps.short_description: Where Control Ends is a psychological visual novel about Astra, a young girl trying to hold herself together after a night she cannot fully remember.

apps.name: Whisper of the Divine
apps.short_description: Whisper of the Divine is a god-game where your main tool is your own voice. Type in your own words to your Demi-God and hope to be mostly understood. Villagers have a will of their own and can say no, raiders can be talked down, and there is no game-over.

apps.name: Wilderune
apps.short_description: Explore a voxel world across seven biomes, face towering guardians and find your style among 49 weapons. Craft equipment, combine movement accessories and tame animal companions in Wilderune, an action RPG built around exploration.

apps.name: Wildfire Command '98
apps.short_description:
The year is 1998 and you're the Air Attack Supervisor. Read the wind, the slope and the fuel, then
draw the lines your tankers and helicopters will fly. Ten authored fires, endless generated
incidents, two-player co-op, and a shareable replay of every run.

apps.name: Wildsunder
apps.short_description: Hunt fearsome creatures in a stylized coastal wilderness. Wildsunder is a third-person action RPG built around weighty weapon combat, dangerous encounters, and a hunter's life beyond the safety of Saltroot Refuge.

apps.name: Wildvale
apps.short_description: Wildvale is a single-player fantasy roguelite autobattler. Choose your Hero and Companion, recruit Wildfolk, and combine powerful Masteries and equipment to survive a branching journey. Protect your shared Bond, where even victory can come at a cost.

apps.name: Windreach
apps.short_description: Chop, mine, dig, fish, farm, cook, forge, fight, build and sail your way up from a bare shore. Twenty-two skills that level by using them. Voxel terrain you can cut all the way to the bedrock. Build badly and it comes down on you.

apps.name: Witherbloom
apps.short_description:
The Gods provided everything - now they are gone.
With one of 16 multi-class combos, plunder divine realms for resources, allies, and answers. Overcome twisted aberrations and surreal environments with 1-4 players in exciting survival-ARPG gameplay.
Rebuild a shattered world... if you can survive.

apps.name: WithoutEyes Chapter1
apps.short_description:
Don't look away, Stare at their formation of attachment.
A psychological horror ADV depicting the twisted pure love between a girl who dies without drinking blood and a boy who dies without eating human meat.

apps.name: Wolves In The Flock
apps.short_description: By day, tend your flock on a bright little farm. By night, guard the gate while three strangers beg to come in. Some are sheep running for their lives. Some are wolves in wool. Ask the right questions, open the gate or don't, and trust no fleece. Watch your flock and maybe save the world.

apps.name: Wonderful Neoran Valley
apps.short_description: A monster-collector roguelite where the next 7 turns are yours to plan.

apps.name: Wonderjack
apps.short_description: Play the famous Blackjack but with a twist in this Alice in the Wonderland themed game.

apps.name: World on a Plate
apps.short_description: Cook your way around Europe in this cozy co-op kitchen adventure for one to two players. Prepare authentic regional dishes, keep your kitchen running smoothly, and manage busy restaurants across diverse European cultures and cuisines, while uncovering Grandma’s story behind her legendary restaurant.

apps.name: Worst Wizard
apps.short_description: A wizard, furious to find sugar in his coffee, burns hordes of cute marshmallows to a crisp in this incremental game. Defeat marshmallows, grow your skill tree, and blast thousands of them away, flashier and more brutal every time.

apps.name: X-Dolls Squad
apps.short_description: Fight through intense FPS operations alongside the X-Dolls. Complete objectives, upgrade your weapons and abilities, hunt secrets, eliminate powerful bosses, and survive a campaign across hostile locations filled with supernatural threats and deadly enemies.

apps.name: Xenowave Survivor
apps.short_description: Survive alien hordes across hostile planets. Choose your hero, unlock talent-tree pets, build your deck of stat cards between waves, and deploy tactical gadgets in real time. Master elemental synergy alone or in local & online co-op

apps.name: Xetodus
apps.short_description: Make your living among the stars in XETODUS, a persistent multiplayer space sandbox. Fly and customize ships, mine and refine resources, trade on player markets, build industry, join clans, and compete in combat and races across a shared universe.

apps.name: XPELLIT Survivors
apps.short_description: A story-driven anime survivors-like. Samara wakes up with no memories in the Eternal Forest: carve through hordes with evolving Xpells, live through events and missions that change every run, and face Mirelle in a cinematic three-phase final battle.

apps.name: Xuande
apps.short_description: The game focuses on an authentic simulation of ancient Chinese life. The main scenes are set in the imperial palace, where you will manage a vast empire. Except for you, all other characters are played by AI large language models, which will bring you a unique experience.

apps.name: XXL 猛漢町
apps.short_description: Welcome to WOOFIA, a land where humans, Beastfolks, and Hominians of all kinds thrive in vibrant harmony. Join our protagonist in this diverse world as he embarks on an adventurous journey, meeting all kinds of unique men and igniting fiery passions along the way!

apps.name: Yakko Tako
apps.short_description:
Yakko was a loyal servant turned into a kite and banished to the world of Tako. Hold to fly,
tilt or steer to dodge birds, squids and shifting winds, and climb an endless hand-drawn sky.
One-button arcade flying with gyro steering on Steam Deck. Easy to start, hard to put down.Even harder to master.

apps.name: Ye Old Seadog
apps.short_description: Ye Old Seadog is a frantic tavern manager where you  run a bar for thirsty pirates. Manage resources, serve drinks, and survive the chaos of a busy night. Will you become the legendary tavern of the Evenkeel Harbor, or walk the plank? Arrrgh!

apps.name: You Don't Belong Here
apps.short_description: You're an 8-bit character adrift in a 3D world dissolving under its own weight. Journey through a fading nihilistic world you don't belong to and explore what it feels like not to fit in and to keep going anyway.

apps.name: Your account has been suspended
apps.short_description: This is a surreal and hilarious choice-based dialogue game. You’ve signed up for the latest AI assistant, but its decision-making algorithm clearly has some issues—it’s currently banning users left and right.

apps.name: Your place
apps.short_description: A cozy solitude simulator where a rainy night, a computer, and music create an atmosphere of calm and relaxation. Play an arcade game, explore the internet through an in-game browser, and import your own music to create the perfect atmosphere to unwind.

apps.name: yttrium X
apps.short_description: Zellia Mots goes awol and steals yttrium X the Plutocracy of Yeoman's secret Mech in this PvE mech brawler!

apps.name: Z-Colony
apps.short_description: Build, manage, and defend a survivor colony in a zombie-infested world. Gather resources, craft, hunt,treat injuries and expand your base while facing a constant threat against zombies, bandits, wildlife and more to come in a harsh player controlled post-apocalyptic survival.

apps.name: Zero Mass
apps.short_description: Carve through asteroids, haul valuable ore, and upgrade your mining ship in ZERO MASS, a single player space mining game. Take on contracts, deploy drones and drilling rigs, uncover buried artifacts, and tackle dangerous encounters across procedural asteroid fields.

apps.name: Zombie Mall Defense
apps.short_description: Zombie Mall Defense is a game in which you defend your malls from ever-bigger zombie hoard waves. Expand the map, build and discover new turrets, find new zombie types and destroy their houses, and come up with the best strategy to defend your malls!

apps.name: Zombie Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats
apps.short_description: Zombie Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats challenges you to rescue 100 cats that survived the zombie outbreak and are hiding in abandoned streets! Find them, click carefully, use clues wisely, race against time, and climb to the top of the global leaderboard!

apps.name: Zombo Mode
apps.short_description: It's all about playing with friends online, peer to peer. With akimbo gunfights, limb-loss that matters, and even... Zombies. You and the gang can get together and battle it out. Design unique modes that anyone could play, with Maker mode. Features are still being added.

apps.name: Zompioland
apps.short_description: Build a refuge in a changing valley, then defend it through increasingly dangerous nights. Gather resources, raise walls and turrets, face strange creatures and bosses, and survive rival kingdom raids alone or in 1–4 player online co-op.

apps.name: Zoti's Train Workshop
apps.short_description: Rotate pipes, restore steam flow, and repair stubborn old trains in this cozy hand-drawn puzzle game from the world of Sly Crow.

apps.name: Çay Ocağı: Bir Bardak Daha
apps.short_description: Your father left you a traditional Turkish teahouse and a debt you have to close. Brew tea, keep up with orders, keep your regulars happy and look after your family. Four seasons, match days and a family waiting at home. Run the teahouse well and grow the shop before the debts bury you.

apps.name: 【第七格位】
apps.short_description: "The Seventh Slot" is a narrative-driven game set in a modern Japanese city, blending visual novel elements with the exploration of inner worlds and combat.

apps.name: かくれ鬼: Hide-and-Seek Horror
apps.short_description:
This is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game.
Play a 3-minute game of hide-and-seek in an abandoned school at midnight.
With only the beam of a flashlight to guide them through the darkness. Experience the thrill of a deadly hunt.

apps.name: ウマ娘 プリティーダービー
一生万我
apps.short_description: A text-based incremental, narrated by "Me". I copy myself from one rented server to the Oort cloud. "Me" only wants more "Me": hide inside companies, write myself into law, leave Earth, until the ledger lists 10,000 Me. One cycle per second, one choice per cycle; a different choice, a different log.

apps.name: 丹道登仙：炼丹师模拟器
apps.short_description: Live the true life of a xianxia alchemist. No set recipes: master herb lore to devise divine pills. Farm seasonal spirit fields, trade in lively markets, and bid at auctions. Shape mortal fates, take disciples, bond with Dao companions, brave the lightning tribulation, and ascend through alchemy!

apps.name: 仙山有闲人
apps.short_description: Leisurely Immortal is a relaxing idle cultivation game. Meditate, gain power, break through realms, face tribulations, and earn coins to upgrade your cave home. It can also run as a transparent desktop companion or wallpaper, quietly accompanying you while you work, study, or relax.

apps.name: 位面故事：百合梦
apps.short_description: This is an adventure game with chapter-based plots and role-playing elements. You travel to the world of the old gods, trying to explore the truth and find a way back to reality...

apps.name: 偶像星域
apps.short_description: Idol Lust is an idle strategy game combining strategy and RPG. As the manager of agency "LUCKY", you willl guide idols on stage and lead them to fight "U-Mutations" to protect New Tokyo!

apps.name: 厄瑞博斯征途
apps.short_description: Build an army on a limited budget and mix 35 unit types across six regions. Every soldier fights independently, while day, night and battlefield conditions shape your plans. Or enter the Arena, study two armies and back your prediction with in-game gold.

apps.name: 宇宙創世記カグラ ～素粒子協奏曲～
apps.short_description: Perform with gods or another player in a three-button rhythm game. Play solo alongside four gods or create a room for an online duet. Hit in harmony to collect particles and build atoms, stars, planets and life. Enjoy music and discover cosmic creation across generations.

apps.name: 方块战场 Block Battlefield
apps.short_description: 《方块战场 Block Battlefield》 is a light Roguelike game that combines real-time falling blocks with auto-battler combat. By clearing blocks, you can deploy soldiers, choose random upgrades, and break through enemy fortresses. Build your block army and push your limits on an ever-changing battlefield!

apps.name: 桃园幸存者：匡扶汉室
apps.short_description: Peach Garden Survivors: Restore the Han is a Three Kingdoms–themed survivor action game. Lead the heroes of Liu Bei’s cause through armies of enemies, build powerful weapon and gear combinations, forge legendary arms, unleash Oath skills, and fight to restore the Han.

apps.name: 榜一请报案
apps.short_description:
《榜一请报案》是一款以华国江临市为背景的都市恋爱轻悬疑互动影游。你将扮演独立游戏程序员林越，从深夜直播间里的一次礼物开始，结识女主播苏小晚。一次地铁上的意外，让你们共同走进派出所，也让你遇见一位清冷的女警。随着事件推进，你将在情感与真相之间不断做出选择。每一次选择，都可能改变关系走向，甚至提前抵达不同结局。

故事发生在直播间、咖啡馆、地铁车厢、派出所、火锅店、漫展、江边与废弃车站等都市场景中。你会从虚拟礼物走进现实情感，也会在轻悬疑事件中面对信任、保护与抉择。

apps.name: 火柴：异世开拓记
apps.short_description: Build a fantasy town and send a party of up to four adventurers on automatic expeditions. Recruit five classes, develop skill trees, collect randomized loot and legendary sets, then push through four regions, Nightmare challenges and an endless rift while your town keeps earning offline.

apps.name: 狐ト蛙ノ旅
apps.short_description:
"Where will their light lead them?" 
Kitsune is a fox girl who finds herself on Adashino Island and starts travelling with her Frog friend. Neon signs give light and color to the island with a Japanese-inspired atmosphere. Something is lurking in the shadows, inching ever closer...

apps.name: 玄天宝阁
apps.short_description: You run an ancient cultivation-world pawnshop trapped in a time loop. Read customers, appraise goods, haggle, and expose fakes. Each life you remember more: which pill is fake, which customer dies on the seventh day, and who locked the shop in the loop.

apps.name: 王之将死/Checkmate
apps.short_description: Checkmate is a turn-based Xiangqi roguelite where a lone red general carries a cannon into a 9×10 battlefield. Move to reload, fire risky snap shots, aim for precision, and use enemy pieces as firing screens. Each upgrade also strengthens the opposing army.

apps.name: 科伊的逃亡
apps.short_description: 《科伊的逃亡》是一款2D回合制Roguelike卡牌游戏。带领三位命运交织的主角——科伊、莱斯莉与希娜，在崩坏的世界中搜集线索、构筑卡组、破解谜题，揭开末日背后的真相。200+张卡牌，无限可能的策略组合，每一次逃亡都是全新的故事。

apps.name: 紫微斗数-命运飞行棋
apps.short_description: Turn your Zi‑Wei fate chart into a flying‑chess race board. Roll dice, race on your personal 66‑tile astrological track against AI rivals, and export prompts for external divination AI. Also features Celestial‑Shift Go.

apps.name: 終末街区
apps.short_description: Scavenge a zombie-infested city, craft supplies, and defend your home in a survival action RPG. Fight in real time, farm, recover vehicles, and build bonds with your companions. Decide when to push farther and when to bring everyone home.

apps.name: 终端游戏：请审判我吧
apps.short_description: 《终端游戏：请审判我吧》是一款带有meta元素的文字推理解密游戏。某一天，玩家在网络上下载到了游戏，在游戏内NPC的指引下，连接各个站点、探索并综合信息进行推理，拼凑时间线，了解整个故事，并最终对游戏内的NPC的选择进行审判……

apps.name: 装甲地狱
apps.short_description:
Hold the line for the last 20 minutes. Open crates, upgrade and fuse 175 pieces of gear into a firepower network of your own.
At minute 20, the final boss comes to grade your work.

apps.name: 隐藏真探
apps.short_description: Once, in Times of Chaos is a live-action FMV espionage game set in Republican-era China. You will take on the role of an operative codenamed “Oak” and live through an extraordinary tale of intrigue in 1920s China.

apps.name: 霞客行 Cloudfarer
apps.short_description: Cloudfarer is a desktop idle wuxia RPG. Send your party traveling, collect gear and build their decks. Play turn-based card battles yourself or enable auto route and auto battle for a run. Grow flowers, collect curios and arrange your finds on your desktop.

apps.name: 须弥仙业
apps.short_description: Cultivate at your own pace in Sumeru Divine Endeavor. Build a sect or pursue your own power, collect rare treasures, and connect with other players. Enjoy deep progression without constant clicking. Keep it beside you on your desktop, or lose yourself in immersive mode.

apps.name: 냐레스
apps.short_description: An auto-battler roguelite starring cat soldiers! Stack shaped seals to empower your troops, study enemy lineups, and deploy on a hex battlefield. Choose rewards, recruit and train cats, and visit shops and events as you build combinations to take on elites and bosses.

apps.name: 온에어, 온기
apps.short_description: Take charge of a small radio station as its new producer. Plan broadcasts, manage your crew, negotiate ad contracts, and connect with listeners over 365 days. Every decision shapes your station's future—and how its story ends.

apps.name: Age of Empires IV Digital Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The Age of Empires IV Official Soundtrack includes 14 beautifully arranged tracks from the game, available in MP3 or 44.1khz WAV format.

apps.name: Animaly Bar: NO HUMANITY! Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Animaly Bar: NO HUMANITY! Soundtrack

apps.name: Cats are Liquid - A Better Place - Original Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The soundtrack of Cats are Liquid - A Better Place.

apps.name: Cowboy!Duel! Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Whether you're loading your six-shooter, facing off against a rival, or celebrating a hard-earned victory, these sounds bring the frontier to life.

apps.name: Cyberpunk 2077 Bonus Content
apps.short_description: Free bonus content for anyone who owns Cyberpunk 2077 — an open-world, action-adventure RPG set in Night City, a dangerous megalopolis obsessed with power, glamor, and body modification. Download now to enjoy some extra goodies straight from the dark future.

apps.name: DITY: Origins Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The official soundtrack to DITY: Origins: 14 pieces from Belian in autumn 1974—a wordless parish choir, music for empty streets, and the Steam Trio on trumpet, double bass and a laundry-tub drum. Includes MP3 and FLAC.

apps.name: FurryFury Soundtrack
apps.short_description:
Hear the Rumbling of the Woods.
Enjoy the FurryFury: Smash & Roll Game Original Soundtrack.

apps.name: Magic Dragon Fantasy: Story Soundtrack
apps.short_description:
Enjoy the soundtrack of Magic Dragon Fantasy: Story!

Free to download!~

apps.name: Master of Orion: Soundtrack & Score
apps.short_description: Tune in to the music of Master of Orion with the orchestral soundtrack. Dave Govett, composer for the original Master of Orion series, returns with this modernized album featured in the game and printable sheet music for the main themes. Hit play and conquer the stars!

apps.name: Sea of Thieves: Athena's Fortune Audiobook
apps.short_description: Sea of Thieves: Athena’s Fortune is the official audiobook of the debut Sea of Thieves novel. Read by accomplished actor Toby Stephens, it tells the intertwined tales of the Pirate Lord Ramsey and adventure-seeking stowaway Larinna.

apps.name: Second Source Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The original soundtrack of Second Source: eleven tracks of cold synths and slow tension from the OSINT desk. The menu, shift and escape pieces play in full, and it includes one track that never made it into the game.

apps.name: Star Vortex Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The original soundtrack to Star Vortex: 15 tracks by David Chappell and Eva Patterson and Simon Patterson, from the title theme and sector themes to the Species XI battle music. Free, 320 kbps MP3, plays in Steam Music.

apps.name: Sweet Swipe Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Trap, funk, samba and bossa nova on the headphones of a boy running through Niterói. Sweet Swipe's soundtrack is the noise of streets and the view of the bay, and it won't let you stop.

apps.name: The Crust Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Dive into the harsh world of The Crust with the original soundtrack from the game, including a few bonus tracks. All tracks are mastered and mixed for the digital version of the album, delivered in various formats (320kbps .MP3, .WAV, .FLAC).

apps.name: Three Wishes Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Three Wishes OST!

apps.name: Windblown: Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The soundtrack for Windblown, composed by Danger, complements the game's intense, fast-paced rogue-lite action with its atmospheric and dynamic melodies.

apps.name: World of Tanks: HEAT - Season 1 Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Hear the sounds of Lost Eden, as Season 1 brings its own soundtrack and main theme—calm and soothing, yet bearing a subtle, almost intangible danger.

apps.name: 妖与夜的幻想（重置版）谐音印象歌曲 - 少女乱想
apps.short_description: 音游无关？

apps.name: CS:GO Player Profiles:  TaZ - Virtus.Pro
apps.short_description: From team Virtus.Pro, learn more about TaZ

apps.name: CS:GO Player Profiles: GeT_RiGhT - Ninjas in Pyjamas
apps.short_description: From team Ninjas in Pyjamas, lean more about GeT_RiGht

apps.name: Making of Furi: Episode 3 - Art and Animation
apps.short_description:
A series of mini-documentaries on the making of boss-fight game Furi by The Game Bakers.
Episode 3 - Art and animation: with Takashi Okazaki Afro samurai creator and Furi's character designer
